title: Apple with milk

ingredients.name: dried fruits: raisins, almonds and walnuts

preparation: Boil the milk with the cardamom until it is reduced by half. Peel and grate the apples. In a pan, add the apples and the sugar. Cook until the apple juice has evaporated and the sugar turns into caramel. Add the caramelized apple to the milk and simmer for 7-8 minutes, stirring with a spatula. Add the dried fruits. Place in the refrigerator. Serve once it is cold.
notes: This dish can be offered as a snack; since it is composed of fruit, dairy, and nuts, it is very complete. Apples are a good source of fiber, while nuts provide high-quality fats and proteins.

title: Macaroni with tuna
preparation: Bring the water to a boil. Once it starts boiling, add a pinch of salt and add the macaroni (100 g per person). When they are cooked to your liking, add a little butter and pepper. In parallel, chop the onion and fry it slowly until it turns brown. Once fried, mix it with the tuna and the macaroni.
notes: Tuna is a fish that provides us with excellent quality proteins and fats. To increase the fiber content of this dish, you can use whole wheat macaroni. This recipe can be used as a main course; if accompanied by a salad or varied seasonal vegetables, it is already nutritionally complete and balanced. Try, as much as possible, to preferably use extra virgin olive oil.

title: Tapita
preparation: Make a sofrito with onion, peppers (red and green), garlic, and sautéed chickpeas. Cut the bread (it can also be toasted) and place the sofrito and a canned sardine on top!
notes: The sofrito, very representative of Mediterranean cuisine, is an excellent source of antioxidants, which are essential for the proper functioning of our organism. Additionally, it is ideal for making use of those peppers that, due to being overripe, would not be eaten and would be thrown away. The chickpeas, being legumes, stand out for their beneficial health components (fiber, vitamins, minerals, antioxidants, proteins, carbohydrates) and for not containing harmful ones (salt, saturated fats, and sugar). Furthermore, they are very economical. This recipe can be presented as a main dish because, by containing sardines and chickpeas, it is complete and balanced at a nutritional level. A good option is to accompany it with a salad or a variety of seasonal vegetables. The sardine is a fish that provides us with excellent quality proteins and fats. Try, as much as possible, to preferably use extra virgin olive oil.

title: Shortbread pastries
preparation: Place the first dough and spread the jam on it. Place the second dough on top, apply a thin layer of egg, and decorate with coconut and peanuts. Bake in a very hot oven (more or less).
notes: Eggs are an excellent and economical source of high-quality protein and vitamin A, essential for, for example, the correct development and functioning of vision. It is not necessary to wash eggs before using them, as doing so can make it easier to contaminate the food you are preparing or other foods present in the kitchen. There is no qualitative difference between white and brown eggs. The color of these depends exclusively on the breed of the hen. The quality of the egg lies in its size and the quality of life of the hen. Peanuts are a good source of energy, as they offer us very high-quality fats.

title: Yogurt sponge cake
preparation: Mix all the ingredients in a bowl, except for the beaten egg white which is added at the end. Place in the oven
notes: To increase the fiber content of the sponge cake, you can use whole wheat flour. Try, as much as possible, to preferably use extra virgin olive oil. Accompanying a piece of sponge cake with a piece of fresh fruit is a good option for a snack.

title: Chicken Tajín with Olives
preparation: Place the tajín over low heat with the oil. Add the chopped onion and garlic and let cook for 5 minutes. Add the chicken, seasonings, olives, and water. Cover and let cook for one hour. Serve in the tajín dish.
notes: Chicken, like rabbit and other poultry, provides us with high-quality protein and low fat. Remember that excessive animal fat can be harmful to our health. Try, as much as possible, to preferably use virgin olive oil.

title: Bread
preparation: Mix the warm water and the yeast. In a separate bowl, mix the flour, sugar, and salt; add the butter and the splash of oil. Knead and add the water with the yeast that we prepared earlier, until a smooth and homogeneous dough is formed. Knead for 10-15 minutes! Place the dough, greased with oil, in a baking dish that is also greased and cover it with a bowl (NOTE: the dough will double in size, so the bowl or container must be twice as large as the dough). Place it in the oven (without preheating and with a glass of water to prevent the bread from retaining too much humidity) at 180º-200º for 40' or until done!
notes: Bread is one of the protagonists of Mediterranean cuisine, along with olive oil. It is a good ally in accompanying main meals. To increase the fiber content, you can use whole wheat flour. Try, as much as possible, to preferably use extra virgin olive oil.

title: Meat Tajine with Apricots
preparation: Place the tajine over low heat with the oil. Add the chopped onion and garlic cloves and let cook for a while. Add half a liter of water and let cook until the meat is quite tender. Add the ginger and black pepper. Let cook for 30 minutes. Meanwhile, in a saucepan, boil the apricots for 10 minutes; then add the sugar and cinnamon and let cook for 5 more minutes. Serve in the tajine dish, adding the cooked apricots with the sugar and cinnamon to the meat.
notes: Apricots are a good source of fiber and minerals that provide this dish with a contrast of color and, above all, an exotic sweet and sour flavor. This recipe is ideal for making use of those apricots that, due to being too ripe, would not be eaten and would be thrown away. Try, as much as possible, to preferably use extra virgin olive oil.

title: Shami Kabab
preparation: Place the meat and chickpeas in a pot with two glasses of water and all the seasonings. Cover the pot and let it simmer until the water has evaporated. After that, mash everything together. Add the egg, chopped onion, and chopped green chili, and mix well. Form small patties with the mixture and fry them over low heat until golden brown. Serve on a large plate and eat with sauce.
notes: Due to its complete nutritional composition in terms of carbohydrates and proteins, this dish can be served as a main course. A very healthy option that will add color and freshness to the meal is to accompany it with a salad or assorted seasonal vegetables. Try, as much as possible, to preferably use extra virgin olive oil for frying. To reduce the oil content, wrap the patties in absorbent paper towels.

title: Arabic Chicken
preparation: One day before: wash the chicken with lemon and salt (30' in water) and rub it with a mixture of crushed garlic with cilantro and parsley. The next day: place the chicken in the pot along with finely sliced onion, salt, ginger, saffron, black pepper, and oil (you can also add garlic, cilantro, and parsley paste if necessary). Once it is cooking, add the liver in pieces (for the subsequent sauce). When the chicken is done, drain it and rub it with butter, milk, and red pepper, then put it in the oven (to brown). Presentation: Place the chicken on a platter and add the sauce (the cooking liquid, which is better if blended beforehand). Serve with pineapple or apricot (previously fried with sugar and cinnamon) or with potatoes.
notes: Chicken, like rabbit and other poultry, provides us with very high-quality protein and low fat. Remember that excess animal fat can be harmful to our health. The plums and pineapple provide the dish with an extra boost of fiber and a cheerful flavor contrast. This recipe is ideal for making use of those apricots, plums, or fresh pineapple that, due to being too ripe, would not be eaten and would be thrown away. Try, as much as possible, to preferably use extra virgin olive oil.

title: Red beans
preparation: Peel the garlic, tomatoes, ginger, and onion and cut everything into julienne. Place the pressure cooker over heat with three tablespoons of oil and add the garlic, tomatoes, onion, ginger, and turmeric and let them brown. Add the red beans, add one liter of water, and let cook for half an hour over high heat. Serve the beans on a large plate garnished with chopped cilantro.
notes: Red beans, being legumes, stand out for their health-beneficial components (fiber, vitamins, minerals, antioxidants, proteins, carbohydrates) and for not containing harmful ones (salt, saturated fats, and sugar). Additionally, they are very economical. It is a dish rich in fiber and antioxidants that, combined with a little potato or rice, can be served as a main course. It can also be accompanied by a varied seasonal salad. Try, as far as possible, to preferably use extra virgin olive oil.

title: Lentils

ingredients.name: chicken thigh (you can use whatever meat you prefer, chorizo, lamb, etc.)

preparation: Boil the chicken, 1 leek, and 1 carrot for 15 minutes. At the end, strain them. Finely chop the vegetables and sauté them in a pot. Shortly after, add the lentils and sauté for a little bit longer (about a minute). Add the broth and cook over low heat for approximately 40 minutes.
notes: Lentils, being legumes, offer us carbohydrates and high-quality proteins at a very good price, as well as fiber, vitamins, and minerals. You can substitute the meat with a little potato and you will have an equally complete dish! Zucchini is a mild vegetable, easy to digest and with a significant amount of fiber (if not peeled). The sofrito, very representative of Mediterranean cuisine, is an excellent source of antioxidants, essential for the correct functioning of our organism. Additionally, it is ideal for making use of those zucchinis and carrots that, due to their advanced state of ripeness, would not be eaten and would be thrown away.

title: Matar pulao
preparation: Place the rice in a bowl and wash it 2 or 3 times. Drain and leave the rice to soak with a glass of water. Heat the pressure cooker, add the ghee or oil, the whole spices, and mix well. Fry the mixture for a few moments. Add the peas, mix well, and fry for a few moments. Add the soaked rice, mix well, increase the heat, and fry the mixture for a few moments. Add a glass of water and the salt. When it begins to boil, cover the pressure cooker and cook for 6 minutes. Serve on a large plate or in a bowl.
notes: This dish, with aromas that provide its characteristic and fundamental flavor, can be served as a main course. The rice, which is a cereal, and the peas, which are a legume, together provide a good proportion of carbohydrates and proteins, in addition to fiber and minerals. You can increase the fiber content of this recipe by using brown rice. You can accompany this dish with a salad or varied seasonal vegetables.

title: Cookie pudding
preparation: Crush the cookies well. Pour the milk, eggs, and sugar, along with the cookies, and mix everything well. Place the ingredients in a mold and cook them using a bain-marie (water bath).
notes: Eggs are an excellent and affordable source of high-quality protein and vitamin A, which are essential for, for example, the correct development and functioning of vision. It is not necessary to wash eggs before using them, as doing so may make it easier to contaminate the food you are preparing or other foods present in the kitchen. There is no qualitative difference between white and brown eggs. Their color depends exclusively on the breed of the hen. The quality of the egg lies in its size and the quality of life of the hen. If we accompany this recipe with a piece of fresh fruit, it can be offered as a snack, as it is very complete.

title: Peppers with cheese
preparation: Peel the onion and cut it into julienne. Wash the tomatoes and cut them into julienne. Wash the peppers and dice them. In a pan, heat the oil and add the ginger, onion, and peeled and chopped garlic; then add the turmeric, chili, and salt. Cover the pan and let cook over low heat. Add the peppers. Shake the pan to prevent the food from burning. Let cook for 10 minutes. Add the cheese and cook for 2 minutes. Serve in a deep plate and garnish with chopped cilantro.
notes: The peppers and tomatoes give the dish a very bright color in addition to, along with the onion, flavor and a good amount of fiber, antioxidants and minerals. Try, as much as possible, to preferably use extra virgin olive oil.

title: Crema catalana
preparation: Boil the milk with the lemon peel and cinnamon for 1 hour. Mix the egg yolks with the sugar and cornstarch. Mix the yolks and the milk and stir over low heat until the paste thickens. Place the cream in small ramekins, sprinkle with sugar, and caramelize the sugar with a kitchen torch to create a crispy layer. Let it cool and serve in the ramekins.
notes: It is a very energetic dessert. To balance it, you can accompany it with some strawberries or orange slices to add freshness and color.

title: Yellow rice
preparation: Sauté the onion, bell pepper, and garlic. Once they are ready, remove them and fry the chicken in the same pan. Once the chicken is cooked, add the sautéed vegetables, the rice, and the food coloring. Gradually add the water and let it boil, stirring from time to time. When the liquid has been absorbed, remove from the heat and let it rest for 5 minutes (covered).
notes: The sofrito, very representative of Mediterranean cuisine, is an excellent source of antioxidants, which are essential for the proper functioning of our organism. Additionally, it is ideal for making use of bell peppers that, due to their advanced state of ripeness, would not be eaten and would be thrown away. This recipe can be served as a main course, as containing chicken and rice, it is complete and balanced nutritionally. A good option is to accompany it with a salad or varied seasonal vegetables. Try, as much as possible, to preferably use extra virgin olive oil.

title: Harira

ingredients.name: seasonings: salt, black pepper, ginger, cinnamon and parsley

preparation: Dice the tomatoes, onion, celery, and meat, place them in the pot, cover with water and bring to a boil. After 1 hour, add the chickpeas and lentils that have been previously soaked for 6 hours. After another hour, add the rice. Add the seasonings. Serve hot in a deep bowl.
notes: This dish is ideal to be served as a main course because, as it contains carbohydrates, proteins, and vegetables, it is very nutritionally complete. Lentils and chickpeas are an excellent and very affordable source of fiber and protein. Additionally, if you use brown rice, you will increase the amount of minerals and fiber. Try, as much as possible, to preferably use extra virgin olive oil.

title: Curry eggs

ingredients.name: oil, water, salt, garlic, ginger and nepalese spices

preparation: Boil the eggs and the potatoes for ten minutes and, once they are cold, peel them. Cut the tomato, the onion, and the potatoes into small pieces and fry the mixture in a pan for ten minutes adding water. Add the spices and place the eggs. Serve on a large plate.
notes: Eggs are an excellent and economical source of high-quality protein and vitamin A, which are essential for, for example, the correct development and functioning of vision. It is not necessary to wash eggs before using them, as doing so can make it easier to contaminate the food you are preparing or other foods present in the kitchen. There is no qualitative difference between white and brown eggs. The color of these depends exclusively on the breed of the hen. Egg quality lies in its size and the quality of life of the hen. Try, as much as possible, to preferably use olive oil for frying as well.

title: Meatballs
preparation: The Sauce: Place the onion, tomato, and spices to fry for about 20' over low heat. The Meatballs: On the kitchen counter, spread a little flour so the meat dough does not stick. Prepare by mixing (with your hands) the meat, egg, stale bread (grated/crushed), and a touch of pepper and salt. Once everything is mixed, make small balls which we fry and then mix with the sauce.
notes: The tomato and onion sofrito, very representative of Mediterranean cuisine, is an excellent source of antioxidants, essential for the correct functioning of our organism. Additionally, it is ideal for making use of those tomatoes that, due to their overly advanced state of ripeness, would not be eaten and would be thrown away. Try, as much as possible, to preferably use extra virgin olive oil.

title: Cheesecake
preparation: Crush the cookies and mix them with the melted butter. You must ensure the butter turns white (not yellow) to be able to homogenize the mixture. Spread it on the bottom of the mold (careful not to stick: use parchment paper or an anti-stick mold) and keep it in the refrigerator. In parallel, preheat the oven (180º). While the base cools, make the mixture. Put all the products in the blender and mix well. Tip: mix the liquid first and then add the solid. Once finished, pour the mixture over the cookie base that was in the refrigerator. Place the mold in the oven for 1 hour. Let it cool before removing from the mold!
notes: Eggs are an excellent and economical source of high-quality protein and vitamin A, which are essential for, for example, the correct development and functioning of vision. It is not necessary to wash eggs before using them, as doing so can make it easier for the food you are preparing or other foods present in the kitchen to become contaminated. There is no qualitative difference between white and brown eggs. The color of these depends exclusively on the breed of the hen. Egg quality resides in its size and the quality of life of the hen. Natural yogurts are one of the best sources of calcium, a mineral indispensable for the correct development and functioning of bones and muscles. For this reason, they are highly recommended at any age. Choose semi-skimmed or skimmed ones, because they have less fat and cholesterol and the same amount of protein and calcium as whole ones. To add a contrast of color and flavor to the dish, you can accompany the cake with some strawberries or pieces of peach or orange.

title: Biryani masala
preparation: Peel the onion, cut it into julienne strips, and cook it in a pot until golden. Add the chicken, the chopped tomatoes, and a small packet of masala. Cook for 10 minutes, then add the yogurt, saffron, and ginger and cook over low heat until the chicken is tender. Separately, boil the rice. Place a layer of rice and over it a portion of the chicken; then a second layer of rice and over it another portion of the chicken; finally, a third layer of rice and the rest of the chicken. Serve on a large platter.
notes: Due to its nutritional composition rich in carbohydrates and proteins, this dish can be served as a main course. It can also be accompanied by a varied seasonal salad. The tomato and onion provide color and flavor to the dish. Additionally, they provide a good amount of fiber, antioxidants, and minerals. To increase the amount of these, you can use brown rice. Try, as much as possible, to preferably use extra virgin olive oil.

title: Rice pudding
preparation: Put the milk, rice, and a cinnamon stick, half a vanilla bean, and add the lemon peel in a saucepan. Stir and let cook over low heat for about 40 minutes. Serve cold.
notes: If we accompany this dish with a piece of fresh fruit, it can be offered as a snack, as it is very complete. Milk is one of the main sources of calcium; for this reason, it is highly recommended at any age. Choose semi-skimmed or skimmed milk, because it has less fat and cholesterol and the same amount of protein and calcium as whole milk.

title: Meatballs
preparation: Cook the rice and the potatoes (in case you cannot find cooked beetroot, it should also be cooked). The most "laborious" part is the presentation. The rice salad is presented in layers. The charm of the dish is not only its nutritional value but also its presentation. Layered core: 1. rice (half of what was cooked), olives, mayonnaise, tuna, and surimi (all mixed homogeneously). 2. Russian salad, olives, mayonnaise, and tuna. 3. rice (the remaining part) and mayonnaise. You can add boiled egg (grated yolk) to this layer. Base and decoration: Make a bed of lettuce, place the "rice cake" in the center, and then assemble various skewers with whatever ingredients are available.
notes: This recipe, as it contains vegetables (beetroot, lettuce, onion, cucumber, Russian salad, and green beans), protein (tuna, eggs, surimi, and peas), and carbohydrates (rice, corn, potato, and peas), can be served as a main course, as it is already complete and balanced. It is not necessary to wash the eggs before using them, as doing so can facilitate the contamination of the food you are preparing or other foods present in the kitchen. Remember that you can increase the fiber content of this dish by using brown rice. You can substitute the mayonnaise with a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil. This way, you increase the quality of the fats in this dish.

title: Momo chicken
preparation: For the dough: mix the flour, salt, oil, and water in a bowl. Knead gently and let it rest for 30 minutes. For the filling: mix all the ingredients in a bowl. Roll out the dough using a rolling pin and cut small round portions of the dough. Place a small portion of the filling in the center of each dough portion. Then close the dough using a fork. Put water in the steamer, place the raw momos inside, and boil for 20 minutes. Serve on a large plate with sauce.
notes: Chicken, like rabbit and other poultry, provides us with very high-quality protein and low fat. Remember that excess animal fat can be harmful to our health. To increase the fiber content of this dish, you can use whole wheat flour. You can accompany this dish with some steamed vegetables! This will make it lighter and more visually appealing! Try, as much as possible, to preferably use extra virgin olive oil.

title: Fish with tapenade and ratatouille

ingredients.name: oil, e.g., olive oil or cold-pressed rapeseed oil

preparation: Cut the red onion into wedges and finely chop the garlic. Cut the bell pepper, eggplant, courgette, and carrots into cubes. Sauté the vegetables for a few minutes in oil. Add the peeled tomatoes and bouillon. Let it simmer over low heat for approx. 15 min. Season with 1 tsp. salt, pepper, sugar, and balsamic vinegar. Cook the pasta according to the instructions on the packaging, but without salt, as the rest of the dish provides the flavor. Check the fish for bones. Cut it into four equal pieces and place them on a baking sheet with parchment paper. Spread the olive tapenade over the four pieces. Bake the fish for 12-15 min. depending on the thickness of the fish in a preheated oven at 200 degrees on the middle rack.
notes: Saithe can be replaced with other cod species such as black cod, ling, or haddock.

title: Pasta with spinach, chickpeas and parsley pesto

ingredients.name: apple cider vinegar or lemon juice
oil e.g. olive oil or cold-pressed rapeseed oil

preparation: Chop the onion into small dice. Boil the onion in water with ½ tsp. salt for 3-4 min. Rinse the spinach thoroughly. Optionally, set aside a handful of leaves for garnish. Add the spinach to the pot with the onions along with the drained chickpeas. Boil the mixture for a couple of minutes until the spinach wilts. Drain in a sieve. Cook the pasta according to the package instructions, but without salt, as the rest of the dish provides the flavor. Drain it in a sieve. Rinse the parsley thoroughly, place it in a blender along with cubes of parmesan cheese, hazelnuts, garlic, vinegar, oil, 1 tsp. salt and pepper. Blend the pesto until smooth. Fold the pesto into the pasta and spinach mixture. Distribute halved cherry tomatoes over the top. Optionally garnish with fresh spinach leaves.

title: Marinated chicken in wok

ingredients.name: whole grain rice e.g. wild or brown rice, raw weight

preparation: Cook the rice according to the package instructions, but without salt, as the rest of the dish provides the flavor. Cut the chicken fillets into strips. Whisk the marinade together and toss the chicken strips in it. Let it marinate for 10 min. Cut the carrots into sticks. Clean the leek and cut it into 4-5 cm long thin strips. Cut the broccoli into small florets and cut the stem into sticks. Heat a wok or frying pan with the oil. Fry the chicken meat for approx. 5 min. First turn the meat only once it has formed a crust on one side. When the meat is golden on all sides, add carrots, leeks, and broccoli and fry for 3-4 min. Add water, soy sauce, lime juice, and sugar. Cook the dish through for 3-4 min while stirring. Check that the chicken meat is cooked through.
notes: Tip! Instead of carrots, leeks, and broccoli, you can use 800 g of frozen wok vegetables.

title: Meatballs with oven-baked potatoes and raw pickled cabbage

ingredients.name: fresh herbs e.g. lovage, parsley or basil, chopped
cold-pressed rapeseed oil/olive oil for frying
pointed cabbage, in thin strips without core
hazelnuts, roasted in a dry pan for approx. 3 minutes and chopped

preparation: Place the potatoes in a dish and bake them at 180 degrees in a preheated oven for approx. 20 minutes. Sprinkle lovage or other fresh herbs over the potatoes. Pour 1 tsp. cold-pressed rapeseed oil or olive oil over them before serving. Mix the minced meat with onion, oatmeal, eggs, licorice powder and finally skimmed milk or sparkling water, 1 tsp. salt and pepper. Mix it well together. If the mixture is too thin, add more oatmeal. Heat butter and cold-pressed rapeseed oil/olive oil in a pan. Form the mixture into approx. 16 meatballs using a tablespoon. Brown the meatballs for approx. 2 minutes on each side, approx. 4 minutes in total. Turn down to medium heat. Flip and fry the meatballs for approx. 4 minutes on each side, approx. 8 minutes in total, until they are cooked through. Place cabbage and asparagus in a dish. Squeeze the juice from the lemon over them. Chop or pluck thyme over, season with pepper, acacia honey and soy sauce. Mix everything together and finally top with the roasted hazelnuts.

title: Pasta with lentils and tomato-chili sauce

ingredients.name: oil, e.g., olive oil or cold-pressed rapeseed oil
garnish: possibly some leaves from celery

preparation:
Rinse the lentils and cook them according to the instructions on the packaging, but in unsalted water, as the rest of the dish provides the flavor. Drain them in a sieve.

Cut the onions into dice. Finely chop the carrots, celery, and garlic on a cutting board or in a food processor.

Heat the oil in a pot. Sauté the onion and vegetable mixture for 3-4 min. Add chili, peeled tomatoes, tomato paste, oregano, and bouillon. Let the dish simmer without a lid for approx. 15 min. Add the lentils and heat through briefly. Season with 1½ tsp salt and pepper.

Cook the pasta according to the instructions on the packaging, but without salt, as the rest of the dish provides the flavor. Drain it in a sieve. Toss it in the vegetable sauce.

Serve with parmesan.

title: Tortillas with beans and guacamole

ingredients.name: ripe tomatoes, preferably vine tomatoes or 1 can of peeled, chopped tomatoes
fresh jalapeno chili or 2 tsp pickled
romaine or 1/3 iceberg lettuce
ingredients.quantity: ½ or 1/3, approx. 100 g cleaned weight

preparation:
Chop the onions. Grate the carrots. Slice the celery. Dice the tomatoes. Sauté onions, carrots, and celery for a few minutes in oil. Add the beans and sauté them with the vegetables; they can be slightly mashed. Add tomatoes, water if needed, garlic, spice blend, 1 tsp salt, and pepper. Simmer everything together for 10 minutes under a lid. Stir a few times during the process.

Place the avocado flesh in a blender or food processor. Slice the spring onions. Add the spring onions, cleaned chili, tomato in small pieces, and pressed garlic. Mix everything together. Season with ½ tsp salt.

Warm the tortillas according to the instructions on the packaging. Spread a layer of guacamole on them. Distribute lettuce over the top and add the bean sauce. Roll them up. Serve with the remaining lettuce and lime wedges if desired.

title: Cauliflower Tart

ingredients.name: rye flour, graham flour, whole wheat flour or whole spelt flour

preparation: Mix flour, ¼ tsp salt, tahini and egg in a bowl. You can use a food processor if you prefer, as it is faster. Combine the dough with water. Roll out the dough with a rolling pin so that it fits a pan of approximately 24 cm in diameter. Place the dough in the pan. Pre-bake the crust for 10 min at 175 degrees on the middle oven rack. Cut the cauliflower into small florets and dice the stalk. Cut the onions into wedges. Boil the cauliflower and onions in unsalted water for 5 min and drain in a sieve. Stir eggs, skyr, milk, 1½ tsp salt, pepper, grated nutmeg and cheese together in a bowl. Fold in the cauliflower, onions and chopped parsley. Distribute the egg and vegetable mixture into the tart. Bake the tart for approx. 40 min at 175 degrees on the middle oven rack until it is golden and fully cooked. Serve the tart with carrot sticks.

title: Fish Fritters with Beans and Bell Peppers

ingredients.name: oil, or oil and butter
ingredients.quantity: 2 tbsp oil, or 1 tbsp oil and 15 g butter

ingredient_sections.section_name: Green Beans with Bell Peppers, Garlic and Parsley

preparation:
Peel the potatoes and cut them into slices. Toss them with oil and 1 tsp salt. Spread them on parchment paper on a baking sheet. Bake the potatoes for approx. 50 min at 200 degrees on the middle oven rack until they are golden and crispy.

Cut the fish into smaller cubes. Place the fish in a food processor. Mix the fish with 1½ tsp salt until smooth. Mash the boiled potatoes. Grate the carrot using a grater. Finely slice the spring onions. Add potatoes, carrot, spring onions, eggs, wheat flour, milk, and pepper. Mix again. Form the mixture into fritters. Fry them in oil or oil and butter in a pan until they are cooked through.

Trim the beans and boil them in lightly salted water for 5 min. Drain the beans in a sieve. Clean the bell peppers by removing stems and seeds and cut them into strips. Sauté the bell pepper strips in oil in a pan. Add garlic and beans and sauté briefly. Toss in parsley and season with ¼ tsp salt and pepper.

Stir the fromage frais and chives together and season with ½ tsp salt.

title: Carrot Buns

ingredients.name: white whole grain flour e.g. white wheat or durum flour

preparation: Stir the yeast into lukewarm water and add the grated carrots and the other ingredients. Add the rest of the flour. Knead the dough until it is smooth. Let the dough rise covered in a warm place for approx. 1 hour. Shape the dough into 15-20 buns. Let them proof again for approx. 15 min. Optionally brush with beaten egg and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Bake the buns for approx. 20-25 min in a preheated oven on the middle rack at 225 degrees.
notes: Can be long-proofed. Make the dough the day before – use only 10 g yeast. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and let the dough rise in the refrigerator until the next day. Optionally use cold water. Brush with water or a sour milk product instead of egg. The buns can be frozen. Shelf life approx. three months at minus 18 degrees.

title: Carrot Soup

ingredients.name: whole grain buns or bread with whole grain logo or keyhole mark

preparation: Slice the carrots and potatoes and chop the onions and garlic. Sauté them in oil in a pot. Add the remaining ingredients to the soup with the exception of the orange juice. Let the soup simmer for about 20 min. under a lid. Mix the soup smooth with an immersion blender or in a food processor. Season with ½ tsp. salt, pepper and orange juice. Serve the soup with yogurt, bacon and optional chopped parsley.
notes: Bacon can be replaced by 30 g roasted pumpkin seeds.

title: Pirog with falafel and kale-carrot salad

ingredients.name: whole wheat flour, e.g., white wheat or graham flour
oil, e.g., cold-pressed rapeseed oil or olive oil

preparation:
Dissolve the yeast in lukewarm water. Add the other ingredients. Knead the dough until it is smooth. Let the dough rise covered in a warm place for about 1 hour.

Chop the chickpeas in a food processor along with the lemon juice, garlic, and parsley. Season with ½ tsp salt and pepper.

Divide the dough into 8 balls. Roll them out into circles 1/2 cm thick. Place the filling in mounds in the middle of the dough pieces and sprinkle the grated cheese over it. Brush the edges of the dough pieces with the beaten egg. Fold the dough pieces into half-moons. Press the edges together with a fork or fingers. Place the pirogs on parchment paper on a baking sheet. Brush the pirogs with beaten egg and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Bake the pirogs in a preheated oven at 200 degrees for 20-25 min.

Remove the coarse stems from the kale and rinse the kale thoroughly. Let the kale drip in a sieve and chop it very finely, possibly in a food processor. Grate the carrots. Peel the orange and cut the orange flesh into small cubes. Mix the kale, carrots, and orange in a bowl. Stir the yogurt, oil, and orange juice together. Season with sugar, ½ tsp salt, and pepper. Fold the kale mixture and yogurt dressing together.

title: Pasta with pesto, beans and potatoes

ingredients.name: fresh basil or parsley, approx. 40 g cleaned weight
oil, e.g. olive oil or cold-pressed rapeseed oil
lemon juice or apple cider vinegar
whole grain pasta, e.g. spaghetti, raw weight
pointed cabbage, white cabbage or small savoy cabbage, approx. 300 g cleaned weight

preparation: Clip the basil off and rinse it. Place it in a food processor or blender together with freshly grated parmesan cheese, pressed garlic, pine nuts, salt and pepper. Mix it all together. Mix in the oil and lemon juice. Cook the pasta according to the instructions on the packaging but without salt, as the rest of the dish provides the flavor. Peel the potatoes and cut them into 1 cm cubes. String the beans, if you are using fresh ones. Finely shred the pointed cabbage. Dice the onions. First, boil the potatoes for 3-4 min. in unsalted water. Add the beans, pointed cabbage and onion and boil for an additional 5-6 min. If using frozen beans, boil for only 3-4 min. Drain in a sieve. Toss the pesto into the pasta, potatoes and vegetables. Season with 1 tsp. salt and pepper. Serve whole grain bread with the dish.

title: Chili sin carne

ingredients.name: whole grain rice, e.g. natural or brown rice, raw weight
celery stalks, ¼ celeriac or 2 parsley roots, approx. 200 g cleaned weight
kidney beans, approx. 450 g drained weight
ripe tomatoes or 1 can of peeled chopped tomatoes

preparation:
Cook the rice according to the instructions on the package, but without salt as the rest of the dish provides the flavor.

Chop the onions. Cut carrots and celery into small cubes. Sauté onion, carrots, and celery for a few minutes in oil in a pot. Add beans, bouillon, diced tomatoes, tomato paste, pressed garlic, spice blend, and pepper. Simmer everything together for 10 min under a lid. Stir a few times during the process. Season with 1 tsp salt.

Place the avocado flesh in a blender or food processor. Chop spring onions, cleaned chili, garlic, and tomato into smaller pieces and add them as well. Blend everything together. Season with ½ tsp salt.

Serve the stew with guacamole and cooked rice.

title: Potato and leek soup with red lentils

ingredients.name: celery root or hokkaido pumpkin, cleaned
ingredients.quantity: 1/4 celery root or 1 hokkaido pumpkin, 200 g

ingredients.name: apple cider vinegar or white wine vinegar
oil, e.g., olive oil or cold-pressed rapeseed oil
whole grain bread or bread with whole grain logo or keyhole mark

preparation: Peel the potatoes and cut them into slices. Peel the parsley roots and cut them into cubes. Clean the leeks and cut them into slices. Sauté the potatoes, parsley root, and leeks in oil in a pot. Add the vinegar and bring to a boil. Add bouillon, water, and red lentils. Boil together for approximately 20 min. Blend the soup smooth in a blender or food processor, or use an immersion blender. Add the milk and heat the soup while stirring. Season the soup with 1/2 tsp salt and pepper. Serve the soup drizzled with a mixture of parsley and olive oil and with bread.
notes: Instead of the dried red lentils, you can use 1 can of chickpeas. Place them in a sieve, rinse, and drain. Add the chickpeas to the soup along with the bouillon.

title: Tomato soup with potatoes and chickpeas

ingredients.name: Greek yogurt 0.2% or other fermented dairy product max. 0.7% fat

preparation: Chop the onions. Cut peeled potatoes into smaller pieces. Rinse the bell pepper and cut it into smaller pieces. Sauté onions, potatoes, and bell pepper in oil in a pot for 3-4 min. Add peeled tomatoes, finely chopped garlic, bouillon, and chickpeas. Boil the soup covered for approx. 20 min. Mix the soup smooth in a blender or food processor, or use an immersion blender. Season with ½ tsp. salt and pepper and bring the soup to a boil once more. Garnish with washed, drained, and chopped basil and yogurt when serving.
notes: Spread the pesto on the whole grain bread and eat it with the soup, or distribute the pesto in small dollops in the soup, as shown in the picture.

title: Grilled chicken breast with Hasselback potatoes
preparation:
Baked potatoes: Split the potatoes down the middle. Slice them crosswise 8-10 times and place them on a baking sheet with parchment paper. Spread the potatoes with dijon mustard and drizzle 2 tsp of cold-pressed rapeseed oil/olive oil over them. Chop the walnuts and sprinkle them over the potatoes. Bake them at 180 degrees for approx. 35 minutes.

Grilled chicken breast: Place the chicken breasts in an ovenproof dish and season with 1 tsp coarse salt and pepper, as well as 2 tbsp cane sugar. Place the dish in the oven at 180 degrees for approx. 25 minutes.

Waldorf salad: Mix grapes, celery, and apples. Mix mustard with skyr in a bowl and add a little lemon juice. Mix the dressing with the grapes, celery, and apples and season with 1 tsp coarse salt, pepper, and optionally more lemon. Fold in the walnuts at the end to provide crunch to the dish. Garnish with parsley if desired.

title: Burger with fish cakes

ingredients.name: whole grain burger buns approx. 100 g each
white cabbage, approx. 250 g cleaned weight
fromage frais 0.3% or other fermented milk product, max. 0.7% fat

preparation: Cut the fish into cubes and mince it in a food processor together with the salt. Add egg, wheat flour, milk and pepper and mix quickly. Transfer the mixture to a bowl. Finely slice the spring onions and cut the bell pepper into small cubes. Stir them into the mixture. Form the mixture into 8-12 fish cakes and fry them in oil. Check that they are cooked through. Mix all ingredients for the curry mayonnaise together. Slice the lettuce. Split the burger buns and spread them with the curry mayonnaise. Assemble the burgers with the sliced lettuce and fish cakes. Finely shred the white cabbage. Grate the carrots. Cut the bell pepper into small cubes. Mix the white cabbage, carrots and bell peppers. Stir the dressing ingredients together and fold it into the vegetables. Season with 1/2 tsp. salt and pepper. Serve the burger with a piece of fruit.
notes: The salad turns out best if it is allowed to marinate in the refrigerator for half an hour.

title: Loaf with legumes, potatoes and Thousand Island dressing

ingredients.name: fresh or dried thyme
ingredients.quantity: 1 tsp fresh or ½ tsp dried

ingredients.name: plain yogurt, or other dairy product with max 0.7% fat
pointed cabbage or 1/8 white cabbage, cleaned weight
ingredients.quantity: ¼ pointed cabbage or 1/8 white cabbage, approx. 200 g

preparation: Place all ingredients for the loaf in a food processor and mix until smooth. Put the mixture into a greased loaf pan. Place it in the oven at 180 degrees on the middle rack for 50-60 min. Scrub and rinse the potatoes well. Cut them in half. Place them in a bowl with oil, salt, and oregano. Toss well. Spread them on parchment paper on a tray next to the loaf and bake them in the oven together with the loaf; the time is the same. Stir all ingredients for the dressing together. Possibly season further with sugar and lemon juice. Mix the finely shredded pointed cabbage and grated carrot together. Cut the apples into cubes and toss them in. Chop the nuts and toast them in a dry pan. Sprinkle them over.
notes: If you do not have a food processor, you can chop the chickpeas with a knife. Grate the onion and carrots on a grater. Now stir all ingredients for the mixture well together in a bowl.

title: Meatballs with Creamed Spinach

ingredients.name: small carrots, 1 small parsley root or small parsnip, approx. 100 g cleaned weight
minced pork or a mixture of veal and pork, max. 10% fat
fresh spinach or 450 g whole from frozen

preparation: Boil the potatoes for approx. 18 minutes in unsalted water and drain them. Peel and grate the carrots for a salad. Grate the onion and carrots. Mix the meat with 1 tsp. salt, pepper, egg, carrot, and onion. Add the wheat flour. Then stir in the milk. Heat the oil in a pan. Form the mixture into approx. 12 meatballs using a tablespoon. Brown the meatballs for approx. 2 min. on each side, approx. 4 min. in total. Turn down to medium heat. Turn and fry the meatballs for approx. 4 min. on each side, approx. 8 min. in total, until they are thoroughly cooked. Pinch the spinach to remove coarse stems and rinse it thoroughly. Steam the spinach in 1 dl water until it collapses. Drain the spinach in a sieve. Chop the spinach coarsely on a cutting board. Dissolve the cornstarch in the milk and heat it up together with the oil. Stir constantly. Stir in the spinach. Bring to a short boil. Season with nutmeg, 1½ tsp. salt, and pepper.
notes: If you want a bit more salty flavor, you can add 1 tsp. coarse salt to the potato cooking water.

title: Baked egg cake with potatoes and broccoli
preparation: Slice the potatoes approximately ½ cm thick and boil them in unsalted water for 5 min. Dice the onions. Cut the broccoli into small florets and the stem into small dice. Boil the onions and broccoli together with the potatoes for an additional 4-5 min. Drain the potatoes, onions, and broccoli in a sieve. Whisk wheat flour, 2 tsp salt, pepper, milk, and oil together in a bowl. Add the eggs and cottage cheese and whisk the mixture lightly. Gently fold in the potatoes, onions, and broccoli. Pour the mixture into a greased ovenproof dish and bake the egg cake on the middle oven rack at 200 degrees for approx. 30-40 min until it is fully cooked. Serve tomatoes in wedges with the egg cake, which can optionally be garnished with parsley.
notes: You can add 1 dl of chopped parsley into the egg cake. The dish is suitable for a lunchbox the next day.

title: Salmon with fresh pointed cabbage salad

ingredients.name: crispy tart apple, e.g. red Granny Smith

preparation: Scrub the potatoes and cut them into wedges. Toss them in oil with 1 tsp of salt. Roast them on parchment paper in a preheated oven at 200 degrees for approx. 50 min. Place the salmon in an ovenproof dish and sprinkle with 1 tsp of salt and pepper. Bake the salmon in the oven for 12-15 min depending on how thick the salmon pieces are. Start with the dressing. Mix all the ingredients for the dressing together. Then cut the apples into cubes and toss them immediately in the dressing so they do not turn brown. Cut the pointed cabbage into fine strips and the cauliflower into very small florets. Chop the dill. Toss the two types of cabbage and dill in the dressing.

title: Chickpea patties with beetroot slaw

ingredients.name: fromage frais 0.3%, Greek yogurt 0.2% or other fermented dairy product max. 0.7% fat

preparation:
Mix the drained chickpeas in a food processor or blender. Add the other ingredients and mix well. Form 16-20 flat patties and fry them thoroughly in oil in a pan. Optionally, finish cooking the patties in the oven.

Coarsely grate the beetroot, celery, and apple and mix them together in a bowl. Mix the ingredients for the dressing and season with ½ tsp. salt. Toss the salad and dressing together.

Boil the potatoes for approx. 18 min. in unsalted water and drain them. Fold the pesto into the potatoes.
notes: The chickpea patties can be seasoned with 1 tsp. ground cumin and 2 tbsp. chopped parsley. They also taste good in pita bread together with salad, grated carrot and cucumber slices, a little feta cheese and a little olives. The slaw can be garnished with very finely chopped hazelnuts or parsley.

title: Coarse Whole Grain Pot Bread
preparation: Stir the yeast into the water and subsequently add the remaining ingredients. Mix the dough until all ingredients are combined, then cover the bowl with plastic wrap or a damp cloth and let it rise for 16-18 hours. Once the rising time is complete, turn the dough out onto a floured surface and fold it onto itself a few times. Place it back into the bowl and let it rise for an additional 2 hours in a warm place. Preheat the oven to 250°C and place a heavy-bottomed pot with a lid (approx. 26cm in diameter) inside. When the oven is hot and the dough has finished rising, carefully turn the dough into the pot, put the lid on, and place it back into the oven. Bake for the first 30 minutes with the lid on, and subsequently 15 minutes with the lid off. Let the bread cool for at least 1 hour after baking.

title: Salad with chicken, pointed cabbage, and watermelon

ingredients.name: pointed cabbage, white cabbage, or small savoy cabbage, cleaned weight
ingredients.quantity: ½ pointed cabbage, ¼ white cabbage or 1 small savoy cabbage, approx. 300 g

ingredients.name: salad lettuce in cubes, max. 5% fat
oil e.g. olive oil or cold-pressed rapeseed oil

preparation: Cut the meat into cubes approx. 2 x 2 cm and season with 1 tsp. salt and pepper. Heat the oil in a pan. Fry the meat for approx. 10 min. until it is golden and cooked through. Turn it around during frying. Remove the meat from the pan. Cut the melon into cubes. Remove the seeds. Finely shred the pointed cabbage. Place the pointed cabbage in a bowl and toss in ¼ tsp. salt, let the cabbage sit for 10 min. Add the melon, thawed peas, salad lettuce, and cranberries to the bowl with the pointed cabbage. Whisk the dressing together and toss it into the salad. Arrange the salad on a platter and place the chicken cubes on top.
notes: You can replace the watermelon with other types of melon e.g. cantaloupe. You can replace the chicken meat with 300 g of drained shrimp or 2 cans of drained tuna.

title: Pasta with broccoli and smoked salmon

ingredients.name: oil, e.g., olive oil or cold-pressed rapeseed oil
chopped almonds, optionally toasted in a dry pan

preparation:
Cook the pasta according to the instructions on the packaging, but without salt, as the rest of the dish provides the flavor. Cut the broccoli into smaller florets. Cut the stem into cubes. Clean the leeks and cut them into thin rings. Boil the broccoli and leeks together with the pasta for the last 4-5 minutes of the cooking time. Drain the pasta and vegetables in a sieve.

Place the pasta and vegetables in a dish and stir in the olive oil and lemon juice. Season with 1 tsp. salt and pepper. Cut the salmon into strips. Distribute the almonds and salmon over the pasta.

title: Vietnamese spring rolls
preparation: Cook the rice according to the manufacturer's specifications. Strain and cool under a stream of cold water. Set aside. Clean the fish if necessary, ensuring it is boneless. Season with salt and pepper and cook by steaming or in the microwave. Flake it with a fork and set aside. Chop the herbs. Set aside. Mix the rice with the honey, the fish, and the herbs and season with salt and pepper. Mix well and set aside. Hydrate the rice paper wrappers as explained on the package. Dry them and spread them out on a clean cloth. Arrange the mixture and the lettuce on the wrappers and roll them up. Serve.
notes: Can be accompanied with soy sauce or a vinaigrette.

title: Fruit skewers with mint fondue
preparation: Peel and cut the fruit into pieces of about 2 cm. Skewer them, alternating flavors and colors. Chop the mint and mix with the yogurt for the sauce. Dip the skewers in the yogurt to eat.
notes: Easy

title: Pineapple carpaccio
preparation: Spread the pineapple slices to cover the entire base of a plate. Season with the chopped strawberries and chopped mint. Drizzle with the beaten yogurt around the edges.
notes:
Group 5
Preparation: Easy

title: Chickpea and Pumpkin Vegetable Burger
preparation: Cut the pumpkin into small cubes and mince the garlic. Heat a pan with a little oil over high heat and sauté the pumpkin cubes until tender and caramelized. Season with salt and pepper and remove from the heat. Set the pan aside. Mix all the ingredients, seasoning to taste, and mash with a fork until you achieve a burger-like consistency and appearance. Divide the dough into 4 portions and shape them into burgers. Heat the reserved pan over medium heat with a little oil and sear the burgers on both sides. Serve.
notes: Can be served with a bit of romesco sauce and salad.

title: Cauliflower tabbouleh
preparation: Clean the cauliflower with plenty of water and dry it well. Grate it using a four-sided grater as if it were cheese. Place it in a microwave-safe container with two tablespoons of water and one tablespoon of extra virgin olive oil. Cook for three minutes at maximum power and let it cool in a colander to drain the water well. Dice the red bell pepper, green bell pepper, and cucumber into small pieces (paisana style). Cut some slices of green asparagus and set aside. Mix everything together in a bowl with the grated cauliflower. To finish the dish, add some cherry tomatoes cut in half and some sweet corn kernels (no added sugars). Make a vinaigrette with the juice of half a lemon, three tablespoons of extra virgin olive oil, and one tablespoon of vinegar. Dress and serve.
notes: Preparation: Easy

title: Curry cauliflower with almonds
preparation: Clean and cut the cauliflower into 2 pieces, roughly the size of a small plate. Trim and remove the thickest stems from the base, making sure it stays whole. Steam for 10 minutes (using a steamer or a saucepan with a colander and a lid). Drain and place the cauliflower on a plate. Salt it and dress it with oil in which we have mixed curry powder. Sprinkle toasted almond slices and some capers on top.
notes: Easy

title: Empedrat
preparation: Chop the vegetables to taste and mix them with the cooked beans. Incorporate the rest of the ingredients and dress with a bit of extra virgin olive oil and serve.
notes: Difficulty: Easy

title: Fish, potato and vegetable combo in the microwave
preparation: Wash the vegetables. Peel and cut the potatoes into thin slices. Do the same with the rest of the vegetables. Place the sliced potatoes at the bottom of a microwave-safe container. Place the zucchini, tomato, onion, and pepper on top. Add four tablespoons of water and four of olive oil. Cover the container and cook in the microwave at maximum power for six minutes. Check the potato's cooking by piercing it with a knife. Once this time has passed, open the container, add the hake fillet, and cook again with the container covered for approximately one more minute. Remove from the microwave and let rest for one more minute without uncovering. Decorate with pine nuts, parsley, paprika, and a drizzle of olive oil on top. Serve.
notes: Easy

title: Eggplant mini pizzas
preparation: Wash the eggplants and cut them into slices approximately two centimeters thick. Place them on a baking sheet with a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil and salt, and bake at 180 ºC for ten minutes. Top the eggplants with the desired vegetables* and bake again for another 10-12 minutes.
notes: Some examples: Eggplant and whole cherry tomato with cheese and a little olive puree. Thick slices of eggplant with tomato, sautéed asparagus, anchovies, and oregano. Eggplant cut in half with a tomato, onion, and fine herb fresh cheese sauté.

title: Melon tart
preparation: Cut the melon to use it as a tart base. Remove the segments from the mandarins and the grapefruit. Decorate the tart with the segments and pour the papaya puree on top as a sauce. You can use the citrus peels, previously boiled to remove bitterness, or grate fresh zest over the top.
notes: Easy

title: Meat and Pisto Lasagna
preparation: Using a peeler, make thin slices (lengthwise) of the zucchini and eggplant. Set aside. Heat a pan over medium heat. Open the jar of pisto and heat it in the pan until it boils. Add the ground beef to the pan. Season with salt and pepper and cook while mixing well. Preheat the oven to 180 ºC. In a baking dish, place a layer of filling at the base, followed by a layer of zucchini or eggplant slices. Continue alternating in this manner until finished with a layer of slices. Sprinkle the parmesan cheese on top and bake for 20 minutes. Remove from the oven and serve.
notes: Easy

title: Vegetable mosaic
preparation: Wash and slice the zucchini, eggplant, carrot, tomato, and leek; try to make sure the slices are the same size. Cook them on a griddle with extra virgin olive oil, season with salt and pepper, and arrange them in a mosaic pattern, alternating colors. Use the same griddle to add a little water to recover the juices from the roasting. Season with salt and pepper. Mix these juices with a little mayonnaise and drizzle over the vegetables.
notes: Easy

title: Rice soup with little vegetables
preparation: Cut the vegetables into very small pieces and bring them to a boil. When it begins to cook, add the rice (according to the manufacturer's instructions) and let everything cook together. At the time of serving, add a drizzle of olive oil on top (optional).
notes: Easy

title: Tender wheat salad with pesto and raw vegetables
preparation: Boil the tender wheat according to the package instructions (about 25 minutes in plenty of water). Drain and cool it. Wash the mushrooms, dry them, and cut them into thin slices. Clean the artichokes until you have the hearts and cut them into thin slices. Salt them. If there is a delay before eating, store the hearts and mushrooms with a little olive oil and lemon drizzled over them. For the pesto, grate the cheese and blend it with the rest of the ingredients. Season with salt and pepper. Mix the cleaned spinach with the wheat, artichokes, and mushrooms. Serve with the pesto on the side.
notes: Easy

title: Pescaíto frito (Fried Fish)
preparation: Clean the anchovies thoroughly, removing the heads. Salt them. Heat enough olive oil in a pan to fry the anchovies in two or three batches. Coat the anchovies in chickpea flour, covering them well and pressing lightly to create a perfect layer. Shake off the excess flour and set aside. Once the oil has reached a temperature of 180 ºC, add the anchovies one by one. They must have free space so they fry well and do not break; otherwise, they would absorb too much fat. Once the anchovies have reached a beautiful golden color (1-2 minutes), remove them from the oil with a slotted spoon or tongs and let them rest on paper towels. Serve immediately with the lemon cut into quarters.
notes: Tips to avoid excess fat: It is very important to keep the oil at 180 ºC to prevent the fish from being "boiled." If we add too many at once to the frying oil, it will cool down and the flour coating will break, allowing oil to seep in. Likewise, it is fundamental to leave enough space for the anchovies on the paper towel, without crowding them. This way we will achieve a less greasy and more crispy fish.

title: Colored tortillas (4 types)
preparation: For the green color: wash and blanch the spinach in boiling water for 10 seconds. Drain and cool in very cold water. Drain again, dry them very well and set aside. For the red color: wash and cut the red bell pepper into thin strips. Blanch in boiling water for 30 seconds. Drain and cool in very cold water. Drain again, dry it very well and set aside. For the orange color: wash, peel, and cut the pumpkin pulp into small cubes. Cook in boiling water for 5-10 minutes, until tender. For the violet color: remove and dry the cooked beet. Cut into small cubes and set aside. For the tortillas: blend 2 eggs for each tortilla in a beaker with an immersion blender, along with enough coloring to tint it. Add salt. Heat a small frying pan with a little olive oil and cook the tortillas on both sides. Serve.
notes: The tortillas can be served in two ways: Individually, along with their own vegetable as a side dish, seasoned with a little olive oil. Rainbow tortilla: cook the tortillas on only one side, leaving the top part juicy, and then stack the tortillas one on top of another, as if they were crepes, so that the cut looks like a rainbow.

title: Chicken breast with roasted vegetables
preparation: Clean, peel, and cut the vegetables: the zucchini, tomato, and carrots into thick slices, the onion into julienne, and the pumpkin into medium cubes. Preheat the oven to 180 ºC. Arrange the vegetables on a baking tray, mixed with a bit of oil, salt, and pepper. Bake for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, season the chicken breasts with salt and pepper and dress them with a bit of olive oil and the herbs. Cover the chicken breasts tightly with parchment paper or aluminum foil. Place the chicken breasts on top of the vegetables and bake for another 10-15 minutes, until everything is well cooked and tender. Remove from the oven and take the chicken breasts out of their wrapping, making use of the juices they have released.
notes: It can be eaten as is or chopped up and used as a filling for fajitas, empanadas, stews, etc.

title: Chopped vegetables and avocado
preparation: Mash an avocado with a few drops of lemon juice and salt using a fork. Wash and finely dice (brunoise) the spring onion, carrot, red bell pepper, and green bell pepper. Mix these vegetables with the avocado paste and season with a bit of salt, pepper, and extra virgin olive oil. Serve topped with small wedges of tomato, some basil leaves, and lemon zest.

title: Ricotta mille-feuille with fruit sauce
preparation: Cut the ricotta into rectangles. Wash and cut the fruit, creating layers by alternating the cheese and the different fruits. Pour the sauce on top and serve. Blend all the fruit with an electric blender to make the fruit sauce.
notes: Preparation: Easy

title: Zucchini cups with yogurt, broccoli, and cauliflower
preparation: Wash and cut the zucchini into cylinders of about 4 cm. Using a spoon, hollow out a bit of the interior. Cut the cauliflower and broccoli florets and wash them. Steam all the vegetables for about 10-12 minutes. Once this time has passed, let the vegetables cool slightly. Serve the filled zucchini cups with yogurt sauce (yogurt beaten with a few drops of lemon juice, salt, sweet paprika, and chopped mint leaves) and accompany with the broccoli and cauliflower. Drizzle a bit of olive oil over everything.

title: Lentil soup with mustard
preparation: Cook the peeled and finely chopped onion in a saucepan with the oil until it is soft. Add the finely chopped carrot and leek, and let them cook for about 5 minutes. Add the mustard and cook for 1 more minute. Pour in the lentils, 3/4 liter of the broth, and the bay leaf, and cook over low heat until the lentils are tender. If necessary, add broth or water. Adjust salt and pepper to taste.
notes: Legumes are foods with such a complete nutrient density that it is interesting to present them in different ways and combine them with a variety of foods. Lentils have a high content of fiber, protein, carbohydrates, phosphorus, calcium, magnesium, and iron. When it is hot, stews are not very appealing; they are more delicious served as a salad. The vegetables that accompany them soften the dish, make it more digestible, and provide more regulatory elements. The result is a very nutritious dish that pairs very well with a lighter second course, such as stuffed zucchini with a bit of fish, and fruit-based desserts, rich in vitamin C to increase the absorption of the plant iron abundant in lentils.

title: Empedrat with mushrooms and bonito belly
preparation: Blend half of the mushrooms with water until it becomes a smooth cream. Season with salt, pepper, and vinegar. Peel, remove the seeds, and cut the tomatoes into quarters. Finely chop the onion and boil and cut the eggs hard. Assemble the dish by harmoniously alternating the ingredients. Dress with the mushroom cream and extra virgin oil, and garnish with chives.
notes: Source: Department of Agriculture, Livestock, Fisheries and Food / Alícia Foundation

title: Beetroot gaspatxo
preparation: The same preparation can be made in two versions: one without garlic and onion, and another that incorporates these two ingredients. Clean and peel the carrots and beetroots, then cut them into large cubes. Cook them in boiling water over medium heat for about 15 minutes. Remove from heat, reserve the cooking water, and let the vegetables cool (to do this faster, they can be mixed with ice water). Store them in the refrigerator. Peel and cut the onions into strips, sauté them, and also store them in the refrigerator. Blend the carrot and beetroot with the cooking water (all very cold), add the oil, black pepper, and, if desired, a bit of salt. Depending on the texture, add more water or oil, and you will have the first version ready. Now, if you want the version with all the ingredients, incorporate the onion, raw garlic, and apple cider vinegar. Blend and serve.
notes: When the heat arrives before the tomatoes, this beetroot gaspatxo is a very good alternative. This preparation provides a good supply of vegetables, with all their nutrients of interest. You can add some fresh mint leaves, rosemary, or small croutons of toasted bread. Because it is a very light recipe, it can be accompanied by another more complete dish containing legumes, or pasta or rice with small portions of protein foods (meat, fish, or eggs), for example.

title: Cucumber and celery salad with dried cheese and Iberian ham shreds
preparation: Peel and slice the cucumber, and cut the celery into sticks. Prepare and garnish the dish with the cheese and ham shreds.
notes: A different kind of salad, very rich in fiber coming mainly from the celery. The dried cheese and Iberian ham shreds, besides adding a touch of color to the dish, combine very well with the flavors of the vegetables. The amount of ham and cheese is very small, which means the energy contribution of the dish is light, provided that not too much oil is used when dressing it.

title: Toast with escalivada

ingredients.name: onion sliced very thinly and roasted

preparation: First, prepare the vegetables to be roasted in the oven. Next, toast the large slice of country bread. Arrange the slice on a plate and top it with the roasted onion, pepper, and eggplant, which should be cooled and previously seasoned with olive oil, salt, and black pepper. Slice the olives. Place the anchovies on top of the vegetables and finish garnishing everything with the olive slices. Instead of anchovies, you can use tuna or even hard-boiled eggs sliced.
notes: The toast with escalivada and anchovies can be a balanced single-course meal. It consists of a bread base, i.e., carbohydrates, a good portion of roasted vegetables, and a small contribution of animal proteins from the anchovies. The amount of bread and oil for seasoning may vary depending on each person's needs. If you want a lower energy intake, you should use less bread and oil. It is a quick, very Mediterranean, and fresh preparation for summer, suitable both for people with diabetes (who will have to control the amount of bread according to their diet), as well as for people with high cholesterol or even for weight-loss diets (controlling the amount of bread and oil). If you have to control salt intake, do not add any and, furthermore, use a hard-boiled egg instead of canned fish, for example.

title: Red cabbage salad with pumpkin seeds and yogurt sauce
preparation: Clean the cabbage and cut it into fine shreds. Clean the celery and cut it into fine pieces. Prepare a dressing with the yogurt, lemon juice, pepper, chopped chives, oil and, if desired, a bit of salt. Dice the clean apple and mix all the ingredients with the dressing in a bowl.
notes: The cabbage family consists of vegetables that are of special interest due to their high contribution of nutrients such as vitamins, minerals, fiber, and antioxidant compounds. In this case, red cabbage is the base of this recipe, together with the apple and celery, resulting in a very original and colorful autumn-winter salad with an interesting blend of sweet and acidic flavors.

title: Hummus (chickpea pâté) with breadsticks
preparation: Blend the chickpeas in a blender until a smooth paste is obtained. Add the tahini, the peeled and chopped garlic cloves, lemon juice, cumin, olive oil, and season with salt and pepper to taste. Mix for 3 to 5 minutes until it reaches a smooth consistency. Serve with the breadsticks.
notes: Adapted from: Vegetarianismo

title: Purple lasagna

ingredients.name: ripe tomatoes (canned crushed tomatoes, if not tomato season)

preparation: Cook the pasta in plenty of boiling salted water. Once cooked, remove, drain, and spread out on a clean cloth. Chop the tomatoes into small pieces (or use crushed tomatoes) and cook them in a saucepan with 2 tablespoons of oil (and a little salt, if desired). After about 20 minutes, remove from heat and pass through a potato masher to obtain a smooth tomato sauce. In a pan, sauté the peeled and finely chopped onion with the oil for about 5 minutes. Add the clean, finely shredded cabbage and the peeled and minced garlic. Season with pepper, cumin, and nutmeg, and cook until the cabbage is soft, for about 15-20 minutes. Grease a baking dish with oil, place a base of pasta sheets, add a layer of the cabbage filling, and alternate layers until finishing with a layer of pasta. Cover everything with the tomato sauce and top with the grated cheese. Gratin in the oven until golden brown.
notes: This dish can become a very elegant first course. It provides a good portion of vegetables and the spices give it an interesting Mediterranean touch. If you want the dish to be vegan, you can substitute the grated cheese with breadcrumbs or chopped almonds. You can also use cheese and/or a good handful of chopped almonds for the gratin, thereby providing a protein value that will make the preparation not require a second course. It can be accompanied by a good salad and fresh fruit for dessert.

title: Brown rice with vegetables
preparation: Cook the rice with the water and a pinch of salt and, when it begins to boil, lower the heat to a minimum, cover, and let it cook for about 30-40 minutes (depending on the type of rice), until the water has been absorbed. Peel the artichokes by removing the outer leaves and trying to leave only the tenderest leaves. Cut off the stems and about 2-3 cm of the tips. Slice them into wedges and soak them in water and lemon juice. Clean the mushrooms and oyster mushrooms and cut them into quarters. Cook the cleaned and thinly sliced leek in a saucepan with oil for 5 minutes. Add the artichokes, mushrooms, oyster mushrooms, and minced garlic, and let cook covered for about 5 minutes. Add the peas to the saucepan and let everything cook for about 7 more minutes. Mix the rice with the vegetables and the chopped arugula. Adjust salt and pepper and cook for about 2 more minutes.
notes: Peas can be frozen. It can be accompanied by sesame or toasted seeds. Brown rice with vegetables provides a very important amount of fiber, as well as vitamins, minerals, and antioxidants, as all these compounds are found in greater quantities in whole grains than in refined ones. The richness in complex carbohydrates in the rice makes this dish quite energetic, although it contains practically no fats. This recipe can be considered either a main course, preceded by a salad with dried fruit, for example, or eaten as a first course and accompanied by a light main course (such as tofu sausages with salad).

title: Cauliflower, broccoli and almond cream
preparation: Cook the peeled and finely chopped onion in a saucepan with oil until it is soft. Add the cleaned cauliflower cut into small florets, along with the broth or water and, if desired, a bit of salt, and let it cook for about 20 minutes. Steam the broccoli cut into florets, cool it in cold water, and set aside. Make a paste with the garlic, almonds, and nutmeg, and add it to the saucepan after the 20 minutes have passed. Once the cauliflower is cooked, blend everything ensuring it stays a smooth cream. Serve the cream decorated with the broccoli and toasted almond slices.
notes: Cauliflower and broccoli are some of the typical vegetables of the cold season. They are especially nutritious, as they contain fiber, vitamins, and minerals (among which calcium stands out). Furthermore, they are rich in antioxidant substances, especially those rich in sulfur, which are responsible for the characteristic smell of cruciferous vegetables. The smooth texture of this cream and its exquisite flavor, also thanks to the toasted almonds, make this dish a good way to incorporate these vegetables into the diet.

title: Baked calçots

ingredients.name: black pepper and iodized salt (or romesco sauce or calçot sauce)

preparation: Trim the roots of the calçots. Remove the green stems and leave only the white part of the calçot (about 15-20 cm). Remove the first layer of the white part, which usually has dirt. Wash the calçots under the tap with plenty of water. Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Place the clean calçots in a baking tray with a drizzle of oil. Bake them for 10 minutes, turn them over, and let them cook for another 10 minutes, until they are golden, soft, and melty. Season them with a bit of black pepper, a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil and, if desired, a bit of salt. They can also be accompanied by a couple of tablespoons of romesco sauce or calçot sauce.
notes: The calçot is a variety of tender onion with a very mild flavor, ideal for all ages. Baked calçots can serve as a first course, alone or accompanied, for example, by roasted potatoes. They can also be used as a side dish: 4-5 calçots are a good portion to accompany a main course. Moreover, everything can be used! The greener leaves, well cleaned, can be added to soups and the tender green parts, sautéed, for omelets or scrambled eggs.

title: Peas with Roasted Garlic
preparation: Cut and grate the tomatoes. In a pan with oil, fry the garlic cloves until they are golden and roasted. Drain them and set them aside. Take advantage to fry the bread to make the picada (seasoning paste). In the same pan, if necessary, add a little more oil and make a sauce with the tomato. Season with salt. Add the wine and let it reduce. Once it is well candied, add the peas and stir everything together, add half a small glass of water, cover, and cook slowly until the peas are cooked. Just before, make a picada with the garlic, parsley, hazelnuts, bread, and a pinch of salt, and add it to the pan. Adjust the salt and pepper. It should be a slightly juicy stew.
notes: You can add one or two peeled potatoes, spring onion, or broth instead of water.

title: Escalivada and potato cake

ingredients.name: extra virgin olive oil and iodized salt

preparation: Boil the whole potatoes, with skin, in plenty of water and, if desired, a little salt. Once cooked, let them cool and peel them. Meanwhile, place the peppers, eggplants, and onions on a baking tray in the oven to roast (escalivar) at 200 °C for 45 minutes or 1 hour. After this time, let the cooked vegetables cool, then chop and mash the potato. Once the vegetables are cold, peel them and cut them into strips, reserving some to decorate the top of the cake. Mix the rest of the vegetables with the mashed potato, add the eggs, and blend everything with a blender until you obtain a very homogeneous mixture. If the mixture is too thick, add half a glass of milk. Prepare a rectangular baking dish, drizzle it with oil, and coat the entire surface. Next, arrange the previously reserved vegetable strips along with some anchovies, and then pour and spread the homogeneous mixture obtained from blending the potatoes, vegetables, and eggs over them. Place it in the oven at 150 °C, using a bain-marie (water bath) underneath, and let it bake for approximately one hour. To serve the cake, simply flip it over and slice it.
notes: This recipe provides a good amount of vegetables and starch, thanks to the potatoes. The eggs and anchovies guarantee the protein intake. Therefore, we can consider it a quite complete recipe. It can also be enriched with cheese or nuts to give it more texture and flavor. This preparation can be accompanied by a refreshing salad of ripe tomatoes, onion, and olives. For dessert, a pineapple granita with fresh mint leaves. In this way, a very balanced, refreshing, healthy, and seasonal menu is configured.

title: Chard salad with goat cheese, honey vinaigrette, walnuts and hazelnuts

ingredient_sections.section_name: Ingredients for two to three people

ingredients.name: cucumber (if not in season, radishes can be used)
cherry tomatoes (if not in season, carrot can be used)

preparation: Wash the chard and lettuce leaves well with water and drain them. Chop the larger leaves. Peel the onion and cut it into julienne. Wash the cucumber (or radishes) and slice it. Wash the tomatoes and cut them in half (or slice the carrot). Crumble the goat cheese. For the vinaigrette: toast the hazelnuts and walnuts in the oven at 180 °C for 10 min. Let them cool. You can also buy roasted hazelnuts. In a bowl, combine the extra virgin olive oil, sherry vinegar, and honey. Whisk the ingredients until an emulsion is achieved. Add the walnuts and hazelnuts (you can crush them slightly), season with salt and pepper, and mix well. Toss the chard with the lettuce and the rest of the vegetables. Distribute into 2-3 plates and top with the raisins, cucumber (or radishes), tomato (or carrot), onion, and pieces of goat cheese. Finish by dressing with the nut and honey vinaigrette.
notes: This chard salad is an original recipe, as chard is usually eaten cooked. However, like many tender green leafy vegetables, it can also be consumed fresh and raw, providing a good supply of minerals, vitamins, and health-protecting substances. The salad can be an appetizer, which should be complemented with a first and/or second course that provides starches (bread, pasta, rice, potato, etc.) or legumes. The protein contribution is guaranteed by the cheese and the nuts.

title: Escalivada with hard-boiled egg
preparation: Boil the eggs for 6 minutes from the moment the water starts boiling. Cool and peel them. Peel the tomatoes, peppers, eggplants, and garlic. Cut the vegetables into strips and mince the garlic. Season with plenty of oil and pepper and, if desired, a little salt and the minced garlic. Let it macerate for a while. Divide the preparation into four plates, with the sliced eggs on top. Serve and present the dish.
notes: This recipe offers an interesting contribution of summer seasonal vegetables, complemented by the eggs. The dish can be served as a refreshing first course, which can be followed by a second course containing starches, such as pasta, rice, potato, or legumes, or by also adding roasted potatoes, making for a good single-course meal. For dessert, very refreshing fresh fruit is suggested: cubes of watermelon and melon.

title: Olive pâté
preparation: Remove the pits from the olives and grind them. Add olive oil until a pâté consistency is obtained and mix with the oregano. Let rest overnight.

title: Spinach Meatballs

ingredients.name: pine nuts (toasted almonds can also be used)

preparation: Clean the spinach and cut off the stems. Cook the spinach in boiling water for 2 to 3 minutes if fresh, or until the blocks have broken down if frozen. Drain and set aside; once cooled, drain them further by hand, making sure to remove all excess water. Heat the olive oil in a pan and add the finely chopped garlic and pine nuts. When they begin to brown, add the spinach, pepper and, if desired, a little salt. Let it sauté for about 2 minutes and set aside until cooled. Mix the spinach well with the beaten eggs and crumbled cheese, then add breadcrumbs until everything is well combined. Form the meatballs and coat them in flour. Fry them in a pan with plenty of hot oil. Once browned, drain them on a wire rack so the excess oil can drip off.
notes: Suggestion: They can be accompanied by a béchamel sauce. Dietary comment: Due to their presentation, spinach meatballs are an alternative to a dish as typical as meat meatballs. Among their ingredients, besides the spinach, there are eggs and cheese, so they can be served as a main course. It is recommended to complete the meal with a starter or a side dish that provides more vegetables, as well as carbohydrates (pasta, potato, rice, millet, etc.).

title: Cherry tomato skewers, cheese, olives, dates...

ingredients.name: cheese (e.g., fresh mozzarella or fresh cheese like Burgos)

preparation: Cut the cheese into cubes approximately the same size as the cherry tomatoes. Alternate the cheese on the skewer with the tomatoes and olives. Season with a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil and serve.

title: Warm white bean salad
preparation: Clean the peppers and coat them with oil. Place them in the oven with the grill turned on and as close as possible so that the skins char without the peppers getting mushy. Once charred, place them in a covered container for an hour. When they are cold, peel them and remove the seeds to cut them into pieces. Prepare the dressing by mixing, in a small bowl, the pepper, vinegar, oil and, if desired, a little salt. In a saucepan, sauté the peeled and finely chopped onion with oil for 3-4 minutes. Add the peeled and chopped garlic, the diced fennel, the rosemary and the bay leaf, and cook for 5 more minutes, stirring occasionally. Incorporate the beans and cook for another 2 minutes. Remove from heat and let it cool for a few minutes. In a bowl, mix the beans, the peppers, the grated lemon zest, the chopped parsley and the dressing. Adjust the pepper and, if desired, the salt, and serve warm.
notes: Legumes are a very nutritious, economical food with great versatility in the kitchen. This recipe combines white beans with vegetables in the form of a warm salad, a healthy, original proposal and ideal for late summer. It can be a single dish that can be completed with seasonal fresh fruit desserts.

title: Tagliatelle with Asparagus and Mushrooms

ingredients.name: assorted mushrooms (fresh, depending on the season; otherwise, canned or dried)

preparation: Clean and chop the mushrooms and asparagus into similar-sized pieces. Heat the oil in a pan and add the peeled and crushed garlic cloves. Let them brown over low heat and then remove them. Add the asparagus and mushrooms to the pan and season with black pepper, a few drops of lemon juice and, if desired, a bit of salt. Stir well and add a couple of tablespoons of water. Cover everything and let it cook over low heat for about fifteen minutes.
