preparation: Take a bowl, add the 4 eggs and whisk them, then add the chopped vegetables and mix well. Add the lentils, oregano, pepper, and salt. Place a frying pan with extra virgin olive oil and pour in the entire bowl to make the omelet to your liking. Serve.
notes: Nickname: Papallona

title: Chickpeas with spinach
preparation: Boil the spinach for 5 minutes and let them drain. Also boil the eggs. In a frying pan, place the sliced garlic with olive oil and let them fry until golden, then add the spinach. Set this aside. In the same pan, add the pine nuts and raisins with a little oil and sauté them. Add the chickpeas and the spinach and mix everything. Cut the hard-boiled eggs in half and place them on top of the dish. Serve.
notes: Pseudonym: Farcellet

title: KEVAL LENTILS
preparation: Peel the onion and chop it very finely, as well as the garlic and the ginger. Place a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil in a pot and sauté the onion, garlic, ginger, and crushed cayenne pepper for 3 minutes. Meanwhile, place the natural tomato in a pan to let the water evaporate, along with the coconut milk. Add the turmeric, cumin, curry, tomato, and coconut milk from the other pan into the vegetable pot, along with a bit of brown sugar and salt, and let it cook for about 2 minutes. Serve.
notes: Pseudonym: Dragoneta

title: Lentils with vegetables
preparation: Put the lentils in a pot, together with the two crushed tomatoes. Add chopped parsley and the chosen spices. Add the previously cleaned vegetables to the pot with olive oil and a bit of salt. Let it cook with water for about 30 minutes over low heat. Serve.
notes: Pseudonym: Cati

title: KARAN
preparation: Take a bowl. Put the chickpea flour, water, egg, a tablespoon of olive oil, a pinch of salt and the yeast all together and emulsify if necessary with a mixer. Pour everything into a mold and bake in the oven at 200ºC for one hour. Serve.
notes: Pseudonym: Anna

title: Lentil medallions with sweet potato chips
preparation: Take a pot and cook the lentils. Chop the tomato and the onion and put them in a pan to sauté with the extra virgin olive oil. Drain the lentils once cooked and mix them with the sauté from the pan and the eggs, stirring until a homogeneous dough is achieved. Form lentil balls and pass them through the pan. Take the sweet potato and slice it very thinly to put it in the oven with pepper and salt. Serve the lentil balls and place the sweet potato chips on a plate.
notes: Pseudonym: Lucky cat

title: Lentils with chorizo

ingredients.name: spices and extra virgin olive oil

preparation: Sauté the chopped onion in a pot with extra virgin olive oil until it turns golden. Add the crushed garlic and cook for 5 more minutes. Add the crushed tomato, the bay leaf, salt, and pepper, and continue cooking until the water from the tomato has evaporated (approximately 15 minutes). Add the chorizo cut into chunks and sauté for another moment. Pour in the lentils with the broth and cook for about 5-10 more minutes. Serve.
notes: Pseudonym: Maria Angel

title: SOYBEANS WITH CLAMS
preparation: Cut the leek and zucchini into small pieces and place them in a pot to boil with the bay leaf and salt. In a saucepan, cook the clams, adding the white wine, chopped parsley, and garlic. Take the vegetable broth and a bit of the clam liquid and blend everything together with the soybeans (for a creamy texture) and the clams. Serve with a bit of chopped parsley.
notes: Pseudonym: Marasa

title: Spinach and bean omelet
preparation: Blanch the spinach. Take a frying pan, add extra virgin olive oil and add the sliced garlic, letting it take on a golden color. Add the spinach, add the beans, and let everything cook for a few minutes so it gains body and flavor. Beat the eggs, take the ingredients from the pan and mix them with the beaten eggs. Take the pan, add a little olive oil, pour everything in, and cook the omelet to the consumer's liking.
notes: Pseudonym: Cuinetes

title: CHICKPEA HUMMUS
preparation: Place the chickpeas, water, lemon juice, tahini, oil, and garlic (optional), all together in a bowl and blend everything until the texture is homogeneous. Pour into a small bowl, add a small drizzle of olive oil and the sweet paprika on top. Serve with breadsticks, whole wheat bread, cereal crackers, etc.
notes: Pseudonym: La Sopa

title: Chickpeas with vegetables and coconut milk
preparation: Wash and chop all the vegetables. Cook the vegetables with extra virgin olive oil. Sauté the cooked chickpeas with the vegetables. Add coconut milk to the preparation. Add the turmeric, spices and salt to taste.

title: Lentil and Eggplant Meatballs

ingredients.name: pepper and La Vera red pepper

preparation: Wash and cut the vegetables, except for the eggplant. In a pan, add the oil and sauté the onion until golden. Add the rest of the vegetables and cook for about 10 minutes, add the salt and set aside. Wash and dice the eggplant and cook it steamed in the microwave for 6-7 minutes. Mix the eggplant with the lentils, add the oats, salt, and spices, and blend with a blender or fork. Form the meatballs with the dough and coat them in flour. Pass them through the pan with the hot oil so they become golden. Add to the sautéed vegetables and serve hot.

title: Catalan Chickpeas
preparation: Cook the previously soaked chickpeas. Also cook the eggs. Wash the raisins and leave them to soak for 30 minutes. In a saucepan, place the cooked and drained chickpeas along with the peeled and sliced eggs. Also add the soaked and drained raisins, all together. Prepare a sofrito with onion (chopped) and olive oil, and when it begins to take color, add a tablespoon of flour, stirring until it gains body and color. Next, add the broth, tomato paste, chopped parsley, and almonds. Let it cook for about 10 minutes. Add the chickpeas and the rest of the ingredients all together and mix well until well integrated. Serve.
notes: Pseudonym: Gladieitor

title: Stewed lentils
preparation: Soak the lentils for at least 3 hours before preparation. Clean them and place them in a colander. Place the lentils in a saucepan with the red bell pepper, green bell pepper, carrot, onion, olive oil, salt, sweet paprika, the bouillon cube, the chorizo, the ham, and the water. Let it cook over low heat for 45 minutes. Serve.
notes: Pseudonym: Lady

title: Chickpea stew with cod
preparation: Sauté the cod cut into cubes. Remove it and keep it in a dish. Using the same oil, sauté the tomatoes, onion, and garlic (all finely chopped). Add the chickpeas and keep stirring. Add the vegetable broth and continue stirring, letting it cook for a few minutes over low heat. Add the cod that we had removed and the eggs cut into small squares, and finish cooking for a few minutes until it gains body and flavor. Remove and plate.
notes: Nickname: Mangela

title: Broad beans Catalan style
preparation: In a casserole with the extra virgin olive oil, add the ribs and the sausage and fry them. Once cooked, remove them and set them aside. Using the same casserole to make the sofrito, add the onion until it turns golden, then add the broad beans and the minced garlic. Stir well and add the meat back in, season with pepper and pour in the white wine. Let it simmer for 35-40 minutes over low heat. When 5 minutes are left, add the mint. Serve.
notes: Pseudonym: Cuinetes

title: White beans with roasted vegetables

ingredients.name: vegetables chosen according to taste (eggplant, carrot, zucchini, onion...)

preparation: Preheat the oven to 200ºC. Wash the vegetables you wish to include, chop them into small pieces, mix them together, and add salt, oil, and spices. Let them bake for a while, then add the pine nuts and the white beans and wait about 5 minutes more in the oven. Serve.
notes: Pseudonym: Entre Boires

title: Lentils with tomato
preparation: Clean the leek and the tomatoes and sauté them with a tablespoon of extra virgin olive oil. Add the garlic, lemon, and thyme, and subsequently the lentils with 1 cup of water, and let cook for about 30 minutes. When they are done, add a bit of pepper. Serve.
notes: Nickname: Mites

title: LENTIL AND BROWN RICE LASAGNA
preparation: Make a sauté with all the finely chopped vegetables. Boil the lentils and the brown rice with a bay leaf and salt; once cooked and drained, mix them with the sautéed vegetables. Next, boil the pasta sheets in water with a little salt. Once ready, assemble the pasta sheets with the lentil, vegetable, and rice filling (previously emulsified). Make the béchamel with the flour, oil, beer, nutmeg, and salt. Cover the lasagna with the béchamel and cheese and gratin in the oven. Serve.
notes: Pseudonym: Manuelita

title: VEGETABLE AND PULSE WRAP
preparation: Boil the vegetables, drain them, and fry them in a pan with the chickpeas, chopped garlic, and extra virgin olive oil. Once they are fried to perfection, mash them and make two omelets using two eggs. Place them in a baking dish and pour the béchamel over them along with the grated cheese. To make the béchamel: place the butter in a pan and add the flour, stirring until homogeneous, then add the milk little by little and the nutmeg and salt until a dense and compact texture is achieved. Bake in the oven until golden, and serve.
notes: Pseudonym: Mr. Bean

title: Cod with chickpeas, artichokes and white sauce
preparation: Sauté the onion and garlic (previously chopped and without the garlic core), letting them pick up flavor and color. Add the heavy cream or milk and emulsify. Boil the artichokes in a separate pot. Place the cod and fry it (previously desalted). Once fried, remove and let it absorb the oil with paper towels. Combine the cod with the rest of the ingredients we prepared previously, the chickpeas, emulsify well and decorate on top with the sliced hard-boiled eggs. Serve.
notes: Pseudonym: Ricardita

title: Lentil base pizza

ingredients.name: red pepper, green pepper, onion, mushrooms and pumpkin

preparation: Preheat the oven with top and bottom heat at 200°C. Drain the cooked lentils, put them in a blender jar, and add the two eggs. Blend until a smooth paste remains. Place baking paper on a baking tray and add the lentil paste, shaping it into a round shape which will be the base of our pizza. Bake for 20 min, and after this time, we fill it: add a base of tomato sauce, then add the vegan cheese, the vegetables, and finish decorating with some sliced black olives. Bake again for 15 min at 200°C, with top and bottom heat. Now all that's left is to enjoy this delicious pizza.
notes: Pseudonym: Lisbet

title: CoDiNuCat - Legume Recipes
preparation: Prepare the legumes by soaking them, cooking them, and then setting them aside. Make a sauté of tomato, onion, and chicken strips over low heat and add the red pepper. Mix it cold with the chopped endives, also cutting the olives and tuna and continuing to mix. Take the avocado and mash it with extra virgin olive oil to make a vinaigrette. Place the legumes and the rest of the ingredients in a bowl until everything is well combined, then add the avocado sauce. Serve.
notes: Pseudonym: Bob esponja targanina

title: Legume and bean burger

ingredients.name: crushed hazelnuts or sesame or walnuts

preparation: Chop the onion, pepper and mushrooms, sauté them with a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil and salt over low heat for 15 minutes. Once the beans are drained, mix everything with the garlic powder, oregano and pepper. Puree everything with the corn flour until a homogeneous and consistent texture is achieved. Let rest for 30 minutes in the refrigerator. Form the patties, flatten them with your hands and coat them with breadcrumbs. Fry in a pan, both sides. Serve.
notes: Pseudonym: Harry Potter

title: CREAMY TOMATO AND RED LENTIL SOUP
preparation: Roast the tomatoes whole and skinless in the oven. Add salt and extra virgin olive oil and heat in the oven at 180ºC for about 40' until they are tender. Place the vegetable broth, water, lentils, and roasted tomatoes in a pot and cook over low heat. About 15' later, the lentils will be tender. Blend with a sprig of rosemary. Add broth if a more liquid consistency is desired. Serve.

title: CAULIFLOWER RICE WITH AZUKI BEANS
preparation: First, soak the azuki beans overnight so they can be boiled the next day (you can also substitute them with already cooked chickpeas or red kidney beans). Crumble the cauliflower into very small pieces. Once everything is prepared, proceed to sauté the vegetables (onion, carrot, and zucchini). When they are golden, add the cauliflower, sauté it briefly together with the rest of the vegetables, and add water or vegetable broth; let it simmer for 5-10 minutes. Add the soy sauce and turmeric, let it cook for a few more minutes, and finally, add the azuki beans. In 5-10 minutes, your dish will be ready.

title: Green bean empedrat with bonito tuna belly
preparation: Puree half of the green beans with water until a homogeneous texture is achieved. Season with salt, pepper, and tomato. Peel the tomatoes, remove the seeds, and cut them into quarters. Boil the onion and the hard-boiled eggs and then chop them. Assemble the dish harmoniously with the green bean ingredients, tuna, onion, black olive puree, and eggs. Pour the green bean sauce with extra virgin olive oil over the top. Add the chives on top and serve.
notes: Pseudonym: La Domarica

title: Lentils with chorizo
preparation: Place the lentils with water and wash them well. Cut the small garlic cloves. Take the onion and the carrot and chop them into small cubes. Place in a pot, a bit of olive oil and add the garlic cloves so they turn golden. Add the onion and the carrot and about 10 minutes later add the chorizo, about 5 minutes later add the potato cut and peeled into small squares. Add the red sweet pepper with the lentils and the water and let cook for about 40 minutes. Serve.
notes: Pseudonym: Mandy

title: Escudella barrejada

ingredients.name: broth of: chicken, knee bones, beef bones, potato, carrot, celery, turnip, pumpkin and leek

preparation: Wash all the vegetables along with the bones and meat and bring to a boil for at least two hours. Boil the green beans and chickpeas if bought raw, or rinse them in water if bought already cooked. Once the broth is ready, strain it and place it on the heat with the vermicelli and legumes. Let it cook on the heat with the strained broth for about 10 minutes until the vermicelli is cooked. Serve.
notes: Nickname: Masterchef

title: STEWED HARICOTS
preparation: Soak the haricot beans for 12 hours. Boil them with water and salt for about 2 hours and check that they are cooked. Cut the meat into cubes, season with salt and pepper, and place it in the casserole with a drizzle of oil. Once the meats are browned, remove them and in the same casserole, place the finely chopped vegetables and the whole head of garlic; cook them over low heat while stirring. When the vegetables are cooked, add the meat, the beans, and a splash of white wine to the casserole. Let the alcohol evaporate and add the vegetable broth, let everything cook together for 10-15 minutes. Serve and enjoy. Enjoy your meal!
notes: Pseudonym: Els Peres de la terrissa

title: Chickpea crepes with chocolate
preparation: Mix all the ingredients using a mixer or an immersion blender. Next, melt a cube of butter in a pan and, when it is hot, pour in a ladle of the batter we have made. When it is cooked on one side, flip it and let it cook on the other side. Once cooked, it can be filled with whatever you like (both sweet and savory) and once filled, fold it in half twice to obtain a triangular shape. Enjoy.
notes: Pseudonym: Doctor Pèsol

title: Lentil croquettes
preparation: Mash the lentils and mix them with the olives and soy sauce to taste. Add flour to the dough until a consistent texture is obtained. Shape the croquettes. Coat them with breadcrumbs and fry them in hot olive oil. Serve.
notes: Pseudonym: Berta

title: WHITE NIU OF AZUKI AND SOY
preparation: Boil the noodles for about 8 minutes. Cut two slices of pineapple into cubes and place them in a bowl, adding the soy, a tablespoon of apple cider vinegar, the honey, and the two peeled garlic cloves. Mix everything and let it marinate for about 30 minutes. In a frying pan, place the tuna salad and sauté it. Drain the ingredients from the bowl and add them to the ingredients in the pan: lentils, tuna salad, azuki beans, and extra virgin olive oil. Drain the noodles and let them cool. A few minutes later, take all the ingredients and mix everything until well emulsified and well integrated. Serve.
notes: Pseudonym: L’encanta ocells

title: Flavored Marinade
preparation: Sauté the leek together with the prawns. Fry the chopped cuttlefish with extra virgin olive oil. Boil the mussels. Add the chickpeas and let it cook for a while so it gains body and flavor. Serve.
notes: Pseudonym: Marieta

title: Chickpea salad
preparation: Slice and finely chop the vegetables and place them in a bowl. Add the chickpeas, mix well and dress to taste or with a vinaigrette to taste. Serve.
notes: Pseudonym: ECF

title: Lentil pâté with walnuts
preparation: Peel and chop the garlic. Blend the lentils, walnuts, garlic, lemons, cumin, and black pepper with the extra virgin olive oil until they reach the desired texture. If needed to emulsify well, add water and lemon juice. Serve.
notes: Pseudonym: Gat cati

title: Chickpeas with Clams
preparation: Place a paella pan to make the sofrito with the onion, garlic, and green pepper with extra virgin olive oil, all finely chopped, over low heat for 10 minutes. When everything has a golden color, add the cooked chickpeas with a little broth (from the chickpeas themselves) and add the clams, a little pepper, and let cook for a few minutes (10'). Serve and enjoy.
notes: Pseudonym: Josefinaso

title: Lentils with pork ribs

ingredients.name: red pepper cut into small pieces
green pepper cut into small pieces

preparation: Place the ribs in a paella pan or casserole dish with a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil. Let them acquire a golden color and then remove them. Place the chopped vegetables in the same pan with the flavor from the ribs and let them cook for about 5 minutes, then add the bay leaf and white wine and let cook for another 5 minutes. Add the ribs that were removed and also the lentils, add water until the pan or casserole is covered and let it cook for 35-40 minutes. Serve.
notes: Nickname: Titi

title: COET OMELETTE

ingredients.name: tomato salad with salt and oil
toasted bread with oil and salt

preparation: In a frying pan, add extra virgin olive oil and add the onion and crumble it. In a bowl, take the lettuce and crumble it with the beaten egg whites, the grated cheese, and the crushed green beans with a pinch of salt. Mix everything with the onion as it gains consistency and flavor, forming an omelet but occupying only half of the pan. Add the beaten egg yolks to the side, occupying the rest of the pan, wait a few seconds, and then fold everything together like an omelet. Serve on a plate and add some honey drizzles on top, with the tomato salad on the side.
notes: Pseudonym: Elvis

title: Chickpeas with goat cheese and peppers
preparation: Soak the chickpeas. Clean and chop the peppers, onion, and garlic. Add a pan with extra virgin olive oil and cook the vegetables. In another pan, add the chickpeas (already cooked) and the goat cheese. Mix everything together until it gains body and texture, letting it cook for 5' over high heat. Serve.
notes: Pseudonym: Mister Patata

title: Minorcan chickpeas
preparation: In a bowl, mix the chickpeas, soy sprouts, and pomegranate seeds. Season with fresh lemon juice, extra virgin olive oil, and flaky salt. Serve on a plate with some lemon zest on top.
notes: Pseudonym: Rael

title: Hummus with Thermomix
preparation: Place all the ingredients in the Thermomix (except for the oil and water), using the 5-7-9 program for about 2 minutes, then open and add a bit of broth and oil to give it texture and homogeneity. Pour into a bowl, topped with a bit of paprika. Sprinkle with a bit of salt and sesame seeds. Serve accompanied by toast or any kind of bread.
notes: Keep the cooking water. Pseudonym: Cuinetes

title: Red lentil soup with pumpkin and rosemary
preparation: Preheat the oven to 200º and prepare parchment paper. Sauté the onion with the olive oil. In a pot, add the vegetable broth with the lentils and let them cook for about 30'. Place the pumpkin on the parchment paper and let it roast for about 30' as well at 150º with a bit of rosemary and salt. Add the pumpkin to the pot with the lentils and rosemary for 10' and then let it rest. Serve.
notes: Pseudonym: Lady

title: LENTIL AND PUMPKIN LASAGNA
preparation: Wash the vegetables and cut them into small cubes. In a large pan, add a good drizzle of olive oil, add all the vegetables, a pinch of salt, and let them cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally; after about 40-45 minutes, increase the heat. When the vegetables are cooked, drain the lentils, and once they have lost all the water, add them to the pan. Add salt, nutmeg, oregano, and 3/4 parts of the jar of natural canned tomato, stir for 5-10 minutes and remove from heat. In a large tray, pour very hot water and add the pasta sheets (these should be covered) and let them soak for about 10-15 minutes. After this time, remove them from the water and let them rest on paper towels and use another paper to dry the surface. In a glass baking dish, cover the bottom with tomato sauce, place two pasta sheets at the base, put a bit of filling on top, repeat this once more and finish with a pasta sheet. Finally, make a light béchamel: in a saucepan, add a good drizzle of olive oil; when hot, add a tablespoon of flour, let it cook for a few minutes, and then gradually add the milk or plant-based drink while stirring constantly; continue stirring, add nutmeg, black pepper, and salt; when the béchamel begins to thicken, remove from heat. Cover the surface of the lasagna, add the grated cheese on top and place it in the oven (previously preheated), bake at 180ºC for about 15 minutes until the cheese is gratin and golden. Serve half a lasagna per person and accompany it with a nice green sprout salad.
notes: Pseudonym: Taste of the season

title: Codfish Empedrat
preparation: Chop the tomato, pepper, and onion into small pieces. Place the potatoes and cod in a bowl, adding the chopped vegetables. Mix everything together and add the black olives and parsley, then season with extra virgin olive oil.
notes: Pseudonym: Cuinetes

title: Forest Fruit Ice Pop

ingredients.name: strawberries (or any variety of forest fruits such as raspberries, blueberries, green grapes, or blackberries, you can try different combinations)

preparation: Fill a glass with water. Add 28 chopped fresh mint leaves and leave them in the glass for approximately 10 minutes. Strain the water and set it aside. Grate the pulp of 28 green grapes to obtain the juice. Add the green grape juice and lemon juice to the water. Skewer the forest fruits on the sticks and place one stick in each cavity of the mold. Add more fruits, grapes, and a mint leaf in each cavity of the mold. Finish filling the cavity with the mint, lemon, and grape juice water. Freeze for a minimum of 4 hours or overnight until the ice pop is completely solid and serve.

title: Healthy banana popsicle
preparation: Crush the hazelnuts in a blender. Add the 0% fat fresh whipped cheese to the blender. Cut the banana and add it to the blender. Blend everything together. Pour into a silicone mold. You can use the same one used for making muffins. Insert popsicle sticks into each mold (optional).

title: Fruit sorbet
preparation: Freeze the previously sliced fruit. Blend the fruit and the yogurt. Shape into sorbet balls and decorate with chia seeds.

title: Oatmeal cookie with strawberry
preparation: Base: grind the walnuts, oat flakes, and pitted dates all together, shape into a round form, with or without a mold, and place in the refrigerator for about 15-20 minutes. Filling: grind the 100% peanut butter, natural soy yogurt, and pitted dates and place them on top of the cookie base using a spoon. Fruit: clean, slice, and place the strawberries on top. Store it in the refrigerator.

title: Bircher muesli

ingredients.name: natural yogurts or 1 ½ cups of milk or unsweetened plant-based beverage
strawberries (or another seasonal fruit such as apricots, peaches, cherries, etc.)
ground cinnamon (another option is grated coconut)

preparation: Grate the apples into a bowl, add a few drops of lemon, the yogurts, and mix. Store in an airtight container in the fridge overnight. At the time of eating: place the previous preparation into 4 bowls and add 3 sliced strawberries and 3 crushed walnuts to each bowl, then sprinkle with cinnamon to taste.
notes: Keep in the refrigerator for 3 days.

title: Melon and feta salad

ingredients.name: fresh or soft goat or sheep cheese
oil, salt and oregano to taste

preparation: Make melon and feta balls (if you don't have the tool, you can make cubes), cubes of sheep or goat cheese, and wash the fresh mint leaves. Assemble the dish by combining one ball of each and the cheese in the middle, decorated with mint. Season it with oil, salt, and oregano to taste. Enjoy this simple, colorful, delicious, and very fresh salad for the hottest days.

title: Rice pudding
preparation: Using a strainer, wash the rice well. In a pot, heat the water and, when it is about to boil, add the rest of the ingredients (except the ground cinnamon). Cook over low heat for 35-40 minutes, stirring constantly so it does not stick. Refrigerate for at least 1-2 hours before consuming.

title: Lime and lemon ice pops mojito-inspired
preparation: First, we must thoroughly clean and disinfect the fruit. In a pitcher or a sealable glass bottle, we add the water. Next, we peel a couple of limes and a couple of lemons and add the zest to the water. Then, we make the juice and add it to the water as well. Finally, we add the fresh mint sprigs and sweeten to taste. Shake it well and let it rest in the refrigerator for 2 to 4 hours. After this time, strain the liquid and fill the ice pop molds. Leave them in the freezer for 3 or 4 hours, depending on the molds and whether you want them as a granita texture.
notes: Sweetener to taste, ask your Dietitian-Nutritionist for advice

title: Refreshing blueberry and chia smoothie
preparation: Blend all the ingredients in a blender until a homogeneous texture is achieved.

title: Lemon mousse

ingredients.name: 0% fresh whipped cheese (or plant-based or lactose-free yogurt)

preparation: Hydrate the neutral gelatin sheets in a bowl with cold water and let them soak. In a large bowl, mix the 0% fresh whipped cheese with the lemon juice, its zest, and the sweetener. Heat a cup with the 20-30ml (two fingers) of milk or plant-based beverage in the microwave for 30-40 seconds. Dissolve the gelatin sheets and incorporate them well into the fresh whipped cheese mixture. In another bowl, whip the egg whites to stiff peaks (to help them whip, add a pinch of salt). Once whipped, incorporate them gradually into the fresh whipped cheese mixture using folding movements. Finally, pour into 4 containers and refrigerate in the fridge for 3-4 hours.
notes: Consult your Dietitian-Nutritionist regarding the sweetener.

title: Avocado and Carob Mousse
preparation: Combine the walnuts and dates and mix them well together. Place them at the bottom of the glass. Using a blender, puree all the ingredients except the extra virgin olive oil until a smooth texture is achieved. Add the extra virgin olive oil and blend again until a creamy texture is reached. Place the mousse over the walnut and date crumble. Decorate with some mint leaves. To eat, mix everything well: the crumble with the mousse and the mint leaves.
notes: Sweetener to taste, ask your Dietitian-Nutritionist for advice. The walnuts should be soaked for 4 h and the dates for 1 h.

title: Cherry cake
preparation: Preheat the oven to 180ºC. With the help of a blender, puree the bananas together with the dates, the oat drink, and the olive oil. In a bowl, mix the flour together with a bit of salt, the baking soda, and the baking powder. Add the banana mixture and mix everything very well. Distribute the mixture into a round silicone mold and place the cherries on top. Bake in the oven for approximately 35-40 minutes. Let cool and unmold.

title: Easy and healthy ice creams without added sugars
preparation: Blend and freeze the fruits separately.
notes: If the ice creams are made with previously frozen fruit, just blending is enough. However, if you want them to be fresher and more refreshing, you can blend and then freeze them again. You can also add crushed ice. They can be made with any fruit you like and some dairy or plant-based drink to taste: milk, natural yogurt, coconut drink, oat drink, rice drink, etc. In addition to the blended fruits, you can add some fruit pieces, such as strawberries or blueberries.

title: Banana and Cocoa Custard
preparation: Dissolve 2 dessert spoons of arrowroot or kuzu with 300 ml of oat milk and heat it in a saucepan. Blend the bananas with 100 ml of oat milk and the cocoa, then add it to the saucepan. Stir everything without reaching the boiling point. Distribute into glasses or small bowls and let cool. Store in the refrigerator and serve when ready to consume, topped with cinnamon.
notes: Arrowroot can be replaced by agar-agar or neutral gelatin; in this case, it must be dissolved with the oat milk while boiling.

title: Banana cake
preparation: Separate the egg whites from the yolks and whip the whites to stiff peaks. Blend the yolks, bananas, oat flour, oats, cinnamon, and vanilla until the mixture is homogeneous. Fold the stiff egg whites into the rest of the batter using a spatula. Grease the mold with a little bit of oats to prevent sticking. Pour the batter into the mold and garnish it with some dark chocolate chunks. Bake in a preheated oven (top and bottom heat) at 150ºC for about 30 minutes. Before removing it from the oven, pierce it with a toothpick. If the toothpick comes out clean, it is cooked.

title: Sara's Ice Cream
preparation: Slice the bananas into slices of approximately one centimeter and freeze them along with the blueberries (any kind of fruit can be used instead of banana, which will serve as the base for the ice cream). Once the fruit is frozen, blend the bananas first, and once you have a creamy paste, add the blueberries and continue blending for another 2-3 minutes until you obtain the ice cream. Add 1 or 2 ice cubes so that it holds its texture better and does not melt quickly.

title: Whole wheat cookies with coconut
preparation: In a container, beat the eggs, then add the oil, salt, sugar, and baking powder. Mix all the ingredients until homogeneous. Add the flour and mix with a pastry spatula until you have a dough that can be worked with your hands. It is advisable to wet your hands to be able to knead it. Take the dough and weigh the balls as you make them on a scale; in this case, they weigh 34g (16 units). Lay parchment paper over the tray you will use to put into the oven and preheat the oven to 180 °C. Once you have made all the balls, flatten them with your hands until you get a round cookie, and place them on the parchment paper. Place the tray in the oven for 20 min.
notes: Gluten-free: substitute the whole wheat flour with rice flour or gluten-free oat flour. Vegetarians: substitute the egg with chickpea flour (60 g = 2 eggs) and water.

title: Mango roll with yogurt and hazelnuts
preparation: First, wash and dry the mango. Place it in the freezer for 10 minutes to firm it up so you can make finer slices. Peel and slice the mango into thin strips. Place the yogurt in the middle and roll it up. Add hazelnuts to taste.
notes: Greek yogurt can be replaced with natural yogurt or switched to a soy dessert; consult with your Dietitian-Nutritionist.

title: Creamy banana, nectarine, and plum gelato

ingredients.name: natural yogurts or greek style or soy yogurts or a glass of plant-based drink

preparation: Wash, peel, dice the fruits and freeze them beforehand. Blend the fruits in a blender. You can add yogurt or plant-based drink if you want to vary the flavor. Pour into molds and freeze for 3-4 hours.

title: Coconut waffles
preparation: Beat the eggs in a bowl. Incorporate the coconut flour into the beaten eggs and mix until the batter is formed. Once the batter is compact, add the milk, cinnamon, and vanilla essence and mix well until all ingredients are incorporated. Cook them in a waffle maker or in a pan in the shape of waffles. If you don't have either option, you can use a regular frying pan and make them like crepes. Add your favorite toppings, in this case, fresh apricots and peanut butter.

title: Butternut squash cannelloni stuffed with chickpeas
preparation: Soak the chickpeas overnight. Boil the chickpeas until they are cooked. If using canned chickpeas, rinse them thoroughly with plenty of water in a colander. Once they are cooked, mash them with a fork, or you can also blend them for a texture more similar to hummus. Clean and dry the butternut squashes. Using a mandoline, cut thin longitudinal strips and let them rest on absorbent paper. Next, cut the apple into slices or small cubes. To the previously prepared chickpea mixture, add the apple and the mató cheese. Mix until everything is homogeneous, add salt and pepper to taste. Grate a little ginger root over the mixture and mix again (remember that ginger has a distinct flavor, taste until it reaches the right point for your palate). Finally, stuff the butternut squash strips with this mixture and roll them up.
notes: If mató cheese is not available, it can be replaced with vegan cheese or crumbled tofu.

title: Broad bean salad

ingredients.name: Montserrat, oxheart or cherry pear tomatoes
scallions or cubes of ibérico ham

preparation: Confit the broad beans in a saucepan with olive oil and some mint leaves over very low heat, and once cooked, let them cool. Clean and dice the tomatoes and mix them with the tender sprouts, the cold drained broad beans, the ham pieces, and some chopped mint leaves, then keep in the refrigerator until the moment of serving. For the vinaigrette, emulsify one dessert spoon of mustard with 3-4 tablespoons of olive oil and one coffee spoon of balsamic vinegar (do not salt it as the mustard and the ham already contain salt). Serve the salad very cold and dress it at the moment of serving.
notes: do not salt it as the mustard and the ham already contain salt

title: Stir-fried spaghetti with vegetables
preparation: Boil the pasta to the desired cooking point (7 minutes for al dente, 11 minutes cooked). Cut the vegetables into small cubes and sauté for about 10 minutes. Add the pasta to the vegetables and mix well for about 5 minutes. Season with salt and pepper and serve hot.

title: Carrot puree
preparation: Prepare all the vegetables and the potato (peel and wash the carrot, potato, garlic, and onion). In a saucepan, add a tablespoon of olive oil and lightly sauté the garlic. Quickly add the rest of the ingredients and cover with the assigned amount of water. Place over high heat until it reaches boiling and let cook for about 20-25 minutes. After this time has passed, using a blender, blend until a homogeneous puree is obtained. Adjust with salt to taste; a couple of small teaspoons is usually sufficient. The puree can be served hot or eaten cold.

title: Hawaiian salad
preparation: First of all, bring water to a boil to cook the rice. When it reaches a boil, add the rice and let it cook for 20 minutes. Immediately drain and set aside until it cools down. Meanwhile, cook the prawns for 7 minutes. If using tofu, drain the water, cover with paper towel or a cloth and squeeze it tightly. Then cut it into cubes. Next, cut the pineapple into cubes. Assemble the dish by placing the cannellini beans at the bottom and the rest of the ingredients next to each other without mixing them. Finally, add the sesame seeds over the pineapple and season with salt, EVOO and pepper.

title: Montserrat tomatoes stuffed with mint oil

ingredients.name: olive oil for the mint oil

preparation: Cut the top part of the tomato to make a lid. Empty the tomato of its interior and cut its fleshy part into small pieces to add to the stuffing. Boil the brown rice with a little salt. Drain and cool it. Finely chop the lettuce leaves, olives, and walnuts. Make a homemade mayonnaise. In a blender jar, add 1 egg, a splash of vinegar, a little salt, and a little olive oil. Start blending with the robot and, without stopping the blender, gradually add the olive oil while binding the ingredients until a mayonnaise texture is obtained. Mix all the ingredients with the mayonnaise: the fleshy part of the tomato, the rice, the lettuce, the olives, and the walnuts. Stuff the tomatoes with the mixture and cover them with their lids. Decorate with mint oil and mint leaves. Mint oil: blend some mint leaves with olive oil (optionally add a little garlic).
notes: It could be made with sunflower oil for a milder taste.

title: Cardoons in green sauce with mussels and Sant Carles de la Ràpita langoustines

ingredients.name: wild cardoons, frozen or fresh (cut the stalks into pieces)
langoustines (at the start of the Sant Carles de la Ràpita langoustine season)

preparation: Make a fish stock or broth in 20 minutes using fish bones, or make use of the langoustine heads by boiling them with the liquid from opening the mussels and the water used for boiling the cardoons. Peel and clean the cardoons well and cook the stalks of frozen cardoons for 20-30 minutes or 40-45 minutes if they are wild. Steam the mussels over medium heat for the necessary time until they open. In a shallow pan, sauté the onion, garlic, and parsley with EVOO until the onion becomes transparent. Add the white wine and let the alcohol evaporate for 2 minutes. Add the tablespoon of cornflour dissolved in a glass of cold water and 2 drops of fish stock or the liquid from opening the mussels. Thicken the sauce slightly. Add the cardoons, the mussels, and the peeled langoustine meat. Cook everything together for 2-3 minutes; just enough time for the langoustine meat to change color, and serve.
notes: To complement the dish, boiled rice can be added (40g raw per person).

title: Red lentil cream with pumpkin and spices

ingredients.name: garam masala (or half a dessert spoon of cinnamon and the other half of turmeric)

preparation: Chop the garlic and onion into very small pieces and sauté them in a saucepan with the oil over low heat for 10-15 minutes or until the onion is soft. Peel the pumpkin and cut it into cubes. When the onion is soft, add the pumpkin and the spices to the saucepan and stir for 2-3 minutes. Add the crushed or grated tomato and the broth and increase the heat. Rinse the lentils in a fine mesh strainer and add them to the saucepan. Let it cook over low heat for 20 minutes or until the lentils and pumpkin have cooked and softened. Taste it and, optionally, add a pinch of salt. You can blend it to achieve a finer and more homogeneous texture, or serve it without using a blender. Serve the lentil cream warm or cold, topped with some green leaves and pumpkin seeds for a crunchy touch.
notes: Red lentils are peeled and split lentils. Therefore, they cook faster than conventional ones but provide less fiber. They are an option to consider for all people for whom legumes cause discomfort.

title: Melon soup
preparation: Open the melon, remove the seeds and cut it into cubes. Blend the melon cubes with the two yogurts and 4 mint leaves, optionally adding a pinch of mint. Place in cups and refrigerate, ideally for 2 to 4 hours. Serve with a slice of ibérico ham rolled up on a toothpick or with ham shavings and some mint leaves.

title: Mediterranean spinach pie
preparation: Sauté the mushrooms with EVOO. Add the spinach and cook with the mushrooms. Beat the eggs in a bowl and add the milk. When the spinach is cooked, add it, along with the mushrooms, to the bowl with the eggs and mix. Incorporate a little salt and oregano and mix. Place in an oven-safe dish. Decorate with the cherry tomatoes and pine nuts. Bake in the oven at 180°C for 25-30 minutes. Let cool.
notes: Vegans: substitute eggs with chickpea flour and water. Change the milk to a plant-based drink. Lactose intolerant: substitute the milk with a plant-based drink. Egg allergy: substitute eggs with chickpea flour and water.

title: Cold avocado and cucumber cream
preparation: Place all ingredients into a blender or food processor and blend. Allow time to let it cool in the refrigerator. Serve very cold, with or without ice cubes.

title: Red lentil cream
preparation: Dice the vegetables. Sauté the onion with a bit of olive oil and, when the onion is translucent, add the rest of the vegetables, the bay leaf, cumin, pepper, turmeric, and salt. Incorporate the rinsed lentils and cover them with water or vegetable broth. Bring to a boil over low heat until the lentils are soft, approximately 30 minutes. Once they are cooked, blend them with a blender until a cream is obtained. Serve in bowls and top with chia seeds, pumpkin seeds, and a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil.

title: Cod mousse with olives and sunflower seeds
preparation: Cook the cod with the chopped onion in the microwave for 4 minutes, covered hermetically. Mash the cod with the onion in a saucepan and add the flour, stirring with a wooden spoon. Add the milk and continue stirring, as if making a béchamel. You can add a little nutmeg and cognac to aromatize it. Once a thick consistency is achieved, blend it and distribute it into glasses or other transparent utensils. Keep in the fridge. To add color, add 3 pitted black stuffed olives and a handful of seeds on top. You can also add some toasted bread croutons.

title: Asparagus and Pepper Salad
preparation: Boil the two eggs for 10 minutes. Wash and finely dice the red pepper, green pepper, and spring onion. Set aside in the refrigerator. Peel the boiled eggs and let them cool. In a container, mix the olive oil, sherry vinegar, and the pinches of salt and ground black pepper. Let the vinaigrette sit at room temperature. Drain the asparagus and arrange them on a plate. You can leave a little bit of the canning liquid if you prefer. Add the diced vegetables on top of the asparagus and dress the dish with the vinaigrette. Finally, grate the boiled eggs, half an egg over each serving.
notes: The addition of egg is optional. Using spring garlic instead of spring onion also works very well.

title: Vegetable cake
preparation: Peel the leeks and the onion and cut them into thin pieces. Wash the pumpkin and cut it into thin slices. Do the same for the carrot, finely sliced or grated. Place the vegetables in a pan with a bit of salt and let them soften. Meanwhile, beat the eggs in a large bowl, add the flour (I add it so the cake has more consistency, but it is optional), the milk or cheese, a bit of salt, pepper, nutmeg and mix well. When the vegetables are cooked, transfer them to the bowl and mix well. Then pour the mixture into an elongated mold, such as a plum cake tin. If it is not silicone, you will need to grease it with a bit of olive oil or butter to prevent sticking. Put it in a preheated oven at 180º and leave it for about 40-45 minutes with heat only from the bottom. Check that the cake is cooked by piercing it with a skewer. If it comes out clean, it is ready. Finally, to give it color, we can turn on the top part of the oven for about 3-4 min.
notes: You can also make this cake with other vegetables. For example: with pumpkin, leek, and onion.

title: Broccoli fritters or pizza base
preparation: Boil the broccoli; once it is cooked enough to be easily mashed with a fork, drain the water. Add the egg and cheese to the broccoli and mix everything until a single dough forms, then add the salt. On a baking tray lined with parchment paper, make shapes less than one finger thick (to ensure they are crispy) and bake at 200ºC for about 25-30 minutes.
notes: These first-course fritters can be served as a vegetable portion for adults and children, accompanied by an omelet or fish with a couple of slices of bread to make a single-dish meal. Another option is to use it as a pizza base for a second course.

title: Stuffed Zucchini
preparation: Clean the zucchinis, cut off the top part and set aside. Empty the interior of the zucchinis with a spoon and set aside. Season the zucchinis with salt and pepper and cook them for 4-5 minutes in the microwave at 800W. Boil the rice according to the manufacturer's instructions. In a pan, add a little extra virgin olive oil and cook the onion over low heat. Add the prawns and sauté them. Incorporate the previously hollowed-out zucchini, the mushrooms, season with salt and pepper, and cook everything together. Stuff the zucchinis with the previous mixture and serve.

title: Fake whole grain rice risotto with pumpkin cream
preparation: Boil the whole grain rice for approximately 20 minutes. In a pan, add 2 tbsp of EVOO and add the spring onions and leek finely chopped and the sliced garlic. Add a little salt. Cook over low heat with a lid for approximately 15 minutes. When the rice is ready, add it to the pan with the vegetables. On the other hand, to make the pumpkin cream, place in a pot the remaining EVOO, the pumpkin, the carrots, and the onion, all peeled and cut into large chunks, over low heat with a lid, without water. Once cooked, puree it. To assemble, add 8 tbsp of pumpkin cream to the rice and decorate with the pumpkin seeds. Enjoy!

title: Tabulé with pistachios
preparation: In a large bowl, grate three pear tomatoes after cutting them in half. You can also grate the skin or discard it. Add the lemon juice, two tablespoons of EVOO, and mix well. This would also be the moment to add a pinch of salt, if you wish to use it. Next, add the couscous and stir for a few minutes with a spoon until it is well soaked with the mixture. Meanwhile, cut the cucumber, the other tomato, the green pepper, and the red pepper into small cubes and add them to the bowl, mix again, and cover. We could change the proposed ingredients or add some fruit, such as pieces of melon. Let it rest for 1 hour; during this time the couscous is "cooking," so there is no need to turn on the stove! It can be left at room temperature or in the refrigerator so it will be fresher when eating. Subsequently, give the couscous a few turns so it becomes fluffier. When serving, we can remove the pit from some olives and chop them or leave them whole, peel a handful of pistachios per person (preferably unsalted) and place them on top of the salad; just before eating, chop the mint and distribute it along with a drizzle of EVOO and a touch of pepper.
notes: We could change the proposed ingredients or add some fruit, such as pieces of melon. During this time the couscous is "cooking," so there is no need to turn on the stove! It can be left at room temperature or in the refrigerator so it will be fresher when eating.

title: Refreshing carrot cream
preparation: Sauté the onion and all the peeled and chopped carrot in a saucepan with a little extra virgin olive oil (for a short time). Add the sparkling water and let it boil until the carrot is cooked. Add the half cup of semi-skimmed milk and blend until it is creamy and homogeneous. Let it cool and then place it in the refrigerator. When it is at a low temperature, it can be served as a first course or appetizer.

title: Greenpatxo
preparation: Wash all ingredients thoroughly. Cut the cucumber, apple, and celery into large pieces, approximately 3 cm. Place all ingredients (except the cherry tomatoes and some cucumber pieces) into a food processor, blender, or mixer to blend them together until a liquid texture is obtained. Cut the tomatoes in half or quarters and use them along with the separated cucumber pieces to decorate the presentation. Enjoy it very cold.

title: Watermelon Gazpacho
preparation: Wash the tomatoes and peel them, then set aside. Cut the same quantity of watermelon as tomato into small pieces. In a blender, add the tomato, watermelon, and one clove of garlic, and blend. Next, add a drizzle of olive oil, a bit of salt, and pepper. Blend again and taste to adjust. To finish, add 2-3 fresh mint leaves and blend again. If you want the gazpacho to be more liquid, you can add water until you achieve the desired texture. Place in the refrigerator and serve very cold.
notes: The colder it is, the better. You can garnish it with some fresh mint leaves.

title: Razor clam ceviche
preparation: Wash and dice the pepper, sweet onion, avocado, and cherry tomatoes, then mix them in a bowl. Open the tin of razor clams, drain the liquid from the container, and add the clams to the bowl. Season with salt, pepper, extra virgin olive oil, and vinegar. Easy, fast, and fresh!

title: Cordovan Salmorejo
preparation: Wash the tomatoes and blend them with skin and all. Pass the tomatoes through a strainer so that the dish remains without seeds or skin. Place the bread in a bowl. Add the tomato next. Let the tomato soak the bread for 10 minutes. Add the garlic and salt. Blend everything together well with an immersion blender. Add the extra virgin olive oil and blend again until a smooth and thick texture is achieved.
notes: The leftover seeds and skin can be kept in a bowl and used in another dish, on top of the bread or as a base for a sofrito.

title: Beetroot Mille-feuille
preparation: Clean and peel the beetroot and the onion. Clean the tomato and the radishes. Use a mandoline to slice the beetroot into thin slices, and do the same with the onion and the radishes. Use the mandoline to slice the tomato slightly thicker than the beetroot to maintain consistency. Slice the mozzarella into rounds. Assemble the dish. Place a little arugula at the base and arrange the vegetables and the mozzarella in alternating layers. Top everything with the sprouts. Add a spoonful of toasted sesame and dress with EVOO.

title: Cauliflower faux couscous
preparation: Separate the cauliflower into small florets, wash them and dry them well. Grind the cauliflower until you achieve the desired grain size and set aside. Clean the onion and chop it. Peel the carrots and cut them into small cubes. Wash and also cut the pumpkin into cubes. Heat a bit of oil in a pan, add the tender onion and sauté for 5 minutes or until tender. Add the carrot, sauté for a few minutes, and then add the pumpkin and raisins. Cook everything together for another 3-4 minutes. Add the cauliflower, season with salt and pepper, and sauté while stirring for 2 minutes. Finally, add the sunflower seeds and sauté for approximately 2 more minutes.
notes: salt-free

title: Cucumber carpaccio with dried tomato and basil pesto

ingredients.name: pine nuts (OPTIONAL: Add 2-3 walnuts, it gives an interesting touch)

preparation: Wash the cucumbers and slice them as thinly as possible (if you have a mandoline, it is very quick and convenient) and place them on the plate. Next, chop the dried tomatoes into small pieces and place them over the cucumber, finally adding a couple of tablespoons of our sauce and decorating with the sprouts. Place all the ingredients into the blender jar and blend until a homogeneous mixture is obtained. If you want it more liquid, add more EVOO. It keeps well for a few days in the refrigerator.
notes: If someone does not like cucumber, it can perfectly be made with sliced zucchini. For vegans, the sauce can be made perfectly without the parmesan cheese; the nuts and garlic already provide enough flavor. For people allergic to nuts, we would remove the nuts from the sauce and, in that case, add the parmesan.

title: Beetroot hummus
preparation: Wash the chickpeas thoroughly. Cut the beetroot and the garlic clove into small pieces. Place everything in a container. Add the lemon juice, tahini, olive oil, and salt (and water if necessary). Blend and serve in a bowl accompanied by breadsticks and/or crudités of carrot, red bell pepper, cucumber or endives.
notes: If it is too thick, we can improve the texture with a little bit of water.

title: Hummus in the shape of ice cream with bell pepper sauce

ingredients.name: sweet and mild red pepper powder

preparation: Roast the peppers for 40 minutes in the oven (180ºC). Meanwhile, cut the avocado in half horizontally, remove the pit, and scoop out the flesh with a spoon, placing it into a blender. To prevent oxidation, immediately add the lemon juice and the rest of the ingredients: boiled chickpeas, olive oil, salt, and spices (you could add 1 teaspoon of each ground type). Optionally add garlic (see recommendations). Blend at maximum power until a fine texture is achieved. If using an immersion blender, you will need to be a bit more patient. Afterward, you can strain it to make the texture even smoother. Then blend until you obtain a homogeneous paste. If it is difficult to blend, you can add a spoonful of mineral water. Next, peel the roasted and cooled peppers and blend them as well. Using an ice cream scoop, fill it with the hummus to form a ball and serve it in a bowl. Then, take 1 tablespoon of the bell pepper puree and arrange it on top, sprinkling the pistachios and a small pinch of salt on top, or you can leave the bell pepper puree at the bottom.
notes: If you add garlic, I recommend blanching it so the flavor isn't too strong by placing it in a pot with cold water and just as it's about to boil, remove it, cut it in half, remove the germ, and then you can add it to the mixture.

title: “Light” Fried Potatoes

ingredients.name: extra virgin olive oil spray (or use a brush)

preparation: Preheat oven to 180ºC. Peel the potatoes and cut them into wedges. Let them soak in cold water for 10-15 minutes to remove excess starch. Drain well and pat them dry with paper towels. Place the potatoes separately on a baking tray lined with parchment paper and spray with extra virgin olive oil. If you don't have a spray, you can also use a brush to coat them with the oil. Season with spices to taste: garlic, parsley, black pepper, paprika, etc. Leave the potatoes in the oven for 10-15 minutes until they look golden.

title: Baba Ganoush
preparation: Preheat the oven to 200 º C. Pierce the eggplants with a knife and place them on a baking tray with parchment paper. Bake for about 40-45 minutes or until they are tender. Remove from the oven and let them cool. Place the sliced eggplants (there is no need to peel them) and the rest of the ingredients in a food processor or blender until well combined. You can serve the Baba Ganoush immediately or let it cool in the refrigerator. For decoration, you can use fruit, chopped parsley, and a little more paprika. You can serve it with crudités (cucumber, red bell pepper, celery, and carrot) and pita bread or toasted spelt bread.
notes: The original Baba Ganoush is without chickpeas, but it also turns out very good if they are added, which also increases the protein content of the appetizer.

title: The easiest and most awaited hummus for summer
preparation: Blend all the ingredients except for the sweet paprika. Serve in a bowl and add a little sweet paprika, a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil, and some whole chickpeas for decoration.

title: Beetroot and cherry gaspacho

ingredients.name: ripe pear tomato, with lots of pulp
hard-boiled egg or bits of ibérico ham

preparation: Cook the beetroot whole and with the skin for 45 – 60 minutes depending on the size. Peel it once it is cold and cut it into pieces. Chop the tomato; there is no need to peel it or remove the seeds if you use a powerful blender. Remove the pits from the cherries. Blend the beetroot with the tomato, cherries, bread, salt, and the half clove of garlic. Add the vinegar and the extra virgin olive oil little by little without stopping the blender, so that it becomes well emulsified. Depending on your preferred texture, add between 100 and 150 ml of water to make it less thick. Keep in the refrigerator and serve cold with hard-boiled egg or bits of ibérico ham on top.

title: Warm beetroot cream
preparation: Peel and cut the onion and beetroots, reserve the beetroot leaves to make a "topping". Incorporate the olive oil into the pot and sauté the onion. Once sautéed, add the beetroot. Cover the mixture with water and milk, cover, and boil for 20 minutes. Next, julienne the beetroot leaves and sauté them with a bit of olive oil and finely minced garlic. Cover the pan so they cook slowly with their own steam. Once cooked, add the juice of one lemon and let it reduce. We will then set this aside to assemble the dish. Once the beetroot and onion are cooked, place them in a blender or use an immersion blender and blend until smooth. Plate it if you want to consume it warm; otherwise, keep it in the refrigerator for a few hours beforehand, and on top of the cream, add the beetroot leaf "topping" which will be hot and create a contrast with the temperature of the cream. Finish the dish with some black salt flakes or similar, currant seeds, parmesan cheese, and a drizzle of olive oil.
notes: We can also add apple at the time we boil the beetroot and the onion.

title: Tzatziki
preparation: Crush the cucumber and mix it with the yogurt. Finely chop the mint leaves. Crush the garlic with a garlic press or a mortar. Add it to the mixture along with the extra virgin olive oil, pepper, and salt.
notes: Delicious for dipping with carrot sticks, red bell pepper sticks, or other vegetables. It can also be used as a sauce for salads or pasta.

title: Escalivada Mousse
preparation: Clean the vegetables and roast them in the oven with the skin on at a high temperature. Once they are cooked and cooled, peel the vegetables and remove the seeds. Puree the vegetables together with the eggs, milk, and a drizzle of EVOO. Cook it in a bain-marie for about 30 minutes. Once cooled, it can be enjoyed accompanied by anchovies, hard-boiled egg, black olives, or toast.

title: Ajoblanco with melon
preparation: Soak the bread in cold water for a few minutes. Blend the bread, water, almond, garlic, vinegar, and salt, then process until it is very smooth. While continuing to blend, gradually add the extra virgin olive oil so that it emulsifies. Keep in the refrigerator and serve very cold accompanied by melon cubes.

title: Smooth gazpacho with apple
preparation: Wash all the vegetables well. Peel the cucumber and the apples and remove the cores. Put the tomatoes cut in half, the apples cut into quarters, the green and red pepper, the cucumber, the garlic, the EVOO, the vinegar, the salt, and the ice cubes into a food processor or blender. Blend at maximum power until a fine texture is achieved. If you use an immersion blender, you will need to be a bit more patient. Afterwards, you can strain it so the texture is even finer. Once everything is blended, add a little water and blend again to adjust the consistency. Adjust salt and vinegar if necessary. Let it cool in the refrigerator for at least two hours and... ready!

title: Cherry Gazpacho
preparation: Clean and disinfect all the vegetables. Cut them into large chunks and blend everything in a blender or with an immersion blender. Then, pass everything through a food mill to remove seeds or thicker skins that might be unpleasant to eat. Store tightly covered in the refrigerator to consume it well chilled.
notes: It can be decorated with a cherry and a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil, as well as some slivers of Iberian ham.

title: Tuna pudding

ingredients.name: natural tuna in a can, drained

preparation: Add the tuna (well drained), the milk, the eggs, the bread, the tomato, and a bit of salt and pepper to the blender. Blend until a homogeneous paste is achieved. Grease the mold with butter. Pour the previous mixture into the mold and cover with aluminum foil. Preheat the oven to 180ºC. Place water in a deep dish, and inside it, place the mold with the mixture (as it will be cooked in a bain-marie). Place the dish in the oven for one hour at 180ºC. The aluminum foil must continue covering the mixture during the entire cooking process. Unmold the pudding when it is cold.

title: Butternut squash burger
preparation: Wash the butternut squash and grate it without peeling. Place it in a colander to drain the water it contains. Cook the potato with the skin in the microwave. Once cooked, peel the potato, chop it up, and place it in a bowl. Finely chop the spring onion and add it to the potato. Add the grated cheese, the whole egg, the garlic, the finely chopped parsley, and the flour. Squeeze the grated butternut squash by pressing with your hands to remove all possible water. Add it to the bowl. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Mix the ingredients well with a fork until they are integrated and form a paste. Add a little more flour if you find that the paste is too runny.
notes: If you want to make it vegan, you can substitute the egg with a tablespoon of chickpea flour, two tablespoons of water, and a squeeze of lemon juice.

title: Vegetable and prawn skewers
preparation: Clean the pumpkin, carrot, and red bell pepper thoroughly. Slice the pumpkin into rounds and then into half-moons. Cut the bell pepper into large squares. Peel the carrot and slice it into rounds. Sauté the vegetables in a pan with a little olive oil and set them aside. Cook the prawns in the same pan with a little olive oil and the teaspoon of turmeric. Let them cool and, to make the skewers, thread the vegetables alternating with the prawns.
notes: You can reheat them before serving.

title: Flaked cod with almond sauce “romesco variant”

ingredients.name: toasted bread from the previous day

preparation: In a pan over low heat with a little extra virgin olive oil, add chopped spring onion and a couple of garlic cloves. When well cooked, add the roasted red pepper or piquillo pepper. Meanwhile, in a blender or food processor, add the toasted almonds, extra virgin olive oil, water, vinegar, raw garlic, toasted bread, sweet pepper powder, and salt; blend and set aside to add the cooked ingredients. Blend everything together with the blender until a smooth texture is achieved, adding water if necessary. Cut and wash the escarole and tomatoes, disinfecting if necessary. To plate, first place the escarole, then the cod, the tomato, and the pepper, then decorate with the sauce and the olives.
notes: We can use the sauce for other dishes and it is ideal if tomato is not liked.

title: Eggs stuffed with hummus and piquillo peppers

ingredients.name: sweet or spicy red pepper powder

preparation: Take the previously soaked chickpeas and put them in a pressure cooker. In my case (I use a small pot for this amount) I will need 20-25 minutes to cook them. Check the package to know how many minutes your product needs or ask the shop if you buy them in bulk. If you have them in a jar, you can skip this step. Once cooked, put them in a strainer and rinse them well. Let them dry a little. While doing that, boil the eggs. Put them in the water when it starts to boil and count about 15-20 minutes to cook them. Once they are done, discard the hot water and use cold water to cool them down and make them easier to peel. While they cool, make the hummus. Squeeze the juice of half a lemon, strain it, and set it aside. Also, peel the garlic and have it ready. Take the jar of piquillo peppers and drain two of them. Peel the eggs, cut them in half, and remove the cooked yolks. Leave them on a separate plate. Put the chickpeas in the blender measuring cup along with the rest of the ingredients: garlic, tahini, spices, olive oil, lemon juice, egg yolks, and salt. Finally, add the piquillo peppers and blend everything at maximum power. It should result in a puree-like cream, but if it is too thick, you can gradually add tablespoons of water until it reaches the desired texture. Since it is for stuffing eggs, we don't need it to be liquid. Use a pastry bag and put the puree inside. Start stuffing the eggs with the cream. If we are lucky enough to have molds to make shapes, we can stuff them so they look pleasing to the eye. If not, take a freezer bag, put the cream inside, and cut one of the bottom corners slightly to act as a nozzle. If you don't have any of that, you can do it with a spoon. Place the stuffed eggs on a tray and decorate them with sesame seeds or red pepper powder on top. Leave them in the fridge to cool well and enjoy!
notes: If you choose the dried chickpeas option, you must soak them for at least 12h

title: Red tuna tataki with avocado and mango
preparation: Cut both the avocado and the mango into equal strips and arrange them on the plate in the shape of a bed. Lightly sauté the spring onion and sear the tuna on all 4 sides, then arrange all the finely chopped ingredients on top of the plate. Season it with a vinaigrette of soy sauce, mustard, and olive oil. Sprinkle toasted sesame seeds on top, along with the salt flakes and... Enjoy!
notes: This can also be a shared dish as an appetizer.

title: Salmon tartare

ingredients.name: salmon loins previously ultra-frozen or frozen for at least 48 hours

preparation: Place the salmon in the refrigerator to defrost the night before. Finely chop the onion and the pickled gherkins and reserve them in a bowl. Add all the ingredients to this same bowl. Meanwhile, cut the salmon into cubes of approximately 1cm on each side. Finish by adding the salmon to the bowl and stir continuously for 10 minutes so that everything is well-coated. Keep it in the refrigerator for 30 minutes to 1 hour. Enjoy with some toasted whole grain bread slices.

title: Clams in Marinara Sauce
preparation: Place the clams in a container with water and a tablespoon of salt so they can release their sand. Let them soak for 2 hours, changing the water two or three times. In a pan with oil, sauté the chopped onion until it starts to color. Add the grated tomato and let it cook for a few minutes. Incorporate the garlic, celery, and parsley, all finely minced, and continue the sauté for 1 more minute. Add the wine, the bay leaf, and season lightly with salt and pepper. Immediately after, incorporate the clams and stir. Cover and let cook for 10 minutes over low heat.

title: Omelet with spring onions and green pepper
preparation: Julienne the peppers and the spring onions. Put a little olive oil in a pan and sauté all the vegetables over low heat. Once cooked, add the eggs (previously beaten) and let it cook over low heat.

title: Stuffed squid with vegetables
preparation: Clean the squid and chop the tentacles into small pieces. Set aside. Chop the onion and garlic into small pieces, put them in a saucepan, and add the oil, then sauté. Chop all the vegetables into small dice and incorporate them into the previous sauté. Add them in order: onion and leek, peppers, carrot, zucchini, and eggplant. Add the thyme to taste and cook over medium heat. Once the vegetables are gradually sautéed, add the tentacles to cook for a few minutes. Season with aromatic herbs and spices to avoid salt consumption. When everything is cooked, divide into 4 parts and fill the squid. Close the squid with the help of toothpicks. Make some cuts on the surface of the stuffed squid and place them on a very hot griddle or pan with a little oil. Cook for 3 or 4 minutes on each side until golden. On a plate, present it in two pieces accompanied by brown rice or a green salad. Serve immediately.
notes: Season with aromatic herbs and spices to avoid salt consumption. On a plate, present it in two pieces accompanied by brown rice or a green salad. Serve immediately.

title: Pumpkin and chickpea rolls
preparation: Drain and place the chickpeas in a bowl. Mash them with a fork and add a little egg, salt, and pepper. Chop the peanuts, reserve a few, and add the rest to the previous mixture. Cut the pumpkin into thin slices using a mandoline. Chop the leftover ends and add them to the chickpeas. Sauté the slices in a pan with a little egg for a few seconds, just enough to make them flexible (they can also be steamed for 2 minutes). Place 6-8 slices well-stretched and overlapping each other. Place a little pumpkin paste in the middle. Roll it up to form a roll (like a cannoli). Wash the cherries, cut them in half, and remove the pit. In a pan, add a little vinegar, bring to a boil, and add the cherries. Stir and add a little egg. Sauce the rolls with the vinaigrette and sprinkle the remaining chopped peanuts over them.
notes: It can be stuffed with any other type of legume or ingredients, and with larger quantities, it can be a main course.

title: Hake and vegetable muffin
preparation: Dice the tomato into small cubes and grate the pumpkin and carrot. Place everything in a bowl. Puree and process the hake (check that it has no bones) and incorporate it with the vegetables. Once everything is integrated, add the eggs, condiments, and flour with the baking powder. Mix well. Fill the muffin molds with the batter and place cheese cubes in the center, making sure they remain covered by the mixture. Bake in the oven at about 200 degrees for about 20-25 minutes.
notes: Ideal to eat cold or hot. They go very well accompanied by a natural yogurt and mustard sauce.

title: Marinated sardines
preparation: Submerge the sardine fillets in vinegar and let rest in the refrigerator for approximately 2 hours. Remove the fillets from the vinegar and place them on a platter. Distribute the diced tomato and onion, along with the whole pink peppercorns, over the sardine fillets. Keep in the refrigerator until the moment of serving. Before serving, add the olive oil and season with salt and pepper to taste.
notes: To prevent anisakis, freeze the fish for 48 hours at -20ºC

title: Tropical lentil salad
preparation: Cut the pineapples in half and empty the contents. Take a cutting board and dice the pineapple contents, the green pepper, the cucumber, and the red pepper. Since they are canned lentils, rinse them well under the tap and drain the excess water. Once cleaned, place the lentils in a bowl along with all the diced vegetables and mix. Next, dress with olive oil, salt, and pepper. You can also add spices to taste. To finish, refill each pineapple half with the prepared mixture. If desired, you can decorate with mint leaves for a beautiful presentation.

title: Coca de recapte with Sarraí wheat

ingredients.name: medium red bell peppers or 1 large

preparation: Roast the vegetables in the oven. Place baking paper on a tray, prick the vegetables, and bake them at 200ºC for 1 hour. Let them cool. While they are cooling, prepare the dough. Mix the dry ingredients, in this case the flour, salt, paprika, and oregano. Subsequently, add the extra virgin olive oil. Knead and slowly add the water while gradually mixing the dough with two spoons (do not use your hands). Be patient and do it slowly and with care until it becomes unified. Once you have a compact dough like a ball, preheat the oven to 180ºC for 15-20 minutes. Roll out the dough on lightly floured baking paper and prick it with a fork to ensure good cooking. Place the preparation in the oven for 12-15 minutes. Remove the dough and place the topping to taste, a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil, salt and pepper; bake it again. Leave it in the oven for 15 more minutes. Check after these minutes that it is cooked and let it cool on a rack to prevent it from getting soggy.

title: Cold pasta with smoked salmon and broccolini
preparation: In a pot, add water and bring to a boil; once it starts boiling, add the pasta and cook for the time specified on the package or according to your taste. Clean the broccolini, cut the stem if it is too long, and remove the leaves. In a saucepan, add water and bring to a boil. Once it starts boiling, add the broccolini and blanch it for 5 minutes so that it remains crunchy. Once the broccolini is blanched, remove it from the heat and place it in a bowl with very cold water (this will stop the cooking and maintain the intense green color); after a few minutes, drain the broccolini and set aside. Wash the tomatoes, slice them, and set aside. Remove the smoked salmon from its container, cut it into cubes or small pieces, and set aside. Once the pasta is boiled, transfer it directly into a large bowl using a pasta spoon, add the broccolini, cherry tomatoes, salmon, pepper, salt, olive oil, and mix everything together with the help of a wooden spoon. You can keep it in the refrigerator well-covered for a while or serve it immediately. Enjoy your meal!
notes: If you want to make a vegetarian/vegan version, you can add cubes of marinated tofu with spices instead of the smoked salmon.

title: Stuffed Eggplants
preparation: Prepare the eggplants steamed in the Lekue®: place them in the Lekue® clean, sliced in half and with 30 ml of water, at maximum power, 10-15 minutes. Boil the quinoa and rinse it. Prepare a sauté with a little EVOO with the mushrooms, the onion and the boiled quinoa. Empty the steamed eggplants and add the pulp to the base sauté. Fill the eggplants with the sauté and grate them with the cheese.

title: Fresh chickpea, tuna, and egg salad
preparation:
Boil the eggs for 10 to 15 minutes and set aside (let them cool to peel more easily).
Dice the onion, red bell pepper, and green bell pepper into small cubes.
Drain and rinse the chickpeas in a colander.
In a bowl, first mix the vegetables with the chickpeas and the tuna.
Add the lemon juice, vinegar, olive oil, salt, and mix.
Peel and dice the cooked eggs and gently mix with the other ingredients.
notes: Vegetarian option: add brown lentils instead of tuna, and if you wish not to add egg, you can swap it for lemon-marinated tofu, pan-seared until crispy, cut into dice.

title: Cauliflower crust pizza
preparation: Preheat the oven to 180°C. Wash the cauliflower, cut off the stalks, and process it in a food processor until it reaches a fine granular texture, similar to couscous. Take a clean cloth and place the cauliflower inside, twisting the cloth until the cauliflower is very compact, applying force to squeeze out all the water it contains. Add the egg and the spices, mixing well until a homogeneous dough is formed. Place parchment paper on the baking sheet and spread the dough using a spatula. Bake for about 20-25 minutes at 180°C. Let it cool slightly and add the ingredients of your choice. I add crushed natural tomato, mozzarella, anchovies, and basil, and once finished, serve the entire dish with a bit of arugula on top.
notes: I add crushed natural tomato, mozzarella, anchovies, and basil, and once finished, serve the entire dish with a bit of arugula on top.

title: Bulgur Wheat with Broccoli Muffins
preparation: Boil the bulgur wheat for 30 minutes or until you notice the cereal grains have swollen. After that, drain and set aside. To prepare the muffins, boil the previously chopped broccoli until it is cooked. Drain and let cool. In a bowl, place the two egg whites and the egg, add the cooked broccoli, the oat flakes, the salt, and the oregano to taste, and whisk until a homogeneous mixture is obtained. Then, pour the contents into muffin tins previously greased with oil and cook in the oven at 200ºC or in a water bath for 15 minutes. Serve the muffins accompanied by the bulgur wheat seasoned with salt and pepper to taste and low-fat grated cheese.

title: Chickpea salad with pan-seared cod

ingredients.name: red, yellow and green bell peppers

preparation: Soak the chickpeas overnight before cooking them with water and salt (you can add a bay leaf if you wish) or use cooked chickpeas. Chop the vegetables into small pieces: the bell peppers of all colors, the carrot, and the tomato. Mix the vegetables with the chickpeas. Dress with EVOO, salt, and vinegar. Pan-sear the cod using a good non-stick pan and a little EVOO; first, cook it over medium heat with a lid so it can cook well on the inside, and then increase the heat so it becomes slightly golden. Serve the salad as a bed for the cod.
notes: If you want the salad to have a different touch, you can dress it with lemon juice instead of vinegar. If you are vegetarian, you can replace the cod with egg or an omelet, or choose the vegan option with tempeh, Heura®, or dehydrated soy. You can swap the chickpeas for other legumes: lentils, broad beans, kidney beans, etc.

title: Potato salad
preparation: Bring water to a boil in a tall pot. Wash the potatoes with the skin on and add them whole to the water once it starts boiling. Let them cook. Using a clean, dry paper towel, clean the eggshells. It is advisable to use a paper towel for each egg. With the help of a spoon, so they don't hit against the bottom and break, add the eggs to cook when the water starts boiling. Let them boil for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, wash the peppers and tomatoes. Dice the peppers and cut the tomatoes into 2-3 pieces, and place them in a large bowl where they should be salted to taste. Mix the vegetables with the sliced olives and the tuna. Cover with plastic wrap and leave in the refrigerator. 10 minutes after the eggs have finished cooking, strain them and submerge them in cold water. Once cold, peel them and keep them in the refrigerator so they are very cold before incorporating them into the bowl with the vegetables. Once the potatoes are cooked, strain them and let them cool slightly so they can be peeled. Once peeled, cut them and leave them in the refrigerator so they are very cold before mixing them with the rest of the ingredients. When all the ingredients are cold, mix them and serve seasoned with olive oil.

title: Sweet ham and semi-cured cheese rolls stuffed with lettuce with a Pedro Ximénez reduction

ingredients.name: extra category sweet ham sliced thinly

preparation: First, wash the lettuce well and cut it into a very fine julienne. Next, take a slice of sweet ham and place another slice of cheese on top, if possible, so that it matches the entire surface of the ham. Place a handful of lettuce on top and spread it so that it also covers the entire width. Finally, season with salt and pepper and drizzle olive oil over it using a sieve. Lastly, roll it up like a cannelloni and plate it, garnishing with a bit more olive oil and a few drops of Pedro Ximénez reduction.

title: Vegetable sauté with fried egg

ingredients.name: large green bell pepper or 2 small ones

preparation: Wash and peel the vegetables. Cut the green pepper, red pepper, and carrot into sticks. Slice the mushrooms. In a non-stick pan, add 2 tablespoons of extra virgin olive oil and sauté the pepper and carrot. After a couple of minutes, add the mushrooms and let them cook while stirring constantly for another couple of minutes until the vegetables are cooked but al dente. In the same or another non-stick pan, add 1 tablespoon of extra virgin olive oil and once hot, add the 2 eggs. Let them cook covered so that the yolk and the white set. Repeat the same step with the other 2 eggs. Distribute the sautéed vegetables into 4 plates and place one fried egg on each. Season the dish immediately and it is ready to eat.
notes: You can use any seasonal vegetable you like for the sauté: asparagus, tender garlic, pumpkin, etc.

title: Potato, pumpkin and poached egg timbal
preparation: Slice the potatoes and the pumpkin into thin rounds. Place them in a baking tray, salt them and add a drizzle of oil on top. While they are cooking in the oven (35-40 minutes at 180 ºC), take the opportunity to make the poached egg.
