To prepare the poached egg: Line a cup with plastic wrap, letting the ends extend beyond the container. Using oil, lightly coat the inside of the plastic wrap in the cup. Carefully crack the egg and pour it into the cup. Add salt and black pepper. Carefully close the plastic wrap to form a bag and tie it with kitchen twine. Try to ensure no air remains inside. Place the packet in a saucepan with gently boiling water for 4 minutes. Remove the packet from the saucepan using a spoon and place it into a container with very cold water to stop the cooking process. Open the packet to obtain the poached egg. Remove the pumpkin and potato from the oven, checking that they are soft, and assemble them by placing a slice of potato, a slice of pumpkin, and so on, layering as desired, and finally placing the poached egg on top.

title: Summer salad with sautéed chickpeas and mango
preparation: Sauté the chickpeas in a pan with the previously boiled chard, garlic, and paprika. Once ready, cut the cherry tomatoes, mango, and avocado. Prepare the vinaigrette with the EVOO, vinegar, and olive tapenade. All that is left is to plate by incorporating the lamb's lettuce, mango, tomatoes, chickpeas, avocado, parmesan shavings, vinaigrette, and sesame seeds!
notes: The chickpeas can be replaced by any other legume or even quinoa. The spices and seeds used are indicative and may vary according to individual tastes.

title: Vegetable Carbonara Spaghetti

ingredients.name: lean chicken breast fillet cut into cubes

preparation: Peel and dice the zucchini and onions. On the other hand, boil the whole wheat spaghetti al dente. Cook the vegetables (zucchini and onion) in the microwave (with a lid for 15 minutes). You can also cook them steamed or boiled. Once the vegetables are cooked, blend them with a drizzle of skimmed milk and salt. Once we have the blended vegetables (creamy texture), place them in a pot along with olive oil and let them simmer for about 2 minutes. Add some pepper and nutmeg to taste. After two minutes, add the light fresh mozzarella and let it melt with the heat of the pot. Once the vegetable carbonara is made, you only need to cook the chicken in a pan or on a griddle along with oregano and a drizzle of olive oil. Finally, assemble the dish with the whole wheat spaghetti, the chicken cubes, and the carbonara sauce on top.
notes: We can decorate the dish with some pumpkin seeds and oregano.

title: Sardine Coca
preparation: In a bowl, add the glass of milk, the 3 tablespoons of EVOO, the glass of beer, the salt, and 1/4 part of the flour. Stir the whole mixture until it becomes a homogeneous dough. Slowly add the remaining part of the flour and, using your hands, knead everything until you achieve a compact dough. Let it rest for 1 hour at room temperature covered with a clean kitchen cloth. (During this time you can prepare the rest of the ingredients you will use to decorate the cocas). Once it has rested, while preheating the oven to 220ºC, roll out the dough with a rolling pin. Sprinkle flour on the surface to prevent sticking. If you like it crispy, roll it out as much as possible so it is as thin as possible. It is time to bake the dough for 15 minutes at 180ºC (place baking paper on the tray). Remove the dough from the oven and decorate it. Split the cheese slices in half and place them on the dough. Slice the onion into julienne as finely as you can and the tomatoes in half. Drain the oil from the sardines, open them in half, remove the bone, and place them on the coca as well. Finish baking for 15 more minutes in the oven at 180ºC and you are ready.
notes: You can use the ingredients you like best.

title: “Russian Salad”
preparation: Wash and peel the potatoes and cut them into chunks, boil them in a pot with plenty of water and salt (about 10 minutes) and in another pot boil the eggs also with plenty of water and salt (starting from cold water, about 10 minutes). While they are cooking, wash and peel the carrots and cut them into chunks. When the potatoes and eggs are cooked, let them cool. Peel the eggs and cut them into chunks. Finally, combine the potatoes, carrots, and eggs, add the olives as decoration, season with oil and salt and pepper to taste.

title: Chocolate Biscuit
preparation: In a container, combine the margarine with the dates and blend the ingredients until the dates are broken into very small pieces. Next, add the eggs and the cream cheese, and blend until air bubbles appear. Preheat the oven to 160 ºC and line the container you will use for the biscuit with parchment paper. Finish by incorporating the lemon zest, flour, and baking soda. Using a spatula or a large spoon, mix all the ingredients until you obtain a very creamy and smooth dough. Pour the dough into the container you will use to bake the biscuit. Bake in the oven for 35-40 min. To know when it is cooked, insert a knife into the edges and the center; if the knife comes out clean, you can remove it from the oven. Let it cool and, meanwhile, melt the topping chocolate using a bain-marie. Once the biscuit is cold, pour the chocolate over it and let it cool.

title: Avocado and lime mousse

ingredients.name: soy dessert or any natural vegan yogurt

preparation: Crush the dates and walnuts together with the coconut oil until a very uniform paste is formed, mix by hand, line the bottom of a small round mold (18 cm x 6.5 cm) and place it in the refrigerator. Blend the avocado pulp with the agave syrup, the soy dessert or natural vegan yogurt and the lime juice. Ensure it is very smooth, without lumps. Dissolve the agar-agar in a glass of warm water and incorporate it into the mixture. Mix well so everything integrates uniformly and add the lime zest, stirring carefully with a spoon. Spread the mousse over the base of the mold and smooth the top with a spatula. Leave to cool in the refrigerator for at least 3 hours. Before serving the cake, make the topping (incorporate the nuts before serving; otherwise, they will absorb moisture and will not be crunchy). To make the topping, break the walnuts and pistachios with a knife, place them in a pan with the syrup and caramelize them. Once they have cooled, incorporate them over the mousse. If the top of the mousse looks a bit dark, remove the first layer before adding the topping.
notes: If the top of the mousse looks a bit dark, remove the first layer before adding the topping. Vegan recipe.

title: Coconut balls
preparation: Beat the dates and the egg. Add the grated coconut and mix with a spatula. Let it cool for 30 minutes to 1 hour in the refrigerator. Preheat the oven to 180 ºC. Form the balls with your hands and add the grated coconut on top. Bake at 150 ºC for 15-20 minutes.
notes: Suitable for vegetarians and coeliacs. Monitor people with high sugar levels.

title: Pumpkin and walnut cake without sugar
preparation: Preheat the oven to 180 °C. Grind the cashews in a food processor and set aside. Grind the dates in a food processor and set aside. In a bowl, mix the ground cashews and dates, then add the eggs, cooked pumpkin, cinnamon, and ground ginger. After that, add the peeled walnuts and stir with the help of a spoon. Pour the batter into four individual oven-safe molds or into one 15 cm diameter mold and place in the oven for 50 minutes at 180 ºC. Remove from the oven and let cool before removing from the mold. Soak the dates in water for 1 hour. Grind the almonds in a food processor and set aside. Grind the dates with a little of the soaking water and set aside. In a bowl, add the mashed pumpkin, almonds, and crushed dates and mix. Cover the cake with the glaze and it is ready to serve.
notes: This recipe contains no flour and the sugars are those naturally present in the foods, such as dates. It provides healthy fats. Suitable for celiacs, diabetics, and lactose intolerant people.

title: Chocolate nougat with dried fruits and chestnuts

ingredients.name: peanut, almond, hazelnut butter or tahini
mixed dried fruit (walnuts, almonds, sunflower and/or pumpkin seeds...)

preparation: Soak your chosen mixed dried fruit and the chestnuts for 2 hours. Preheat the oven for 10 minutes at 200 ºC. While the oven is heating up, make a slit in the skin of the chestnuts without cutting them into pieces. Chop the chocolate into pieces and place it in a bowl using a double boiler or a dehydrator. When the oven is hot, place the dried fruit and the chestnuts on the oven tray positioned at mid-height. Watch them so they do not burn. Roast and remove the dried fruit after 10 minutes, turn the chestnuts over, and leave them for 10 more minutes. In a bowl, combine the roasted dried fruit and the peeled and chopped chestnuts with the nut butter or tahini and mix well. Then add the chocolate and the orange zest. Place in a nougat mold and put in the refrigerator for about 5 hours to solidify.
notes: Allergies to tree nuts, peanuts, or sesame: you can use raisins or any other dried fruit. These are not desserts for diabetics due to the amount of sugar the chocolate may contain.

title: Chocolate rocks

ingredients.name: handful of sugar-free cereals (spelt flakes/gluten-free option: corn flakes)

preparation: Chop and melt the chocolate in the microwave (low power, defrost option) with the coconut oil. Crumble the rice cakes and cereals. Mix everything together (add a bit of salt to enhance the flavor) and form small piles on parchment paper. Let them cool in the refrigerator.
notes: Suitable for celiacs, vegans (using vegan chocolate) and those intolerant to lactose or fructose...

title: Sweet potato and chocolate magdalenes
preparation: Preheat the oven to 180 ºC. Clean, peel, and grate the sweet potato. Blend all the ingredients in a food processor. Once everything is well integrated, place it into muffin molds. Bake the magdalenes in the oven at 180 ºC for 18-20 minutes. Once cooked, remove from the oven and let cool. You can decorate them with dried fruit, peanut butter, melted 85% chocolate...
notes: Suitable for vegetarians, and people with high blood pressure or diabetes.

title: Sweet truffles
preparation: Soak the dates for 30 minutes. Drain the water well and blend them in a blender along with the peanut butter. Take the unsalted and unsweetened hazelnuts and crush them with a pastry mortar, then mix them with the previous dough. Make 12 truffles (approximately 10 g each). Once made, coat them with shredded coconut. Keep them in the refrigerator.

title: Autumn Cake

ingredients.name: date paste or a ripe banana

preparation: Preheat the oven to 180 ºC. Mix the wet ingredients (eggs, yogurt, oil, date paste, orange zest) in a bowl until a homogeneous mixture is achieved. Add the oat flour, whole wheat flour, and baking powder and beat until they are fully incorporated into the mixture. Peel the apples, grate them to whatever size you prefer, and incorporate them into the batter. Pour the mixture into a mold previously greased with EVOO or lined with parchment paper (baking paper). Place the mold in the oven for about 35 minutes or until cooked (when the edges separate from the mold or by checking that the center is cooked with a toothpick). Remove from the oven and wait for it to cool. Unmold and decorate with nuts, seasonal fruit, yogurt, or homemade jams.
notes: FOR VEGAN VARIATION: Substitute each egg with 1 tbsp of flaxseed meal mixed with ¼ liter of water. Substitute the yogurt with soy dessert. FOR CELIAC VARIATION: Use only oat flour (check for gluten-free certification).

title: Sugar-free apple cake

ingredients.name: large golden apples (2 roasted and one raw)

preparation: Core the 2 apples and cut them into 4 parts. Roast them in the oven with the skin on (30 minutes at 180 ºC). Beat the eggs and add the yogurts and the oil. Mix the flour with the baking powder and add it to the previous mixture. Peel the roasted apples, cut them into cubes and add them to the mixture as well. Stir well. Pour the batter into the mold to put it in the oven. Slice the raw apple into thin slices and place it on top for decoration. Preheat the oven to 170 ºC. Bake for 45 min at 170 ºC, after this time increase the temperature to 180 ºC for 10 minutes.

title: Chocolate lollipops
preparation: Melt the 80 g of dark chocolate together with the two tablespoons of coconut oil in the microwave at low power. Blend an avocado, six Medjool dates, and the chocolate mixture in a food processor. Let rest in the freezer for 30 minutes. Form balls with your hands, coat them with grated coconut, and insert them onto a skewer. Keep them in the refrigerator so they are more consistent.

title: Hot chocolate
preparation: Slice the banana into rounds. In a pot, cook all the ingredients, except for the fruit to accompany, for about 7-8 minutes. Next, remove from heat and blend. Serve in a cup and accompany with your favorite fruit!
notes: Suitable for vegetarians and vegans.

title: Cabbage and cauliflower puree with tuber chips
preparation: Wash all the vegetables thoroughly and peel the skin of the potato and the sweet potato. Next, slice the potato and the sweet potato into very thin slices using a mandoline or a very sharp knife so that the cuts are very thin (chip style) and reserve them in a bowl with water. Cut the leek, cauliflower, and cabbage into small pieces, place them in a pot and cover the vegetables with water or homemade broth. Add a bit of salt and cook for approximately 30 minutes until the vegetables are soft. While the vegetables are boiling, dry the potato and sweet potato slices with paper or a kitchen cloth, and heat olive oil in a frying pan. Fry the potato and sweet potato chips until golden and crispy, then reserve them on a tray with paper towel to remove excess oil. Next, place the chips in a bowl and season with salt and rosemary leaves. Blend the boiled vegetables in a blender and then pass them through a potato masher. Plate the vegetable puree with a drizzle of olive oil and a few chips on top.
notes: This puree can be accompanied by spices such as turmeric. The chips can also be cooked in the oven with less olive oil, opting for other herbs such as oregano.

title: Butternut squash spaghetti with textured soy Bolognese
preparation: Soak the textured soy in water or vegetable broth. Wash the butternut squash and cut it using a mandoline so that it forms spaghetti shapes and set aside. Chop the onion and garlic. In a pan, sauté the onion with the oil for 3-4 minutes. Add the garlic and sauté for another 5 minutes. Add the crushed tomato and let it sauté for 10 minutes. Add the butternut squash spaghetti and sauté. Drain the textured soy, add it, and sauté again. You can add oregano and parmesan cheese if you wish.

title: Stuffed Eggplants with Chickpeas
preparation: Wash the eggplants, cut them in half and bake them in the oven for about 30 minutes at 180 ºC. Next, remove the eggplant pulp. In a pan with the olive oil, sauté the grated onion, add the roasted eggplant pulp, the tomato sauce and the chickpeas, and let the flavors blend. Add a pinch of salt and the red peppers, if to your taste. Now you can stuff the eggplants and bake them in the oven topped with the grated emmental cheese and oregano. You can plate them and enjoy.
notes: For a vegan option: they can be cooked without cheese; additionally, they can be gratinated alone or with crushed unsalted toasted or raw nuts. If salt intake must be reduced or eliminated due to arterial hypertension or another pathology, they can be cooked without salt.

title: Endive Salad
preparation: Wash and cut the endives. Wash and cut the fuji apple into cubes, keeping the skin on. In a bowl, mix the endives and the apple. Cut a garlic clove, remove the core, and place it in a mortar. Add a pinch of salt to the mortar and crush the garlic. Add one teaspoon of clear mustard, the juice of half a lemon, and the four tablespoons of olive oil to the mortar and stir. Dress the endives and apple with the mustard sauce and add the grated cheese on top. Decorate with some black olives.
notes: This dish is suitable for everyone, please be aware of allergens.

title: Sopa Bruta de Nadal

ingredient_sections.section_name: Reserved ingredients once the broth is made (potatoes and meat)

preparation: Prepare a large pot and fill it with water. Add the bones and the meat and a splash of vinegar. The bones should be covered by the water. Wait approximately 10 minutes for the bones to start releasing nutrients into the water. After this time, set the cooking time. In a normal pot, it should be kept uncovered and covered once it starts to boil. Wash the vegetables and peel the onion, turnip, parsnip, potato, and carrot. Cut the vegetables into large chunks so they can be easily removed from the broth later. Halfway through cooking, add the fresh, cut vegetables and a bit of salt so they release their nutrients into the water. If the water has reduced too much, add more and cover the pot again. While the broth is cooking, boil the eggs, peel them, and chop them. Once the broth is cooked, strain it and reserve the bones, meat, and vegetables. Remove the skin, fat, and bones from the meat, and shred it with your fingers. It should not be finely chopped or pureed. Grate the potatoes and mix them with the chopped eggs and shredded meat to have the soup ingredients. Ladle the broth into a bowl, correct the salt, and add the soup mixture prepared in the previous step. Serve it hot.
notes: If using a slow cooker, the broth should be set for 18-24h. If using a pressure cooker, set for 4h once it starts boiling and then lower to minimum heat. If using a normal pot, set for 6-8h once it starts boiling and then lower to minimum heat. Low FODMAP: Boil the green leaves of the leek, not the white part. Do not add onion to the broth. Ovo-lacto vegetarian: Substitute the meat and bones with chickpeas when making the broth and also use them for the soup. Vegan: Substitute the meat and bones with chickpeas when making the broth. For the soup, substitute the boiled eggs with mushrooms or tofu cubes. Add more vegetables to the soup (turnip, carrot, onion, parsnip...). Hypertension: Substitute the pork and beef bones for 1 clean chicken carcass and keep the chicken thighs. Degrease the broth. Do not add salt during cooking and enhance with spices: black pepper, cumin, parsley... If you want to change the eggs for chickpeas, let them be dried with homemade cooking and avoid canned ones. Low-calorie diet: substitute the pork and beef bones for 1 clean chicken carcass and keep the chicken thighs. Degrease the broth. Substitute the eggs with chickpeas. Substitute the grated potato with carrot, parsnip, onion and/or turnip. Easy digestion: Cook the broth only with chicken bones. The soup is made from the shredded chicken meat and grated boiled potato. Eggs can be added or not depending on tolerance. A middle ground is to add only the boiled egg white, chopped.

title: Quinoa with tomato and leek
preparation: Weigh the quinoa portion and rinse it. Bring water to a boil in a pot, cook the quinoa; once cooked, drain and set aside (approximate cooking time 12 minutes). Wash and chop the leek into pieces and cook it in a pan with 20 ml of olive oil, stirring so it does not burn; once cooked, remove from heat and set aside. In the same pan, reduce the crushed tomato over medium heat together with 10 ml of olive oil and add salt if it does not already contain any (check the container ingredients). Add the reserved leek to the pan with the reduced crushed tomato and cook everything together for a couple of minutes. Mix the reserved quinoa into the pan mixture. Plate and serve hot. Enjoy!
notes: Hypertension: The same recipe without adding salt; it is recommended to use crushed tomato without salt. Diabetes: it is recommended to adjust the quinoa portion in each particular case and accompany the dish with a salad to lower the glycemic load. Allergens: in principle there are none, but consult your dietitian or check the nutritional label of the tomato if it is canned.

title: Bean and Pumpkin Galette

ingredients.name: water needed to achieve desired texture

preparation: DOUGH PREPARATION: Soak the beans for at least 8h (ideally overnight). Once 8h have passed, drain them well under the tap. Cover the beans with clean water. Add a pinch of salt and blend. Adjust the amount of water until the texture is like crepe batter. Reserve the dough until it is time to make the galettes. FILLING PREPARATION: Clean and peel the pumpkin. Cut into small cubes and place on a baking tray. Add a drizzle of oil, salt, and a bit of oregano and place in the oven at about 180 ºC for 20 minutes. Watch so it does not overcook and the cubes stay whole. Meanwhile, prepare the cauliflower. Using a food processor (or a knife), chop the cauliflower very finely until it reaches a rice-like texture. Sauté the cauliflower in a pan, along with some very finely chopped garlic cloves and a bit of salt. Set aside. SAUCE PREPARATION: Mix all the sauce ingredients and blend well. Add water if you think it is necessary. ASSEMBLY OF THE GALETTE: Heat a pan with a bit of oil. When it is well heated, add a bit of galette dough to cover the entire base. As soon as it starts to bubble, flip it and cook on both sides. Repeat the same with the rest of the dough. Remove from heat and place the galettes on a plate. Fill with the pumpkin, cauliflower, and a bit of goat cheese (optional). Fold the galette and add the sauce to your liking.
notes: Vegan recipe if made without cheese. Lacto-vegetarian recipe if cheese is added to the filling.

title: Eggplant Millefeuille with Anchovies and Parmesan
preparation: Slice the eggplant into rounds and place it in salt so that it loses its bitterness. Put the vegetable broth in a small saucepan and add the anchovies when it starts to boil. Leave it on very low heat for about 10 minutes. Remove some of the salt from the eggplants. Grill the slices. In a good non-stick pan, add a very thin layer of parmesan. Leave on very low heat, so it doesn't burn, until it takes some color. Assemble the layers according to the photograph and add the rosemary flower as decoration. Reserve the cooking broth as an appetizer.

title: Vegetable Crust
preparation: Preheat the oven to 190 ºC. Mix the flour, water, and oil in a bowl and add a bit of salt and oregano. Once you have achieved a homogeneous and compact dough, knead it on a flat surface. Roll out the dough with a rolling pin or a glass until it is very thin. Arrange the dough on a baking tray lined with parchment paper. Wash and cut the vegetables and place them on top of the dough. Try to leave a finger's width at the edges of the dough so you can fold them later. Season the vegetables with a drizzle of oil, a bit of salt, and pepper. Dice the sweet ham and place it over the vegetables. Once you have placed all the ingredients for the crust, fold the edges of the dough. Bake in the oven for 35-40 minutes at 190 ºC.
notes: Another type of flour can be used in case of gluten intolerance.

title: Cauliflower rice risotto

ingredients.name: salt or soy sauce (tamari) and pepper

preparation: Sauté the onion with olive oil. When golden, add the whole shiitake mushrooms and the diced button mushrooms. Cook for a few minutes. Add the rest of the vegetables and sauté for a few more minutes. Add the grated cauliflower and cook for 5 more minutes, stirring occasionally. Finally, add the rice drink, pepper, salt or tamari to taste, and let cook for the last few minutes. Turn off the heat and add the nutritional yeast and mix everything together.
notes: It is a vegan recipe but you can substitute the nutritional yeast with parmesan. The plant-based drink can be of any type and you can even change it for cow's milk. Check the soy sauce label (it usually contains gluten).

title: “Colirroz” three delights with pesto sauce
preparation: Place the pumpkin in the microwave for 5 minutes in a microwave-safe container with 1 tbsp of water. Place the onion and pepper in a microwave-safe container with 1 tbsp of water and cook for 6 minutes. Put the olive oil in a pan with the garlic and leek and sauté for 3 minutes. Add the previously grated raw cauliflower to the pan and sauté for 5 more minutes. Add the pumpkin, onion, and pepper previously cooked in the microwave, season, and incorporate the pesto sauce, mixing everything for 3 minutes.
notes: The recipe can be made with other seasonal vegetables. This recipe is designed to be served as a first course; if dried fruit or nuts are added, it can be a main course for a vegan or vegetarian menu. Suitable for vegans, vegetarians, and celiacs.

title: Mushroom Risotto
preparation: In a saucepan, add a drizzle of EVOO and sauté the mushrooms with salt and pepper. Once the mushrooms are sautéed, add the caramelized onion, the garlic and parsley paste, and the pinch of turmeric. Immediately after, add the rice and a sprig of rosemary or thyme and stir so that it absorbs all the flavors of the mushrooms and seasonings. When the rice is transparent, add the hot broth gradually over medium heat. Stir, adding broth until the rice is "al dente". Next, add a drizzle of whole or evaporated milk and stir until it is absorbed and reaches the desired texture. Plate it with a bit of parmesan cheese on top.
notes: Consult your dietitian-nutritionist or check the nutritional label of the cheese because it may contain egg lysozyme.

title: Pumpkin, butternut squash and coconut milk cream
preparation: Chop the onion and the garlic cloves. Sauté for 7 minutes with the salt and olive oil over medium/low heat. Cut the pumpkin and the butternut squash into squares, add them to the sauté, and let them cook for 3 more minutes. Pour in the water along with the pepper and rosemary. Cover and let it cook for 20 minutes. Once finished, blend all the ingredients together with the coconut milk. If it is too thick, you can add a little more water until you achieve a creamy texture.
notes: If it is too thick, you can add a little more water until you achieve a creamy texture.

title: Chickpea, pumpkin and mushroom fritters with walnut and basil mayonnaise
preparation: Boil the flour for about 5 minutes with water and salt. The cooking time may vary depending on the chickpea flour. Peel the pumpkin and cut it into small cubes. Wash and cut the mushrooms into small cubes. Sauté the pumpkin and mushrooms in a pan, preferably a wok, with a bit of EVOO. Mix the flour with the vegetables in the wok. In a blender, add the egg, 2 garlic cloves, a squeeze of lemon, and sunflower oil. Start blending and continue adding oil until you achieve a mayonnaise texture. Add the walnuts crushed by hand and the basil leaves chopped into small pieces and blend. Mix the mayonnaise with the chickpea fritters and the vegetables.
notes: For those allergic to nuts, make the mayonnaise without the nuts. For those allergic to eggs, make a lactonese. Recipe suitable for celiacs.

title: Leek cake with Roquefort sauce
preparation: Slice the leeks into thin rounds and fry them covered (do not brown them). Beat the eggs very well. Mix the beaten eggs with 2-3 tablespoons of breadcrumbs and let it rest for a few minutes. Add the cooked leek and beat everything together. Add the half glass of milk and beat again (if the mixture is too liquid, there is no need to add the milk). In the baking dish, grease the sides with oil and finely cover the bottom of the dish with breadcrumbs. Pour in the entire beaten mixture. Bake in the oven using a water bath for 40-45 minutes at 180-200 ºC. Let it cool before unmolding. Blend all the ingredients until a smooth cream remains.
notes: Variation of the leek cake without egg or milk for those allergic to milk protein and egg: Slice the leeks into thin rounds and fry them covered (do not brown them). Blend the tofu with the plant-based drink until it reaches a creamy consistency. Add the cooked leek with the blended tofu and beat everything together. If the mixture is too thick, you can add a little more plant-based drink to thin it out. In the baking dish, grease the sides with oil and finely cover the bottom of the dish with breadcrumbs. Pour in the entire beaten mixture. Bake in the oven using a water bath for 40-45 minutes at 180-200 ºC. Let it cool before unmolding.

title: Sweet potato gnocchi with sautéed mushrooms
preparation: For the gnocchi, wash the sweet potatoes and bake them in the oven at 200 ºC for about 45 minutes. Let them cool down. Once cooked and cold, peel them and mash them with a fork along with the black pepper, the egg, the cheese if desired, the nutmeg, and the sifted flour. Pour the mixture onto a clean surface, knead it, and keep adding flour if you see that it has a texture that is too sticky. Carefully, form a cylinder with your fingers and cut it into 2-3 cm pieces to give each piece the shape of a gnocchi. Boil them in water until they float to the surface. Meanwhile, sauté the mushrooms with garlic, parsley, and black pepper in a pan with oil. They only need to be cooked for a few minutes until golden to your liking. Mix the mushrooms with the sweet potato gnocchi and enjoy!

title: Vegetarian minestrone
preparation:
To begin, wash and peel the tomato, carrot, cabbage, celery, turnip, and potatoes. Cut everything into squares. If the green beans are fresh, trim the ends.

Peel and mince the garlic and place it in a pan to brown for a few minutes. Set aside.

Next, sauté the tomato, carrot, cabbage, celery, turnip, and potatoes with a drizzle of EVOO for about 5 minutes. Add the previously reserved garlic to the preparation.

If the peas and green beans are frozen, heat them on the side to remove the chill and add them at this point. If they are fresh, you can add them washed directly to the pan.

Cover the ingredients with water or vegetable broth, and incorporate the noodles.

Next, add salt and pepper to taste.

Bring to a boil and once it starts boiling, maintain for about 5-10 minutes.

At this point, add the cooked white beans and let them sit for a few more minutes so the flavors integrate.

Serve it hot and enjoy!

title: Onion soup
preparation: Cut the onion into brunoise or julienne style depending on preference and set aside. In a pot, add the butter and oil and let them heat up. Add the onion and sauté it. When you see it is golden, add the vegetable broth. Meanwhile, bring a container of water with a little salt to a boil; simultaneously, take a cup, line it with plastic wrap, brush it with a little oil, add the egg, and tie it with kitchen tongs or a string. When the water starts to boil, add the egg pouch and let it cook for approximately 3 minutes. Remove it and let it cool. Once the soup is made, serve in a bowl, add the toast, the egg, and the cheese (optional). Once the soup is ready, you can place it in oven-safe containers and gratin the cheese until it is golden.
notes: Vegans: Substitute the cheese with cashew "cheese". Omit the egg, you can add tofu cubes instead.

title: Leek and fennel cream with spices, sesame and poppy seeds

ingredients.name: spices to taste (pepper, cumin, ginger powder)

preparation: Chop the ingredients and sauté them in oil until they turn golden. Cover with water and boil for 15-20 minutes. Blend, previously removing some broth if there is too much, so that it reaches a creamy consistency. You can add broth later if the cream has become too thick. Once served, garnish the dish with spices and/or seeds.
notes: The cream contains a mixture of pepper, cumin, ginger, sesame seeds, and poppy seeds.

title: Kale cabbage and tofu soup "caldo verde" style
preparation: Marinate the tofu by cutting it into cubes and mixing it with a little water, oil, tamari, sweet and hot red pepper. Set it aside in the refrigerator. Finely chop the onion and garlic (brunoise) and sauté them in a large pot with oil. Add the cleaned, peeled, and coarsely diced potatoes to the pot. Add enough water to cover the potatoes and let it cook for about 25 minutes. Wash the cabbage and slice it into thin strips, removing the stem. Blend the broth until very smooth, adding a little more water if necessary. Incorporate the finely sliced cabbage into the pot and let it cook for about 5-10 minutes. Sauté the marinated tofu in a separate pan. Serve the "caldo verde" with some cubes of marinated tofu.

title: Celeriac and pear cream
preparation: Peel 1/2 celeriac and cut it into dice. Peel 2 pears and cut them into dice. Sauté the celeriac dice with the pear dice in a saucepan with olive oil for 20 minutes. Add just enough water to cover and cook for another 30 minutes. Blend and adjust the salt. Garnish with olive oil, chopped chives, and pine nuts.
notes: Vegan and vegetarian.

title: Pumpkin cream with salty ham crunch and prawns
preparation: Peel the pumpkin, onions and garlic. Chop the vegetables and add a little water, about 5 fingers. Let it boil in a pressure cooker for about 15 minutes. If you do not have a pressure cooker, let it cook for 35 minutes. Blend the result until you achieve a cream texture. Sauté the peeled prawns in a pan with a little garlic and parsley. To make the crunch, wrap the ham pieces in paper towel and put them in the microwave for 30 seconds on each side, and it will result in crunchy ham. Serve the pumpkin cream with the peeled prawns in the middle and the ham crunch. It is ready to enjoy!
notes: Ideal for diabetics due to its fiber content and because it is low in carbohydrates. You could complete it with some toasted bread as a source of slow carbohydrates. If you remove the salty ham and prawns, it is suitable for vegetarians and you could substitute the protein with grated hard-boiled egg or grated cheese.

title: Pea cream

ingredients.name: medium leeks (we will use the white part)

preparation: Prepare the mint oil by crushing the mint with extra virgin olive oil. Set aside. In a pot with a little extra virgin olive oil, sauté the chopped leek and onion. When they are golden, add the peas and let them sweat for about 3-4 minutes. Afterwards, add the hot vegetable broth and bring to a boil. Let everything cook together for about 7 minutes. After 7 minutes, remove from heat. If you want to give it a creamier texture, add the cream cheese and blend it with an immersion blender. If you wish, you can pass the cream through a fine sieve so it is even smoother. To finish, return the cream to the pan to give it a final heat. Adjust salt and black pepper to taste. Serve with the mint oil drizzled on top and chopped pepper. You can also plate the cream with chopped pistachios or cashews on top.
notes: If you want to make the recipe vegan or for those intolerant to lactose or allergic to cow's milk protein, do not add the cheese. You can substitute the cream cheese with yogurt or a plant-based drink which would help provide a smoother texture. I remind you that peas are not vegetables, they are legumes. So it is a complete cream that provides us with fiber, vitamins and is satiating.

title: Cauliflower gnocchi with pesto

ingredients.name: cauliflower or 1 small cauliflower or ½ large cauliflower
rice flour (almond flour can also be used)
pine nuts or another nut such as raw hazelnut or walnuts

preparation: Cut off the stalks and keep the cauliflower florets. Chop or grate them using the finest part of a grater so it is as fine as possible, like making cauliflower couscous. You can also chop it with a food processor. Boil the cauliflower with little water for 5 minutes. Drain it very well, preferably with a clean cotton cloth, so you can press it and help eliminate all possible water. Transfer it to a bowl and add the grated cheese, a pinch of salt, and the rice flour. Knead until all ingredients are integrated. Then form small balls approximately 1.5 cm long by rolling the balls over the tines of a fork. Immediately cook them in abundant boiling water for about 3-4 minutes. Meanwhile, to make the pesto, clean the basil keeping only the leaf and remove the germ from the middle of the garlic. Crush all the ingredients. Drain the gnocchi and immediately mix them with the pesto. You can dilute the pesto with the cooking water from the gnocchi to achieve the desired texture.
notes: Recommendation: they should be eaten without resting, because they can easily take on a gummy texture. You can accompany them with arugula and, to complement the meal, with a scramble of mushrooms. Enjoy! Recipe suitable for celiacs and ovo-lacto-vegetarians.

title: Chard Cream
preparation:
HOMEMADE PREPARATION
In a pan, heat the oil and sauté the onion; once it is golden, add the potatoes and, 2 minutes later, the chard. Let it sweat for about 5 minutes. After this time, transfer the contents to a pot and add the 0.5 l (you may need more water) and cook over high heat for about 30 minutes. If you have a pressure cooker, it will take about 10 minutes. Let the temperature drop and blend until the desired texture is achieved, add the half yogurt and blend again. Subsequently, plate it and decorate with the pine nuts (previously toasted in the pan) and adjust with pepper and, if desired, also with turmeric.

THERMOMIX PREPARATION
Peel the potatoes, wash them, and chop them into pieces. Set aside. Do the same with the chard and chop it. Set aside. Place the onion (cut into quarters) and the oil in the mixing bowl. Chop everything together for 4 seconds/Speed 4. Sauté for 7 minutes/Varoma/Speed 1. Incorporate the potatoes and sauté for two more minutes/Varoma/Speed 1. Next, add the chard. Sauté for 3 minutes/Varoma/Speed 1. Incorporate the salt and water. Cook for 30 minutes/Varoma/Speed 1. When cooking is finished, wait a few minutes for the temperature to drop. Meanwhile, toast the pine nuts. Set aside. Blend for 1 minute/Turbo speed 5-10. Add the yogurt and mix for 10 seconds/Speed 2. Serve in a soup plate, bowl, or cup. Decorate with the pine nuts, a pinch of ground pepper, and a few drops of olive oil.
notes: Nuts (the pine nuts). They can be substituted with squares of Iberian ham or whole grain rusks (which contain gluten). Vegans: do not include the yogurt in the preparation or simply swap it for a soy dessert.

title: Stuffed mushrooms
preparation: First of all, wash all the vegetables well, especially the mushrooms. Mince the garlic cloves and the onion. Next, heat oil in a large pan and once hot, add the garlic. When it is slightly golden, add the onion. While the onion is browning, finely chop the previously peeled carrots and the red bell pepper and add them to the pan. Then, remove the stems from the mushrooms, chop them very finely and add them to the pan. Season everything to taste and once all the vegetables are cooked, you can stuff the mushrooms. Optionally, you can gratin them with cheese in the oven.
notes: The recipe is suitable for vegetarian and vegan diets.

title: Artichokes with parmesan
preparation: Clean the artichokes by removing the stem and the outer leaves. Keep them in a bowl with water and parsley so they do not oxidize. Remove them from the water and slice them very thinly with a mandoline or a knife. Set aside on a flat plate. To make the vinaigrette, combine the lemon juice, EVOO, and a few drops of vinegar in a bowl. Mix well. Coat the sliced artichokes with the vinaigrette. Slice the parmesan into very thin shavings and thinly slice the green part of the spring onion. Serve the artichokes on a flat plate topped with the parmesan shavings and the sliced spring onion. Finish with a drizzle of EVOO. Optionally add salt and pepper.
notes: Hypercholesterolemia: control the amount of parmesan or you can swap it for chopped almonds. Hypertension: avoid salt and swap the parmesan for chopped almonds. Vegans: substitute the parmesan with chopped cashews and nutritional yeast.

title: Crepes with dried tomato pâté and almonds

ingredients.name: raw almonds soaked for about 12 h

preparation:
PREPARATION FOR THE PÁTÉ:
Peel the almonds if you have used them with the skin (it is very easy after soaking).
Put all the ingredients in a food processor and blend until a uniform paste is formed. You can also make it with an immersion blender, though it requires more patience; you will need to stir the mixture with a spoon because part of it gets stuck to the blades, which prevents you from continuing to blend.

PREPARATION FOR THE CREPES:
Put all the ingredients in a blender and blend until the batter is very smooth.
Let it rest for 30 minutes and stir again (it can also be prepared the day before in the refrigerator).
Heat your best frying pan well and leave it over medium heat to proceed with making the crepes. Add a few drops of EVOO, spreading them with a small piece of paper.
Using a ladle (about ¾ of a ladle), measure the amount of batter for each crepe and spread it well across the pan.
Let it cook on one side, then flip it, leaving it for a minute or until you see that it is slightly golden.
Spread 1 tablespoon of pâté onto the crepe, spread it well, then roll it up and carefully slice it into rounds to make bites and... ready to eat!!
notes: This pâté is very energetic, as the base is a nut and it contains a significant amount of oil. You will see that many ways occur to you to serve it: on toast, as a complement in a salad, etc.

title: Pumpkin ingot with pomegranate
preparation: Prepare 4 pumpkin ingots. An ingot is a rectangle about 9 cm long, 4 cm wide and 1-2 cm high. Once you have the ingot, add the spices and a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil. Use a brush to spread it, this way you avoid using too much oil; do this on both sides of the ingot. Preheat the oven to 180 ºC and bake the ingots on a tray lined with parchment paper. Bake them for about 15 minutes, carefully turn the ingots and bake them for another 10-15 minutes on the other side. Once cooked, let them cool. Deseed the pomegranate in a bowl. Also crumble the cheese with your hands and set it aside in another bowl. Once the ingots are cold, serve them on a plate and top with the deseeded pomegranate, the crumbled cheese, black pepper and a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil.
notes: Lactose intolerance: substitute the cheese with a lactose-free cheese. Vegans: substitute the cheese with a vegan cheese.

title: Pear Vichyssoise
preparation: Clean and chop the leeks and garlic. Sauté them in a pot with the oil for 10 minutes. Peel, wash, and chop the potato and add it to the pot. Peel, wash, and cut the pear into cubes. Reserve a few cubes for decoration. Add the pear cubes to the pot and sauté for a couple of minutes. Once sautéed, add the broth, milk, and salt. When it comes to a boil, let it cook for about 20 minutes. Meanwhile, sauté the remaining pear cubes with a little oil in a pan. After 20 minutes, blend the mixture and add the sautéed cubes on top.
notes: Milk can be replaced with unsweetened plant-based milk if dairy is not desired or cannot be consumed. The vegetable broth can be made without celery if it cannot be consumed.

title: Mini vegetable frittatas
preparation: Cut the vegetables into small cubes or julienne and boil them. In a bowl, beat the 4 eggs and add a bit of garlic powder. Once the vegetables are boiled, add them to the egg mixture. Fill silicone molds with the egg and vegetable mixture and place them in the microwave for about 6 minutes at maximum power to heat. Unmold and enjoy.
notes: You can swap the vegetables for whichever ones you like best. Vegan version: substitute the egg with aquafaba (the viscous water resulting from cooking legumes) or 30 g of chia seeds with 200 g of water. Leave the chia seed and water mixture overnight and you will see it takes on a honey-like consistency; add the vegetables to this mixture and continue with the procedure.

title: Stuffed eggs with avocado
preparation: Boil the eggs for about 10 minutes, until cooked, in water with a few drops of vinegar. Refresh them with cold water, peel them, cut them in half and set aside. In a bowl, mix the avocado pulp, the 4 yolks, the mayonnaise, the mustard, the lemon juice, and the garam masala, plus salt and pepper to taste. Fill each egg half with the mixture you have made. You can garnish the dish with the peppers, the pickles... Ready to serve and enjoy.

title: Venezuelan ham bread

ingredients.name: mixture of water and semi-skimmed milk (85 ml water and 85 ml milk)
egg yolk to glaze the bread before baking

preparation: Mix the milk, water, and yeast in a glass. Place the wheat flour in a container and add the mixture. Incorporate the oil and the egg and then the salt and sugar. Mix until you have a consistent dough and let it rest for one hour, covered with a kitchen cloth. Roll out the dough with a rolling pin until you have a square shape. Add the ham, raisins, and olives. Roll it up like a Swiss roll and let it rest for 20 minutes. Brush the dough with the egg yolk. Place it in the oven at 250 °C for 30 minutes. Slice and enjoy!
notes: Vegans: for vegan ham, replace the egg with olive oil and use unsweetened plant-based milk. Gluten intolerant: use gluten-free flour and yeast. For arterial hypertension: use low-salt ham and olives or exclude the olives.

title: Sweet potato chips

ingredients.name: spices to taste (black pepper, garlic powder, thyme, oregano...)

preparation: Preheat the oven to 180 ºC. Clean and peel the sweet potato. Slice it into very thin slices (you can do this by hand if you have good skill, with a potato peeler, or with a mandoline). Place the sweet potato slices on a baking sheet (it is better to use parchment paper to prevent them from sticking). Add the salt, spices to taste, and a drizzle of olive oil on top. Bake in the oven for 15 min at 180 ºC and they are ready. To achieve a crunchy texture, turn on the broiler for the last 5 minutes!
notes: To achieve a crunchy texture, turn on the broiler for the last 5 minutes!

title: Baked cauliflower with spices
preparation: Wash and cut the cauliflower into florets. In a bowl, combine the water, egg, sweet paprika, and black pepper. Add the cauliflower florets and mix so they are well coated in the sauce. Place the cauliflower on baking paper. Bake in the oven for 15 to 20 min at 180 ºC.
notes: Not suitable for low FODMAP diets.

title: Pumpkin Parmesana
preparation: Clean the pumpkin, removing the seeds and the skin. Then, slice it into thin longitudinal slices or squares as you find most convenient. Set aside. Dice the onion and sauté it in a pan with a little EVOO; when it begins to brown, add the tomato for sautéing. Together, add a pinch of salt and oregano to taste; mix and continue cooking for about 10 minutes. Preheat the oven to 180 ºC. In an ovenproof dish, distribute a layer of pumpkin slices, then add two tablespoons of the previously prepared tomato sauté and the mozzarella cheese. Repeat this action a couple of times, finishing with a layer of pumpkin and placing the parmesan cheese on top. Bake the parmesana for about 20 minutes in the oven at 180 ºC. Once it is soft and cooked on all sides, it is ready to serve. Soak the cashews in water for 8 hours. After this time, drain the water. In a container, add all the mentioned ingredients, and using a blender suitable for pureeing, blend until you achieve a cream cheese-like texture. Use this cream to replace the mozzarella cheese in the recipe. To finish the dish and as a substitute for the parmesan cheese, add nutritional yeast on top of the pumpkin.
notes: In case of being vegan or lactose intolerant, substitute the cheese with a cashew cream.

title: Bean and tomato hummus

ingredients.name: water (if it is too thick, add more)

preparation: Hydrate the tomatoes and the pepper with hot water for approximately 1 hour. Drain and dry the tomatoes and the pepper. Rinse and drain the beans. Place all the ingredients in a food processor. Blend until a fine texture is achieved. Assemble the dish and decorate with olive oil and oregano. Serve with vegetable sticks or to your taste.

title: Baked sweet potato with yogurt sauce
preparation: PREPARING SWEET POTATOES: Cut the sweet potatoes into thick wedges. Place the wedges on a baking tray, add a drizzle of EVOO, salt, and the spices: oregano, rosemary, thyme, sweet pepper, garlic powder, and freshly ground pepper. Mix well so all pieces are coated and place in a preheated oven at 180 ºC for between 35 and 50 minutes (check until the sweet potatoes are cooked). PREPARING SAUCE: Place the 250 g of yogurt in a bowl. Add the grated garlic, the juice of half a lemon, salt, and black pepper. Stir until no lumps remain. Serve with a parsley leaf for garnish.
notes: For vegans, those allergic to cow's milk protein, or lactose intolerant people, you can substitute the yogurt with a soy dessert similar to greek style or normal soy dessert by adding guar gum or rice flour as a thickener.

title: Lupin and dried fruit "cheese"

ingredients.name: raw dried fruits (walnuts, almonds, hazelnuts and cashews)

preparation: Leave the lupin beans in water for two hours to desalt them (change the water a couple of times). In a bowl, mix the extra virgin olive oil, the tamari, and the bay leaf and let them macerate for two hours. Drain and blend the lupin beans together with the rice drink and the dried fruits until it becomes a paste. Add the onion, garlic powder, and nutmeg. In a saucepan, dissolve the agar-agar in water and bring to a boil. Lower the heat and let it cook for a couple of minutes. Remove from heat and add the lupin mixture. Brush a glass container with the macerated oil and pour in the mixture. Let it rest and once cold, place it in the refrigerator. It will be ready in a couple of hours.
notes: Vegan recipe

title: Curry Cauliflower
preparation: Steam the cauliflower for 5 minutes. Add the coconut milk to a pan and heat it until the coconut fat lumps disappear. Add the curry (powder or paste) and stir until well integrated. Add the cauliflower to the sauce and let it cook over medium heat for 10 minutes. Add more coconut milk depending on the amount of sauce you want.
notes: If you cannot or do not want to use coconut milk, you could use heavy cream instead. Caution: Make sure the curry does not contain traces of gluten.

title: Xisquet lamb stew (autochthonous breed from Pallars and Alta Ribagorça) with vegetables and potatoes

ingredients.name: lamb meat (leg, neck and rib tips)
seasonal or dried mushrooms (chanterelles, porcini, etc.)

preparation: Chop the meat (you can ask the butcher to cut it for stew, into small pieces with bones). Use a pressure cooker or express pot. Put the EVOO in the pot and sear the meat pieces on all sides; the oil should be hot to sear the meat in 2-3 minutes per side. Once the meat is seared, set it aside on a plate. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Sauté the vegetables, already sliced into rounds or sticks depending on personal preference. First the onion, garlic, and leek, followed by the chopped peeled tomato and the carrots. When the onion begins to brown, add the meat pieces we set aside, the parsley, and the cumin and mix everything so the flavors blend and the meat absorbs the flavor of the vegetables and spices. Let cook for 2-3 minutes. Add two glasses of water and let cook for 5 minutes. After 5 minutes, remove from heat, add the potatoes cut into large cubes and the peas. Mix all the ingredients. Close the pressure cooker and let cook for about 10 minutes with the valve up (using the quick option of the pot); once 10 minutes have passed, turn off the heat and wait for the valve to descend. Once it can be opened safely, check that the meat falls off the bone and that the potatoes are cooked through. If not, you can close the pot again and leave it closed for a few more minutes to finish cooking. Serve as a main course or a second course, accompanied by a salad with escarole, roasted pepper, beetroot, and candied cabbage.
notes: VEGANS: this recipe can be adapted for vegans by substituting the lamb meat with tempeh. Dice the tempeh strips, sauté them, and add the rest of the ingredients in the same way as the lamb stew. In this case, 2 glasses of vegetable broth should also be added. DIABETES: it is a suitable dish for diabetics, you just need to adjust the amount of potatoes and peas, and they can be substituted for other vegetables like pumpkin. LOW FAT OR HYPOCALORIC DIET: decrease the amount of EVOO, potatoes, and peas, and remove the fat from the meat.

title: White bean and Granny Smith apple hummus
preparation: Leave the dry legumes to soak for 24 hours in warm water with a few drops of lemon juice or vinegar to activate them. Change the water after 12 hours. Cook the soaked legumes in a pressure cooker for 20 minutes once the steam comes out. Once the legumes are cooked, drain them and place them together with the rest of the ingredients in a food processor and blend until a fine paste without lumps is obtained. You can add a pinch of freshly ground three-color pepper as a final touch once the hummus is plated.
notes: It can be accompanied by whole grain crackers, slices of toasted bread, or vegetable sticks.

title: “Baldó” Style Rabbit Shoulder with Calçots
preparation: Season the rabbit shoulders with salt and pepper and brown them on both sides with egg. Once browned, remove them, add the calçots, cut into slices, and sauté over low heat until they are tender. Subsequently, incorporate the rabbit shoulders that you have previously browned, and stir to mix the flavors. Finally, add 2 cups of chicken broth and let it cook for 30 minutes.
notes: Optional: you can whisk an egg and add it to the cooking. With the heat, the egg yolk emulsifies and also gives it a touch of color; you could also add turmeric. For hypertensive individuals, eliminate the addition of salt.

title: Pumpkin and tofu rolllets
preparation: Soak the textured soy in a bowl for 20 minutes. Cut the pumpkins in half, add salt, pepper, and a drizzle of EVOO. Bake in the oven at 200 ºC for about 40-60 minutes until cooked (depending on the size). In a saucepan, heat 3 tbsp of EVOO and sauté the minced garlic and leek for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, wash, peel, and grate the carrots. Add them to the saucepan and continue sautéing for 5 more minutes. Add the drained soy, tomato, cinnamon, sage, pepper, and salt. Cook over low heat for 20 minutes. If necessary, you can add a little water. Using a spoon, empty the pumpkin pulp but not entirely so they maintain their shape. Add this pulp into the saucepan and mix it with the rest of the soy filling. Fill the halves with the filling. Sprinkle some grated cheese on top and gratin for a few minutes.
notes: This recipe is vegetarian and suitable for everyone. It can be gratinated with onion powder instead of cheese to adapt it to a vegan diet.

title: Potato and sweet potato omelet
preparation:
Peel the potato and the sweet potato. Cut them into small cubes and cook for 6 to 8 minutes in a microwave steamer.
Meanwhile, peel the onion and chop it. Add it to the steamer and cook for another 4-6 minutes. In the last minute, you can add the peeled and chopped garlic cloves.
Before making the omelet, sauté everything in a pan with a little olive oil to enhance the flavor.
In a bowl, mix the potato, sweet potato, and vegetables with the beaten eggs. Finally, add the lightly chopped chives leaves.
In a non-stick pan, cook the omelet on both sides.
notes: For a vegan version, you can substitute the eggs with chickpea flour and water. The ratio for these quantities would be 100 g of chickpea flour mixed with 130 ml of water.

title: Pumpkin and tofu rice paper rolls
preparation: To make the filling for the rolls, first dice the tofu, pumpkin, and pepper into small cubes, heat the pan and add the oil; first add the tofu cubes, turmeric, and pepper, followed by the pumpkin and pepper, sauté everything together and let it cook over low heat covered for about 15 minutes. Check that the pumpkin and pepper are cooked and turn off the heat. To prepare the rice sheets, hydrate them with hot water and lay them on a cotton cloth to subsequently fill them with the pumpkin and tofu (instructions on how to prepare them and how to make the rolls are included in the package). Fill the rolls and serve them with a little soy sauce.
notes: If you have high blood pressure, avoid soy sauce. You can add other vegetables such as shredded white cabbage or carrot strips, which also go very well.

title: Stuffed Eggplants
preparation: Wash the 4 eggplants and cut them lengthwise. Scoop out the eggplant pulp with the help of a spoon. Wash and cut all the vegetables into small cubes (eggplant pulp, squash, carrot, onion, and pepper) and set aside. Season the chicken with salt. In a pan, add the 4 tbsp of oil, sauté the chicken, and remove it. In the same oil used for the chicken, add all the chopped vegetables and sauté them over low heat. Add salt and spices. If more oil is needed, add a little water or broth. Cover the pan and let it cook for 4-5 minutes, stirring frequently. Dice the chicken and once the vegetables are cooked, add the chicken to the pan. Stir everything and remove from heat. Preheat the oven to 200 ºC. Fill the eggplants with the vegetables and the chicken. Place baking paper on the baking tray and then place the stuffed eggplant halves on top. Sprinkle a little grated cheese over them. Place the tray in the oven, first cook for 10-15 minutes on the bottom (until the eggplant skin thickens), and then cook them on the top with the grill for 6-8 minutes. Serve... and enjoy! Bon appétit!
notes: Vegetarian and vegan: substitute the chicken with textured soy and change the cheese to vegan cheese or crushed natural tomato. Hypertension: do not add salt and use other spices.

title: Stuffed Pumpkin with Bolognese
preparation: Preheat the oven to 180 ºC. Wash the pumpkins and dry them with paper towels. Place the pumpkins on a baking sheet, cover them with baking paper, and place them in the oven for 25 minutes. Wash the carrot and peel the onion. Chop these two vegetables, place them together in a pan with olive oil for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add the red pepper and the garlic clove to the sauté. Add the minced meat and sauté, stirring, until it changes color. Add the crushed tomato, salt, ground black pepper, ground turmeric, and oregano, and stir everything together. Let it all cook together for 20 minutes and adjust the salt and pepper if necessary. Remove the pumpkins from the oven, wait five minutes, and cut them in half horizontally. Clean them by removing the seeds and filaments from the inside. Sprinkle nutmeg over the pumpkins. Stuff them with the bolognese, sprinkle the grated cheese on top, and place them in the oven for 10 minutes until the cheese melts. Serve immediately.
notes: For vegans, the minced chicken can be replaced with textured soy and the grated cheese with vegan cheese, deactivated nutritional yeast or non-bitter brewer's yeast.

title: Lentil and beetroot meatballs with carrot and thyme sauce

ingredients.name: fine oat flakes or rice flour

preparation: Sauté the chopped onion and garlic in a saucepan with a little olive oil. Remove from heat and add the rest of the ingredients. Preheat the oven to 180 ºC. Form the meatballs with wet hands and place them on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Brush with olive oil and bake for about 15 minutes. For the sauce, peel and clean the leek and carrots, and cut them into 1/2 cm thick slices. Sauté the leek in a saucepan with 2 tbsp of olive oil for about 2 minutes, then add the carrot and chopped garlic. Let it cook for about 5 minutes, then cover with water. Once boiling, add the thyme and let it cook until the carrot is soft. Remove the thyme and blend it. You can add water or broth until you achieve the desired consistency. Add the soy sauce, nutritional yeast, salt, and black pepper to taste. Arrange the meatballs on the plate decoratively with the sauce over or beside them.
notes: Contains gluten if oats are used. Special recipe variations: vegan, hypertension, diabetes, hypercholesterolemia, etc.

title: Peas with ham
preparation: Boil the peas for about 8-9 minutes. Dice the onion and sauté it over low heat. When it is soft, add the diced ham, and before it begins to brown, add the grated tomatoes and pepper. Once the peas are cooked, drain them (reserving a little of the cooking water) and add them to the pan with the onion and tomato. Stir well and let cook for 5 minutes so all the flavors integrate (you can add a little of the cooking water if you see the preparation is drying out, to make it creamier).
notes: Vegans/ vegetarians: Omit the ham from the recipe.

title: Butternut squash and hummus boats

ingredients.name: garlic powder or 1 clove of garlic

preparation: Preheat the oven to 180 ºC, clean the butternut squash with water, cut off the ends and make partitions about 4-5 fingers wide (2-3 portions). Place parchment paper on the baking tray, cut the squash portions into slices (approximately 1 cm wide) and cook briefly for about 5 min (you can also do this in the microwave (3 min) or on a grill). While the squash is cooking slightly, make the hummus. Blend all the ingredients and puree them. If you like a more compact texture, drain the liquid from the jar, and if you want it more fluid, leave it in (if it stays a bit denser, you will be able to handle it better). Once the hummus is made and the squash is half-cooked, make the boat ("montadito"). Place a layer of squash, dip with hummus (generously), place another layer of squash (do not press! otherwise it will come out the sides), another layer of hummus, and finally another layer of squash on top. Once you have all the boats ("montaditos") made and spread out on the baking tray, add a bit of parmesan cheese (or any other) and a bit of oregano on top. Place them in the oven (approximately 8 min or until you notice that the cheese has melted and is toasted).
notes: You can stick in some long toothpicks so they stay more fixed. Consult your dietitian-nutritionist or check the nutritional label of the cheese as it may contain lysozyme from egg.

title: Autumn Chickpeas
preparation: Soak the chickpeas for about 10-12 hours. The next day, drain the soaking water and add clean water, a bay leaf, and cook them until they are tender. In a separate pot, boil the brown rice, drain it, and set aside. Next, cut the pumpkin and set it aside. Chop and sauté the onion, garlic, and bell peppers with a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil. Then add the mushrooms, cover, and cook for 10 to 15 minutes. Add the pumpkin and cook for a few more minutes, making sure it doesn't get too soft. Add the salt, cumin, thyme, and paprika. Once the vegetables are prepared, mix them with the chickpeas and the rice, and the dish is ready to serve.

title: Cod with thyme, hard-boiled egg and pine nuts
preparation: Dry the cod well to remove all the water. Heat a pan with a little olive oil. Flour the cod and cook it in a very hot pan. Set aside. Slice the leek and the onion into julienne. Cook them in a pan or casserole until golden, then add the minced garlic and parsley. Stir for a couple of minutes and then add the peeled tomato cut into dice and a sprig of thyme. Cook slowly until you achieve a good sofrito. Meanwhile, hard-boil the egg and sauté the pine nuts in another pan. Once the sofrito is ready, place the cod in the casserole and add the pine nuts and the hard-boiled egg cut into quarters. Let it cook together over low heat for 15 minutes.
notes: For celiacs: substitute the wheat flour with chickpea flour.

title: Sole with orange and almonds
preparation: To start, coat the sole in flour and cook them in a pan with the extra virgin olive oil until golden. Set the sole aside on a plate and in the same pan, sauté the previously chopped onion. Meanwhile, squeeze the juice of two oranges. Peel the third orange and separate its segments. Add the orange juice to the sautéed onion and let it reduce slightly. Blend the onion with the orange juice and pour the sauce over the sole. Pass the orange segments through the pan and, once browned, place them on the plate as a garnish. Finally, chop the almonds and sprinkle them over the sole.
notes: Vegetarians/ Fish allergy: Substitute the sole with tofu.

title: Cauliflower faux couscous Moroccan style
preparation: Separate the cauliflower florets and chop them (they should have a granular consistency). Sauté the previously chopped spring onion and garlic with a bit of olive oil. Add the chopped almonds and raisins. Sauté until they begin to color. Add the chopped cauliflower and a bit of salt, then sauté. Add the cumin and Ras-el-Hanout and sauté everything together for about 15 minutes. Adjust the salt and serve.
notes: Suitable for vegans and vegetarians.

title: Baked Sea Bass with Garlic and Parsley
preparation: Place the olive oil in a blender with the cleaned parsley leaves and the 2 peeled garlic cloves and blend. Place the sea bass fillets in an ovenproof dish. Slice the tomatoes and place them on top. Pour the garlic and parsley sauce over them. Bake at 180 ºC for about 15 minutes.

title: Eggs in a dish with vegetables
preparation: Boil the tomatoes and add cold water or ice cubes. The contrast will allow them to be peeled easily. Peel and chop the onion. Sauté in a non-stick pan with two tablespoons of oil for five minutes. Wash the eggplant and cut it into cubes with the skin on. Add it to the pan and continue cooking for about five more minutes. Peel the tomatoes and cut them into cubes. Incorporate them into the cooking, stirring with a wooden spoon, and remove from the heat. Add pepper, turmeric, and sea salt. By cooking, you will have inactivated the solanine, an indigestible compound contained in raw eggplant. It's time, add the eggs! Distribute the vegetables into 4 ramekins, ceramic bowls, or glass bowls and crack 1 egg into each. Grate the cheese and sprinkle it on top. Bake the ramekins in a previously preheated oven at 200 degrees for 10 minutes and remove them when the egg white is cooked.
notes: Instead of cheese, you can add chopped ham. By cooking, you will have inactivated the solanine, an indigestible compound contained in raw eggplant. In case of high blood pressure, control the salt intake.

title: Open mushroom and ham omelet
preparation: Clean the mushrooms and spring garlic and cut everything into pieces large enough to distinguish each ingredient. In a pan with a little EVOO, sauté the spring garlic with the mushrooms. When they begin to brown, add the diced ham and sauté for 3 more minutes, then set aside. Beat the eggs with a little salt. Heat a non-stick pan with a little EVOO. Once the EVOO is hot, add the beaten eggs. Let the eggs start to cook for a few seconds and then lower the heat. Now is the time to gradually add the filling to the omelet while it cooks slowly. First, add the mushroom, spring garlic, and ham mixture that was previously set aside. Spread it over the surface of the omelet so that it covers the entire area. Next, add the chopped parmesan cheese, the crushed nuts, and the fresh parsley. Do not flip the omelet; instead, let it cook slowly over low heat. When you see that the egg has completely set, it is ready to serve. Serve the omelet with some arugula on top and some slices of bread.
notes: If the ham is removed, it is suitable for vegetarian diets (ovo-lacto-vegetarian). If the ham, cheese, and salt are also removed, it is suitable for people with high blood pressure (hypertension).

title: Sweet potato and quinoa veggie burgers

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.quantity: to taste or none, if there is a restriction

preparation: Heat 450 ml of water until boiling; rinse the quinoa well with cold water and add it to the boiling water. Cook for about 15 minutes and let it rest (follow the manufacturer's instructions). Heat a pan with 3 tablespoons of oil over medium heat. Grate the sweet potato, once peeled, with a grater, finely chop the onion and also the garlic and add them to the pan. Stir constantly. Add salt and pepper to taste. After 5 minutes, cut the lamb's lettuce or spinach into small pieces and add them to the pan with the rest of the ingredients and leave it on the heat for 5 more minutes. Once ready, mix it with the cooked quinoa in a container and aromatize it with a bit of curry (optional). Beat the two eggs in a bowl and add them to the preparation. Then add the flour and mix well until a homogeneous texture is achieved. Now it is time to make the burgers with your hands: you will make eight. Heat a little olive oil in a pan and fry them. You can also make them in the oven by brushing them with oil beforehand.

title: Monkfish with potato and sweet potato
preparation: Peel the sweet potatoes and the potatoes. Cut them into cubes. Clean the artichokes and slice them into thin pieces. Place them on a baking tray lined with parchment paper. Add a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil and salt, and bake at 200 ºC until golden (you can use the oven to bake other vegetables). In a non-stick pan, add 4 tablespoons of extra virgin olive oil and cook the sweet potatoes and potatoes, covering with a lid that fits well to make the most of the heat and avoid adding more oil. Add a bit of salt. When they are cooked, set them aside. Finally, cook the monkfish in the same non-stick pan where the sweet potatoes and potatoes were cooked for about 5 minutes per side. Assemble the dish with the monkfish, sweet potato, potatoes, and artichokes. Season with extra virgin olive oil, garlic, and parsley powder.
notes: Recipe where the addition of salt can be omitted for hypertensive individuals.

title: Eggplant cannelloni stuffed with creamy chicken

ingredients.name: ripe tomatoes or natural crushed tomato

preparation:
Clean the eggplant. Peel the tomatoes.
Using a mandoline, cut the eggplant into very thin longitudinal slices (if they are too thick they will break when rolling). You should get about 6 thick slices per unit. Remove the ends.
Soak the eggplant slices for about 15 minutes to remove the bitterness.
Dry the slices with paper towel, and grill them on a griddle; flipping them once is enough to leave them slightly golden on both sides and soften the fiber.
On the other hand, cook the chicken fillets. They can be steamed, cooked en papillote, or grilled. Season them with garlic, thyme, red pepper, and a pinch of salt.
When cooked, blend the chicken with the cream and the chives. It should result in a smooth, creamy paste.
Place the filling in the middle of each cooked eggplant slice and roll. Tie with a toothpick so the roll does not unravel.
Using a grater or blender, make a puree of the tomatoes (the pulp, without the skin).
Cook it over low heat with a bit of salt and olive oil. Let it reduce until it thickens.
Remove the toothpick and place the tomato sauce on top.
Garnish with some fresh thyme leaves and serve hot.
notes:
For ovo-lacto-vegetarians, the chicken can be replaced with grated hard-boiled egg.
For vegans, the chicken can be replaced with tofu, and the liquid cream with soy, rice, or oat cream.

title: Sweet potato, spinach and tuna patties
preparation:
Peel the sweet potatoes and cut them into cubes. Place the cut sweet potato in a bowl, moisten it with water, and cook it in the microwave for 10 minutes at maximum power.
Meanwhile, grate the onion and garlic, and sauté them in a pan with the olive oil.
Add the spinach and continue cooking until they have reduced in volume.
Mix the cooked sweet potatoes with the onion, garlic, and spinach.
Add the tuna, eggs, salt, and pepper and, using a fork, mash and mix everything until it forms a paste.
Preheat the oven to 180 ºC.
Once everything is well mixed, place baking paper on an oven-safe tray. Form the patties with the sweet potato paste, using a ring mold to help shape them.
Add grated cheese on top of each patty.
Place the tray with the patties in the oven and bake for 10 minutes.
Finally, gratin for 1 minute and half and remove from the oven.
You can consume them hot, or you can let them cool down, as it is a versatile dish that can be eaten cold or hot.
Plate and garnish the dish with vegetables.
notes: You can consume them hot, or you can let them cool down, as it is a versatile dish that can be eaten cold or hot.

title: Pumpkin and tofu rolls “Veggie-roll” with escalivada and cheese

ingredients.name: black olives chopped into small pieces

preparation: Preheat the oven to 200 ºC. Boil the chard for 10 minutes so it softens. Drain it and place it in a bowl. Add the 3 eggs and mix well as if you were making an omelet. Pour the mixture onto a baking tray lined with parchment paper, forming a thin, more or less rectangular sheet. Bake for 10 minutes, turn carefully and bake on the other side until cooked (approx. 10 min more). On top of the chard base, make a layer with the emmental cheese and add the chopped olives and the escalivada. Roll it up using the help of the parchment paper. Bake again for 10 minutes.

title: Codfish stew with artichokes and langoustines
preparation: Clean and cut the artichokes, onions, and spring garlic into pieces. Grate the tomato. Place the oil in a casserole and sauté the artichokes and onions. Once the artichokes and onions are sautéed, add the spring garlic, the garlic clove, and the chopped parsley bunch. Let it sauté for two minutes and then add the grated tomato. Next, incorporate about 200 ml of water, 1 bay leaf, and the salt into the casserole. Let it cook until the vegetables are cooked. Once the vegetables are cooked, add the cod loins and the langoustines to the casserole. Finally, cover and let cook until the fish is cooked to perfection.

title: Vegetable cannelloni with seitan and hard-boiled egg
preparation:
FILLING PREPARATION: First of all, finely chop the onions and sauté them in a pan with a drizzle of EVOO and a pinch of Himalayan salt. When the onion is transparent, add the finely chopped mushrooms. Once you see that the mushrooms are cooked, add the seitan and the hard-boiled eggs, all previously finely chopped, and sauté everything together. Taste and adjust the salt.

CANELLONI BASE PREPARATION: Use a potato peeler to slice the butternut squash and carrots into thin strips. Place a pot of water to boil with a bit of salt. When the water reaches a boil, add all the squash and carrot strips and boil them for 20 seconds (no more than this time). Once this time has passed, place them immediately in a bowl of ice water to stop the cooking.

ASSEMBLING THE CANNELLONI: Place the squash and carrot slices alternately, overlapping them slightly to make rolling easier. You can make two thick cannelloni or four smaller ones. Place a bit of filling on one end of the strips. Finally, using a knife, lift the ends where the filling is and roll them up gradually until the cannelloni is formed. To finish, place the cannelloni in the oven, preheated to 180 ºC, for five minutes, and they will be ready to serve.
notes:
Recipe suitable for ovo-lacto vegetarians.
In case of high blood pressure, salt can be avoided or reduced.
If you want the recipe to be suitable for vegans, just remove the hard-boiled egg.
To make it suitable for celiacs, seitan could be replaced with poultry strips.

title: Spiced chicken and vegetable soup with rice noodles
preparation: The night before preparing this recipe, marinate the whole chicken breast with the soy sauce and a bit of grated ginger; this will give it a good flavor that will also pass into the soup. Also, if you use dried shiitake mushrooms, place them in a bowl with slightly warm water so they can rehydrate. Place the pressure cooker on the heat and add the EVOO. Take the vegetables, clean them well, peel them, and cut them into strips of about 10 cm. Cut the onion in half and slice it into julienne. Place them inside the pressure cooker. Take the whole chicken breast and place it inside with the soy sauce. Take the fresh mushrooms or those you have rehydrated overnight, and place them whole or halved; for the dried ones, you should cut off the stem. Add the salt, curry, turmeric, and grate a little more ginger or cut a slice and put it in the pot to add more flavor. Turn on the heat and sauté everything for one minute. Once done, pour in enough water for the pressure cooker to make a good broth; this will depend a lot on what you have at home. Close it and cook the broth under low pressure for 10-15 minutes. Once the time has elapsed, open the pot, remove the whole chicken, and leave it on a small plate. Weigh the rice noodles and put the broth on the heat; once it starts to boil, add the rice noodles. The cooking time will depend on the brand (with the noodles used, it takes about 8-10 minutes). While they are cooking, stir them to prevent them from sticking. Start cutting the chicken into slightly thick fillets, and when the soup is ready, put the meat in so it finishes heating up. Serve.

title: Adzuki and Pumpkin Stew
preparation: PREPARATION OF ADZUKI BEANS: Bring the adzuki beans to a boil with the kombu seaweed and cook over low heat. (Pressure cooker: 60 minutes; boiling: 90 minutes). Open the pot, add the salt, stir, and cook for 10 more minutes uncovered until the desired consistency is obtained. PREPARATION OF THE STEW: Sauté the onion with olive oil and salt until it begins to brown. Add the pumpkin and a little salt. Cook covered over low heat until the pumpkin is "al dente", adding a splash of water if necessary so it doesn't stick. Incorporate the cooked adzuki beans and a little water to mix everything together. Cook for 5 more minutes and season with tamari. Optionally, serve the dish with 1 tbsp of sesame oil and fresh chives.
notes: Optionally, serve the dish with 1 tbsp of sesame oil and fresh chives.

title: Cauliflower stew with tofu
preparation: Make a sofrito by putting the olive oil in the pot with the onion, leek, garlic, and pepper. Once it has taken color, add the cauliflower and sauté until it is slightly golden. While that is cooking, cut the tofu with fine herbs into small squares and sauté it in the pan until golden. Set aside. When the sofrito is ready, add the potato, the vegetable broth you have made (or water), and the reserved tofu, and let it all cook until the potato is tender. Add it to the stew and let it cook for another two or three minutes. Turn off the heat and take a little bit of the hot broth to dissolve the miso. Pour it back into the pot and mix everything well. Serve in a deep dish topped with chopped chives. There you go! Enjoy!
notes: Recipe suitable for vegans and vegetarians, low in sodium and suitable for diabetics.

title: Microwave Hasselback Potatoes

ingredients.name: medium potatoes (choose regular or oblong potatoes)
thinly sliced havarti cheese or any other melting cheese (can be low fat)

preparation: Wash the potatoes and dry them with paper towels. Take two chopsticks and place one on each side of the potato to act as a guide for the knife. Using the knife, make vertical cuts every half centimeter along the entire length of the potato, ensuring the base remains uncut (like the pages of a book). Place it in a microwave-safe container, add a little olive oil, and cook for about 4 minutes at maximum power. Check if the potato is cooked; if not, cook for a bit longer until it is somewhat soft. Meanwhile, cut pieces of cheese and ham of the same size and pair them up. Remove the potato from the microwave, wait for it to cool slightly so it doesn't burn you, and separate the slices. Place a piece of ham and cheese into each gap. Once the entire potato is stuffed, add the spices and herbs and return it to the microwave for one and a half to two minutes, until the cheese melts. And they are ready! Serve with a green salad, cherry tomatoes, or any other vegetable.
